overview.main_flow_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Program Start]):::start

    INIT[1: Program Initialization
Initialize working storage,
communication areas, set defaults]:::process
    SESSION[2: Session Context Setup
Store transaction ID, program name,
map name, mapset name]:::process
    FIRSTTIME{3: First-Time Entry?
EIBCALEN = 0?}:::decision
    INITFIRST[3: Initialize paging variables
Set screen to first page]:::process
    LOADCOMM[Load existing session data
from communication area]:::process
    PFKEYSTORE[39: Function Key Aliasing
Map PF13-PF24 to PF1-PF12
Store pressed key]:::process
    RETURNFROMADD{4: Return from Add Screen?
PF3 from Add/Update program?}:::decision
    RESETLIST[4: Reset list screen
to fresh state, first page]:::process
    RECEIVEINPUT{First interaction?
From this program?}:::decision
    RECEIVEMAP[5: Screen Input Reception
Receive Transaction Type List screen
Capture type code filter, description filter,
row selections, codes, descriptions]:::process
    EDITINPUTS[Validate all inputs]:::process
    ROWVALIDATION[6: Row Selection Validation
Validate action codes U/D
Count deletes and updates requested]:::process
    MULTIACTION{7: Multiple Actions
Selected?}:::decision
    MULTIERROR[7: Set error - only one
action allowed at a time]:::process
    DESCCHANGE[8: Row Description Change Detection
Compare entered description
against stored description]:::process
    DESCVALIDATION[9: Row Description Validation
Validate alphanumeric, not blank
for update requests]:::process
    TYPEFILTER[10: Type Code Filter Validation
Validate 2-digit numeric
or treat as blank/no-filter]:::process
    TYPECHANGE{11: Type Code Filter
Changed?}:::decision
    RESETPAGETYPE[11: Reset paging variables
for new filter]:::process
    DESCFILTER[12: Description Filter Validation
Treat as blank or wrap with
wildcard % for LIKE search]:::process
    DESCCHANGEFILTER{13: Description Filter
Changed?}:::decision
    RESETPAGEDESC[13: Reset paging variables
for new filter]:::process
    CROSSVAL[14: Filter Cross-Validation
Check if matching records exist
for given filter conditions]:::process

    TRTYPE_CHECK[(CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
DB2 Table)]:::datasource

    NORECORDS{14: Records found
for filter?}:::decision
    FILTERERROR[14: Set error - No records
found for filter conditions]:::process
    PFKEYVAL{15: PF Key Validation
Which key was pressed?
Is it valid in current context?}:::decision
    INVALIDKEY[15: Invalid key pressed
Treat as Enter key]:::process

    PF3{PF3 Pressed?
Exit to Menu}:::decision
    EXITMENU[16: Exit to Main Menu
Transfer control to
administration menu program]:::final

    PF2{PF2 Pressed?
Add New Record}:::decision
    ADDSCREEN[17: Navigate to Add Transaction Type Screen
Transfer to Add/Update program]:::final

    PF8{PF8 Pressed?
Forward Page}:::decision
    NEXTPAGEEXISTS{35: Next Page Exists?}:::decision
    READFORWARD[18: Forward Paging
Read next page of records
from last key, increment page number
up to 7 records]:::process

    TRTYPE_FWD[(CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
DB2 Table - Forward Cursor)]:::datasource

    NOMOREPAGES[37: Last Page Tracking
No more pages to display]:::process

    PF7{PF7 Pressed?
Backward Page}:::decision
    FIRSTPAGECHECK{20: Already on
First Page?}:::decision
    FIRSTPAGEMSG[20: First Page Boundary Check
No previous pages available]:::process
    READBACK[19: Backward Paging
Read previous page backwards
from first key, decrement page
fill up to 7 rows in reverse]:::process

    TRTYPE_BWD[(CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
DB2 Table - Backward Cursor)]:::datasource

    INPUTERROR{Input Errors
Exist?}:::decision
    DISPLAYERROR[34: Error Message Display
Show validation error messages
on screen]:::process

    ENTERDELETE{Enter + Delete
Requested?}:::decision
    DELETECONFIRM[21: Delete Confirmation Request
Highlight selected row
Prompt user to press PF10 to confirm]:::process

    PF10DELETE{PF10 + Delete
Confirmed?}:::decision
    DELETEEXEC[22: Delete Record Execution
Delete selected transaction type
from database by type code]:::process

    TRTYPE_DEL[(CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
DB2 Table - DELETE)]:::datasource

    DELETESUCCESS{23: Delete
Succeeded?}:::decision
    DELETEOK[23: Delete Success Handling
Display success message
Reset session, return to first page]:::success
    DELETECHILD[24: Delete Failure - Child Records
Inform user to delete
associated child records first]:::process

    ENTERUPDATE{Enter + Update
Requested?}:::decision
    UPDATECONFIRM[25: Update Confirmation Request
Highlight selected row
Prompt user to press PF10 to save]:::process

    PF10UPDATE{PF10 + Update
Confirmed?}:::decision
    NOCHANGE{28: No Changes
Detected?}:::decision
    NOCHANGEMSG[28: No Change Detection
Inform user no changes detected]:::process
    UPDATEEXEC[26: Update Record Execution
Update description of selected
transaction type in database]:::process

    TRTYPE_UPD[(CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
DB2 Table - UPDATE)]:::datasource

    UPDATESUCCESS{27: Update
Succeeded?}:::decision
    UPDATEOK[27: Update Success Handling
Display success message
Refresh list with updated data]:::success

    PF10CHANGED{29: F10 with Changed
Criteria?}:::decision
    TREATASENTER[29: Treat as Enter key
instead of confirming action]:::process

    NORECORDSFOUND{36: No Records Found
on First Page?}:::decision
    NORECORDSMSG[36: No Records Found Notification
Inform user no records found
for current search conditions]:::process

    BUILDSCREEN[30: Transaction Type List Display
Build screen with up to 7 records
page number, date, time, action fields]:::process
    SETUPATTRIBS[31: Screen Attribute Setup
Set colors, protection, cursor
based on current action state]:::process
    FILTERDISP[32: Search Filter Display
Display type code and description
filter values with appropriate colors]:::process
    INFOMSG[33: Informational Message Display
Display context-sensitive messages
to guide user actions]:::process
    ERRMSG[34: Error Message Display
Display error messages
for validation failures]:::process
    CENTERMSG[40: Informational Message Centering
Calculate trimmed message length
Center message on screen]:::process
    SENDSCREEN[Send screen to user]:::process

    SAVESTATE[38: Session State Persistence
Save paging keys, screen data,
selected row, flags, filter values
to communication area]:::process

    RETURN([Return - Wait for
Next User Interaction]):::final

    START --> INIT
    INIT --> SESSION
    SESSION --> FIRSTTIME
    FIRSTTIME -->|Yes - New Session| INITFIRST
    FIRSTTIME -->|No - Existing Session| LOADCOMM
    INITFIRST --> PFKEYSTORE
    LOADCOMM --> PFKEYSTORE
    PFKEYSTORE --> RETURNFROMADD
    RETURNFROMADD -->|Yes - PF3 from Add Screen| RESETLIST
    RETURNFROMADD -->|No| RECEIVEINPUT
    RESETLIST --> RECEIVEINPUT
    RECEIVEINPUT -->|Yes - Receive Input| RECEIVEMAP
    RECEIVEINPUT -->|No - First Time| PFKEYVAL
    RECEIVEMAP --> EDITINPUTS
    EDITINPUTS --> ROWVALIDATION
    ROWVALIDATION --> MULTIACTION
    MULTIACTION -->|Yes| MULTIERROR
    MULTIACTION -->|No| DESCCHANGE
    MULTIERROR --> DESCCHANGE
    DESCCHANGE --> DESCVALIDATION
    DESCVALIDATION --> TYPEFILTER
    TYPEFILTER --> TYPECHANGE
    TYPECHANGE -->|Yes - Changed| RESETPAGETYPE
    TYPECHANGE -->|No - Same| DESCFILTER
    RESETPAGETYPE --> DESCFILTER
    DESCFILTER --> DESCCHANGEFILTER
    DESCCHANGEFILTER -->|Yes - Changed| RESETPAGEDESC
    DESCCHANGEFILTER -->|No - Same| CROSSVAL
    RESETPAGEDESC --> CROSSVAL
    CROSSVAL --> TRTYPE_CHECK
    TRTYPE_CHECK -.->|COUNT query
Check matching records| NORECORDS
    NORECORDS -->|No Records| FILTERERROR
    NORECORDS -->|Records Found| PFKEYVAL
    FILTERERROR --> PFKEYVAL
    PFKEYVAL -->|Invalid Key| INVALIDKEY
    INVALIDKEY --> PFKEYVAL
    PFKEYVAL -->|PF3| PF3
    PF3 -->|Yes| EXITMENU
    PF3 -->|No| PF2
    PF2 -->|Yes| ADDSCREEN
    PF2 -->|No| PF10CHANGED
    PF10CHANGED -->|PF10 + Criteria Changed| TREATASENTER
    PF10CHANGED -->|PF10 + No Change| PF8
    TREATASENTER --> ENTERDELETE
    PF8 -->|Yes| NEXTPAGEEXISTS
    NEXTPAGEEXISTS -->|Yes - More Pages| READFORWARD
    READFORWARD --> TRTYPE_FWD
    TRTYPE_FWD -.->|Forward Cursor
Fetch up to 7 rows| NORECORDSFOUND
    NORECORDSFOUND -->|No Records on Page 1| NORECORDSMSG
    NORECORDSFOUND -->|Records Found| BUILDSCREEN
    NORECORDSMSG --> BUILDSCREEN
    NEXTPAGEEXISTS -->|No - Last Page| NOMOREPAGES
    NOMOREPAGES --> BUILDSCREEN
    PF8 -->|No| PF7
    PF7 -->|Yes| FIRSTPAGECHECK
    FIRSTPAGECHECK -->|Yes - On First Page| FIRSTPAGEMSG
    FIRSTPAGEMSG --> BUILDSCREEN
    FIRSTPAGECHECK -->|No - Not First Page| READBACK
    READBACK --> TRTYPE_BWD
    TRTYPE_BWD -.->|Backward Cursor
Fetch up to 7 rows in reverse| BUILDSCREEN
    PF7 -->|No| INPUTERROR
    INPUTERROR -->|Yes - Errors Exist| DISPLAYERROR
    DISPLAYERROR --> BUILDSCREEN
    INPUTERROR -->|No Errors| ENTERDELETE
    ENTERDELETE -->|Yes - Enter + Delete| DELETECONFIRM
    DELETECONFIRM --> BUILDSCREEN
    ENTERDELETE -->|No| PF10DELETE
    PF10DELETE -->|Yes - PF10 + Delete| DELETEEXEC
    DELETEEXEC --> TRTYPE_DEL
    TRTYPE_DEL -.->|DELETE WHERE TR_TYPE = key| DELETESUCCESS
    DELETESUCCESS -->|Yes - Deleted| DELETEOK
    DELETEOK --> BUILDSCREEN
    DELETESUCCESS -->|No - Child Records| DELETECHILD
    DELETECHILD --> BUILDSCREEN
    PF10DELETE -->|No| ENTERUPDATE
    ENTERUPDATE -->|Yes - Enter + Update| UPDATECONFIRM
    UPDATECONFIRM --> BUILDSCREEN
    ENTERUPDATE -->|No| PF10UPDATE
    PF10UPDATE -->|Yes - PF10 + Update| NOCHANGE
    NOCHANGE -->|No Changes| NOCHANGEMSG
    NOCHANGEMSG --> BUILDSCREEN
    NOCHANGE -->|Changes Detected| UPDATEEXEC
    UPDATEEXEC --> TRTYPE_UPD
    TRTYPE_UPD -.->|UPDATE SET TR_DESCRIPTION
WHERE TR_TYPE = key| UPDATESUCCESS
    UPDATESUCCESS -->|Yes - Updated| UPDATEOK
    UPDATEOK --> BUILDSCREEN
    UPDATESUCCESS -->|No - Failed| BUILDSCREEN
    PF10UPDATE -->|No - Default| READFORWARD
    BUILDSCREEN --> SETUPATTRIBS
    SETUPATTRIBS --> FILTERDISP
    FILTERDISP --> INFOMSG
    INFOMSG --> CENTERMSG
    CENTERMSG --> ERRMSG
    ERRMSG --> SENDSCREEN
    SENDSCREEN --> SAVESTATE
    SAVESTATE --> RETURN

rules.rule_name: Program Working Storage Initialization
rules.rule_description: On every program entry, all working storage areas, miscellaneous storage, and the communication area are reset to their default values before any processing begins.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1: Program Initialization
Initialize working storage,
communication areas, set defaults

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Maintenance program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: All working storage areas (CC-WORK-AREA, WS-MISC-STORAGE, WS-COMMAREA) are initialized to their default values, the return message flag is set to OFF, and the program is ready to process user input

rules.rule_name: Session Context Setup
rules.rule_description: The program records its own identity (transaction ID, program name, map name, mapset name) into the session context so that navigation and return routing are correctly established.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2: Session Context Setup
Store transaction ID, program name,
map name, mapset name

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has completed initialization
acceptance_criteria.When: Session context is being established
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) is stored in WS-TRANID, the program name (LIT-THISPGM) is stored in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, the map name (LIT-THISMAP) is stored in CDEMO-LAST-MAP, and the mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET) is stored in CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET

rules.rule_name: First-Time Entry Detection and Initialization
rules.rule_description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time (no prior session exists), the program initializes all session data fresh, sets the user type to Admin, and positions the display at the first page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3: First-Time Entry?
EIBCALEN = 0?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Maintenance program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: No prior session communication area exists (first-time entry)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The CARDDEMO communication area and program-specific communication area are initialized, the calling transaction ID is set to the current transaction, the calling program is set to the current program, the user type is set to Admin, the program state is set to Enter, the last map and mapset are set to the current map and mapset, the display is positioned at the first page, and the last-page-not-shown flag is set

rules.rule_name: Existing Session Data Restoration
rules.rule_description: When a user returns to the Transaction Type Maintenance screen after a prior interaction, the program restores all previously saved session state including filters, paging position, and selections from the communication area.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Load existing session data
from communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Maintenance program is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: A prior session communication area exists (returning user)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The CARDDEMO communication area is restored from DFHCOMMAREA for the length of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is restored from DFHCOMMAREA starting after the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA length

rules.rule_name: Reset List Screen on Return from Add Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user returns from the Add Transaction Type screen using PF3, or when entering from a different program, the list screen is reset to a fresh first-page state, clearing all prior filters and selections.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4: Return from Add Screen?
PF3 from Add/Update program?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The program detects entry from a different program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM not equal to LIT-THISPGM and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is true) OR PF3 is pressed while the calling transaction is the Add Transaction program (LIT-ADDTTRANID)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is initialized, the program state is set to Enter, the key is set to ENTER, the last map and mapset are set to the current map and mapset, the display is positioned at the first page, and the last-page-not-shown flag is set

rules.rule_name: Screen Input Reception for Transaction Type List
rules.rule_description: The program receives all user-entered data from the Transaction Type List screen, capturing the type code filter, description filter, and for each displayed row: the selection action code, the transaction type code, and the transaction description.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5: Screen Input Reception
Receive Transaction Type List screen
Capture type code filter, description filter,
row selections, codes, descriptions

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The program receives the screen map (CTRTLIAI from LIT-THISMAP / LIT-THISMAPSET)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The type code filter value is captured from TRTYPEI into WS-IN-TYPE-CD, the description filter value is captured from TRDESCI into WS-IN-TYPE-DESC, and for each row (1 through WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES): the selection flag is captured from TRTSELI(I) into WS-EDIT-SELECT(I), the transaction type code is captured from TRTTYPI(I) into WS-ROW-TR-CODE-IN(I), and the description is captured from TRTYPDI(I) into WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I) — if TRTYPDI(I) is an asterisk or spaces the description is set to LOW-VALUES, otherwise the trimmed value is stored

rules.rule_name: Row Selection Action Code Validation
rules.rule_description: The program validates the action code entered in each row's selection field, counting the number of delete and update requests, and flagging any invalid action codes entered by the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6: Row Selection Validation
Validate action codes U/D
Count deletes and updates requested

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction Type List screen with row selections
acceptance_criteria.When: The type code filter and description filter have NOT changed (if either filter changed, all selections are cleared and validation is skipped)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program counts: total actions requested (WS-ACTIONS-REQUESTED = WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES minus blank/low-value selections), delete actions (WS-DELETES-REQUESTED = count of LIT-DELETE-FLAG values), and update actions (WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED = count of LIT-UPDATE-FLAG values); for each row, if the selection is a valid action code (D or U) it is accepted, if blank it is ignored, and if any other value is entered the row is flagged with a selection error and INPUT-ERROR is set with message 'Invalid action code'

rules.rule_name: Multiple Row Actions Prevention
rules.rule_description: Only one action (delete or update) may be selected across all displayed rows at a time. If the user selects actions on more than one row simultaneously, an error is raised.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7: Multiple Actions
Selected?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction Type List screen with row selections
acceptance_criteria.When: The total number of valid actions selected (WS-VALID-ACTIONS-SELECTED = WS-DELETES-REQUESTED + WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED) is greater than 1 (WS-MORETHAN1ACTION is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: INPUT-ERROR is set to true, each row with a valid selection is flagged with a selection error indicator (WS-ROW-TRTSELECT-ERROR = '1'), FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-YES is set, and the error message WS-MESG-MORE-THAN-1-ACTION is set

rules.rule_name: Row Description Change Detection for Update
rules.rule_description: When an update action is selected on a row, the program compares the newly entered description against the original stored description to determine whether any actual change has been made.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8: Row Description Change Detection
Compare entered description
against stored description

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has selected the Update (U) action on a row and the row is the only valid action selected with no bad selections
acceptance_criteria.When: The program evaluates the entered description for that row
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the trimmed, upper-cased entered description (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I)) equals the trimmed, upper-cased stored description (WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(I)) AND their trimmed lengths are equal, then NO-CHANGES-FOUND is set and WS-MESG-NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is set and description validation is skipped; otherwise CHANGES-HAVE-OCCURRED is set and description validation proceeds

rules.rule_name: Row Description Alphanumeric Validation for Update
rules.rule_description: When a user requests an update on a transaction type row, the new description entered must be non-blank and contain only alphanumeric characters.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9: Row Description Validation
Validate alphanumeric, not blank
for update requests

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a new description for a transaction type row and changes have been detected
acceptance_criteria.When: The description field (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I), up to 50 characters) is validated with field name 'Transaction Desc'
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the description is blank, empty, or all low-values, INPUT-ERROR is set and the message '[field name] must be supplied.' is generated; if the description contains non-alphanumeric characters (characters other than letters and numbers), INPUT-ERROR is set and the message '[field name] can have numbers or alphabets only.' is generated; if the description passes both checks, FLG-ALPHNANUM-ISVALID is set; the validation result flags are stored in WS-ARRAY-DESCRIPTION-FLGS and FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-NOT-OK is initially set before validation

rules.rule_name: Type Code Filter Numeric Validation
rules.rule_description: The type code filter field, if supplied, must be a 2-digit numeric value. Blank or zero values are treated as no filter being applied.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10: Type Code Filter Validation
Validate 2-digit numeric
or treat as blank/no-filter

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in the type code filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The type code filter (WS-IN-TYPE-CD) is validated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If WS-IN-TYPE-CD is LOW-VALUES, SPACES, or ZEROS, FLG-TYPEFILTER-BLANK is set and WS-TYPE-CD-FILTER is set to ZEROES (no filter applied); if WS-IN-TYPE-CD is not numeric, INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK is set, FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES is set, and the message 'TYPE CODE FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER' is set in WS-RETURN-MSG; if WS-IN-TYPE-CD is numeric, WS-TYPE-CD-FILTER is set to WS-IN-TYPE-CD and FLG-TYPEFILTER-ISVALID is set

rules.rule_name: Type Code Filter Change Detection and Page Reset
rules.rule_description: When the type code filter value changes from the previously used value, the paging variables are reset so the display starts from the beginning of the filtered result set.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11: Type Code Filter
Changed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The type code filter has been validated
acceptance_criteria.When: The current type code filter value (WS-IN-TYPE-CD) is compared to the previously stored value (WS-CA-TYPE-CD)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If WS-IN-TYPE-CD equals WS-CA-TYPE-CD, OR if the filter is blank AND WS-CA-TYPE-CD is ZEROES/LOW-VALUES/SPACES, then FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is set (no reset needed); otherwise WS-CA-PAGING-VARIABLES are initialized, WS-IN-TYPE-CD is stored into WS-CA-TYPE-CD, and FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-YES is set

rules.rule_name: Description Filter Wildcard Wrapping
rules.rule_description: When a description filter value is provided, the program automatically wraps it with wildcard characters to enable a contains-style partial match search against transaction type descriptions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12: Description Filter Validation
Treat as blank or wrap with
wildcard % for LIKE search

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in the description filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The description filter (WS-IN-TYPE-DESC) is processed
acceptance_criteria.Then: If WS-IN-TYPE-DESC is LOW-VALUES or SPACES, FLG-DESCFILTER-BLANK is set (no filter applied); if a value is provided, FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID is set and WS-TYPE-DESC-FILTER is constructed by concatenating '%' + TRIM(WS-IN-TYPE-DESC) + '%' so that the database search uses a LIKE pattern matching any description containing the entered text

rules.rule_name: Description Filter Change Detection and Page Reset
rules.rule_description: When the description filter value changes from the previously used value, the paging variables are reset so the display starts from the beginning of the filtered result set.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13: Description Filter
Changed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The description filter has been processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The current description filter value (WS-IN-TYPE-DESC) is compared to the previously stored value (WS-CA-TYPE-DESC)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If WS-IN-TYPE-DESC equals WS-CA-TYPE-DESC, OR if the filter is blank AND WS-CA-TYPE-DESC is LOW-VALUES/SPACES, then FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is set (no reset needed); otherwise WS-CA-PAGING-VARIABLES are initialized, WS-IN-TYPE-DESC is stored into WS-CA-TYPE-DESC, and FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-YES is set

rules.rule_name: Filter Cross-Validation Against Database
rules.rule_description: When at least one filter (type code or description) is active, the program verifies that at least one matching transaction type record exists in the database before allowing the user to proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
14: Filter Cross-Validation
Check if matching records exist
for given filter conditions

acceptance_criteria.Given: At least one filter is active (FLG-TYPEFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: A COUNT query is executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE with the active filter conditions: type code filter applies exact match on TR_TYPE when WS-EDIT-TYPE-FLAG = '1', and description filter applies LIKE match on TR_DESCRIPTION using TRIM(WS-TYPE-DESC-FILTER) when WS-EDIT-DESC-FLAG = '1'
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the count (WS-RECORDS-COUNT) is zero, INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK is set if the type filter was active, FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK is set if the description filter was active, FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES is set, and the message 'No Records found for these filter conditions' is set in WS-RETURN-MSG; if records are found, processing continues normally

rules.rule_name: Function Key Validation and Invalid Key Handling
rules.rule_description: Only specific function keys are valid in the Transaction Type Maintenance screen. Invalid key presses are silently converted to ENTER key behavior to prevent unintended actions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
15: PF Key Validation
Which key was pressed?
Is it valid in current context?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed a function key on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The pressed key is evaluated against the list of valid keys
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the key is ENTER, PF2, PF3, PF7, PF8, or PF10 (where PF10 is only valid when a delete or update has been requested), PFK-VALID is set; if the key is PF10 without a pending delete or update, it is not considered valid; if the key is any other key, PFK-INVALID is set and the key is treated as ENTER (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE)

rules.rule_name: Function Key Aliasing PF13-PF24 to PF1-PF12
rules.rule_description: The program maps the upper function keys (PF13 through PF24) to their equivalent lower function keys (PF1 through PF12) so that users on keyboards with only upper function keys receive the same behavior.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
39: Function Key Aliasing
Map PF13-PF24 to PF1-PF12
Store pressed key

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses a function key on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The EIBAID value is evaluated in YYYY-STORE-PFKEY
acceptance_criteria.Then: ENTER maps to CCARD-AID-ENTER, CLEAR maps to CCARD-AID-CLEAR, PA1 maps to CCARD-AID-PA1, PA2 maps to CCARD-AID-PA2, PF1/PF13 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK01, PF2/PF14 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK02, PF3/PF15 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK03, PF4/PF16 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK04, PF5/PF17 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK05, PF6/PF18 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK06, PF7/PF19 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK07, PF8/PF20 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK08, PF9/PF21 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK09, PF10/PF22 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK10, PF11/PF23 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK11, PF12/PF24 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK12

rules.rule_name: Exit to Main Administration Menu
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 to exit the Transaction Type Maintenance screen, control is transferred to the appropriate calling program or the administration menu if no specific caller is identified.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
16: Exit to Main Menu
Transfer control to
administration menu program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: PF3 is pressed
acceptance_criteria.Then: If CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is LOW-VALUES, SPACES, or the current transaction ID, the destination transaction is set to LIT-ADMINTRANID; otherwise CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is used as the destination transaction; if CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is LOW-VALUES, SPACES, or the current program name, the destination program is set to LIT-ADMINPGM; otherwise CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is used as the destination program; the current transaction and program are recorded as the source, user type is set to Admin, program state is set to Enter, a SYNCPOINT (commit) is issued, and control is transferred via XCTL to the destination program passing CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

rules.rule_name: Navigate to Add Transaction Type Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF2, control is transferred to the Add Transaction Type program to allow creation of a new transaction type record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
17: Navigate to Add Transaction Type Screen
Transfer to Add/Update program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and PF2 is pressed while the current program is this program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM)
acceptance_criteria.When: PF2 is pressed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current transaction ID is set as the source transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID = LIT-THISTRANID), the current program is set as the source program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = LIT-THISPGM), user type is set to regular user (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER), program state is set to Enter, the current mapset and map are recorded, the destination program is set to LIT-ADDTPGM, the next mapset is set to LIT-ADDTMAPSET, the next map is set to LIT-ADDTMAP, WS-EXIT-MESSAGE is set to TRUE, and control is transferred via XCTL to LIT-ADDTPGM passing CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

rules.rule_name: Forward Paging - Read Next Page of Transaction Types
rules.rule_description: When the user scrolls forward, the program reads the next page of transaction type records from the database starting from the last key of the current page, filling up to the maximum number of screen rows.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
18: Forward Paging
Read next page of records
from last key, increment page number
up to 7 records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 to scroll forward and a next page exists, OR the program needs to display a forward page of records
acceptance_criteria.When: The forward cursor (C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD) is opened and records are fetched from CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE where TR_TYPE >= WS-START-KEY, applying type code filter (exact match on TR_TYPE when WS-EDIT-TYPE-FLAG = '1') and description filter (LIKE match on TR_DESCRIPTION when WS-EDIT-DESC-FLAG = '1'), ordered by TR_TYPE ascending
acceptance_criteria.Then: All current row output data (WS-CA-ALL-ROWS-OUT) is cleared; records are fetched one by one up to WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES rows; each fetched record's TR_TYPE is stored in WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT(row) and TR_DESCRIPTION-TEXT in WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(row); the first record's TR_TYPE is stored as WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE and if page number is 0 it is incremented to 1; when the maximum rows are filled, one additional fetch is attempted: if successful CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is set and the additional record's TR_TYPE becomes WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE, if no more records CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is set; if PF8 was pressed and no more records WS-MESG-NO-MORE-RECORDS is set; the page number is incremented by 1 when navigating forward via PF8

rules.rule_name: Backward Paging - Read Previous Page of Transaction Types
rules.rule_description: When the user scrolls backward, the program reads the previous page of transaction type records from the database in descending order, filling the screen rows from bottom to top to reconstruct the previous page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
19: Backward Paging
Read previous page backwards
from first key, decrement page
fill up to 7 rows in reverse

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to scroll backward and the display is not on the first page
acceptance_criteria.When: The backward cursor (C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD) is opened and records are fetched from CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE where TR_TYPE < WS-START-KEY (WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE), applying the same type code and description filters, ordered by TR_TYPE DESCENDING
acceptance_criteria.Then: All current row output data (WS-CA-ALL-ROWS-OUT) is cleared; WS-ROW-NUMBER is initialized to WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES; records are fetched one by one and placed from the bottom row upward (WS-ROW-NUMBER decrements by 1 after each fetch); each record's TR_TYPE is stored in WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT(WS-ROW-NUMBER) and TR_DESCRIPTION-TEXT in WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(WS-ROW-NUMBER); when WS-ROW-NUMBER reaches 0, the last fetched TR_TYPE is stored as WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE and the read loop exits; the page number is decremented by 1; all row selection flags are cleared after reading

rules.rule_name: First Page Boundary Check on Backward Navigation
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to scroll backward while already on the first page, the program prevents navigation and informs the user that no previous pages are available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
20: Already on
First Page?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to scroll backward
acceptance_criteria.When: The current page is the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The display remains on the first page, WS-START-KEY is set to WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, the forward read (8000-READ-FORWARD) is performed to re-display the current first page, and the message 'No previous pages to display' is set in WS-RETURN-MSG

rules.rule_name: Delete Confirmation Request Display
rules.rule_description: When the user selects a delete action on a row and presses ENTER, the program displays a confirmation screen highlighting the selected row and prompting the user to press PF10 to confirm the deletion.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
21: Delete Confirmation Request
Highlight selected row
Prompt user to press PF10 to confirm

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered 'D' in a row's selection field and pressed ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: ENTER is pressed, WS-DELETES-REQUESTED is greater than 0, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM
acceptance_criteria.Then: WS-START-KEY is set to WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, a forward read is performed if both type and description filters are valid (not FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK and not FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK), CA-DELETE-REQUESTED state is maintained, the selected row is highlighted in neutral color with the type code and description displayed, and the screen is sent to the user prompting confirmation via PF10; the informational message WS-INFORM-DELETE is set if no other info message exists and filters are unchanged

rules.rule_name: Delete Record Execution
rules.rule_description: When the user confirms a delete action by pressing PF10, the program permanently removes the selected transaction type record from the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
22: Delete Record Execution
Delete selected transaction type
from database by type code

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has previously selected a delete action on a row and pressed PF10 to confirm, with no changes to filters or row selection since the delete was requested
acceptance_criteria.When: PF10 is pressed, WS-DELETES-REQUESTED is greater than 0, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM
acceptance_criteria.Then: The TR_TYPE value from the selected row (WS-ROW-TR-CODE-IN(I-SELECTED)) is moved to DCL-TR-TYPE, and a DELETE statement is executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = DCL-TR-TYPE

rules.rule_name: Delete Success Handling and Session Reset
rules.rule_description: When a transaction type record is successfully deleted, the change is committed, a success message is displayed, and the session is reset to show the first page of the updated list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
23: Delete Success Handling
Display success message
Reset session, return to first page

acceptance_criteria.Given: A DELETE operation has been executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
acceptance_criteria.When: The delete completes successfully (SQLCODE = 0)
acceptance_criteria.Then: A CICS SYNCPOINT is issued to commit the deletion, CA-DELETE-SUCCEEDED is set to TRUE, WS-INFORM-DELETE-SUCCESS is set if no other info message exists, FLG-DELETED-YES is set, the screen is sent showing the success message, and then CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, and WS-MISC-STORAGE are initialized, CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is set to TRUE, CA-FIRST-PAGE is set to TRUE, and CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN is set to TRUE to return to the first page

rules.rule_name: Delete Failure Due to Child Records
rules.rule_description: A transaction type cannot be deleted if other records in the system reference it as a foreign key. The user must first remove all associated child records before the transaction type can be deleted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
24: Delete Failure - Child Records
Inform user to delete
associated child records first

acceptance_criteria.Given: A DELETE operation has been executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
acceptance_criteria.When: The delete fails because child records exist that reference this transaction type (referential integrity violation, SQLCODE = -532)
acceptance_criteria.Then: CA-DELETE-REQUESTED is set to TRUE (delete not completed), the error message 'Please delete associated child records first:' is set as WS-DB2-CURRENT-ACTION, the DB2 error details are formatted and stored in WS-RETURN-MSG, and the screen is redisplayed showing the error message

rules.rule_name: Update Confirmation Request Display
rules.rule_description: When the user selects an update action on a row and presses ENTER, the program displays a confirmation screen with the description field editable and prompts the user to press PF10 to save the changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
25: Update Confirmation Request
Highlight selected row
Prompt user to press PF10 to save

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered 'U' in a row's selection field and pressed ENTER
acceptance_criteria.When: ENTER is pressed, WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED is greater than 0, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM
acceptance_criteria.Then: WS-START-KEY is set to WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, a forward read is performed if both type and description filters are valid (not FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK and not FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK), CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED state is maintained, the selected row's description field is made editable (DFHBMFSE attribute), the type code field is displayed in neutral color (read-only), and the screen is sent to the user prompting confirmation via PF10; the informational message WS-INFORM-UPDATE is set if no other info message exists and filters are unchanged

rules.rule_name: Update Record Execution
rules.rule_description: When the user confirms an update action by pressing PF10, the program updates the description of the selected transaction type record in the database. Only the description field can be changed; the type code is immutable.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
26: Update Record Execution
Update description of selected
transaction type in database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has previously selected an update action on a row, entered a new description, and pressed PF10 to confirm, with no changes to filters or row selection since the update was requested
acceptance_criteria.When: PF10 is pressed, WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED is greater than 0, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM
acceptance_criteria.Then: The TR_TYPE from the selected row (WS-ROW-TR-CODE-IN(I-SELECTED)) is moved to DCL-TR-TYPE, the trimmed new description (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I-SELECTED)) is moved to DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-TEXT, the description length is computed as the length of WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I-SELECTED) and stored in DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN, and an UPDATE statement is executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE SET TR_DESCRIPTION = DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION WHERE TR_TYPE = DCL-TR-TYPE

rules.rule_name: Update Success Handling
rules.rule_description: When a transaction type description is successfully updated, the change is committed, a success message is displayed, and the list is refreshed to show the updated data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
27: Update Success Handling
Display success message
Refresh list with updated data

acceptance_criteria.Given: An UPDATE operation has been executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
acceptance_criteria.When: The update completes successfully (SQLCODE = 0)
acceptance_criteria.Then: A CICS SYNCPOINT is issued to commit the update, CA-UPDATE-SUCCEEDED is set to TRUE, WS-INFORM-UPDATE-SUCCESS is set if no other info message exists, FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is set to TRUE, WS-START-KEY is set to WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, a forward read (8000-READ-FORWARD) is performed to refresh the list, and the screen is sent showing the updated data with the success message

rules.rule_name: No Changes Detected on Update
rules.rule_description: When the user confirms an update but the entered description is identical to the existing description, the program informs the user that no changes were detected and does not perform a database update.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
28: No Changes
Detected?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF10 to confirm an update on a selected row
acceptance_criteria.When: The trimmed, upper-cased entered description equals the trimmed, upper-cased stored description AND their trimmed lengths are equal (NO-CHANGES-FOUND is true / WS-MESG-NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is set)
acceptance_criteria.Then: No database UPDATE is executed, WS-MESG-NO-CHANGES-DETECTED message is displayed to the user, and the screen is refreshed showing the current data without modification

rules.rule_name: PF10 with Changed Criteria Treated as Enter
rules.rule_description: PF10 is only valid as a confirmation key when the filter criteria and row selection are unchanged since the action was requested. If any criteria have changed, PF10 is treated as ENTER to prevent confirming an action against unintended data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
29: F10 with Changed
Criteria?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF10 with a pending delete or update action
acceptance_criteria.When: PF10 is pressed AND any of the following conditions are true: the type code filter has changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-YES), OR the description filter has changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-YES), OR the row selection has changed (FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-YES)
acceptance_criteria.Then: PF10 is treated as ENTER (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE) and the confirmation action is not executed; the screen is redisplayed in its current state

rules.rule_name: Transaction Type List Screen Build
rules.rule_description: The program builds the Transaction Type List display screen, populating it with up to the maximum number of transaction type records, along with the current page number, date, time, program name, and transaction ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
30: Transaction Type List Display
Build screen with up to 7 records
page number, date, time, action fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: Transaction type records have been read from the database and the screen is ready to be built
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen initialization (2100-SCREEN-INIT) and array population (2300-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT) are performed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen output area (CTRTLIAO) is initialized to LOW-VALUES; the current date is formatted as MM/DD/YY and placed in CURDATEO; the current time is formatted as HH:MM:SS and placed in CURTIMEO; the current page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is placed in PAGENOO; the program title lines (CCDA-TITLE01, CCDA-TITLE02) are placed in TITLE01O and TITLE02O; the transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) is placed in TRNNAMEO; the program name (LIT-THISPGM) is placed in PGMNAMEO; for each row with data (WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT not LOW-VALUES): the transaction type code (WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT(I)) is placed in TRTTYPO(I), the description (WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(I)) is placed in TRTYPDO(I), and the selection flag (WS-EDIT-SELECT(I)) is placed in TRTSELO(I)

rules.rule_name: Screen Attribute Setup Based on Action State
rules.rule_description: The program sets the visual attributes (colors, field protection, cursor position) of each screen row based on the current action state, ensuring users can only interact with appropriate fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
31: Screen Attribute Setup
Set colors, protection, cursor
based on current action state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: Screen attributes are set up (2200-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS) for each row (from WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES down to 1)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction type code column (TRTYPDA) is always set to protected (DFHBMPRF — read-only); if a row has no data (WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT = LOW-VALUES) OR FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES is set, the selection field (TRTSELA) is set to protected (DFHBMPRO); if a row has a selection error (WS-ROW-TRTSELECT-ERROR = '1'), the selection field color is set to RED (DFHRED) and cursor length is set to -1; if DELETE is selected on a row with only one valid action and no bad selections, the type code color (TRTTYPC) and description color (TRTYPDC) are set to neutral (DFHNEUTR) and cursor length is set to -1; if UPDATE is selected on a row with only one valid action and no bad selections: the type code color is set to neutral, if update is completed the description color is neutral and cursor length -1, if update not yet completed the description length is set to -1 and attribute to editable (DFHBMFSE) and if description validation failed the description color is set to RED; otherwise the selection field attribute is set to editable (DFHBMFSE)

rules.rule_name: Search Filter Display with Color Coding
rules.rule_description: The type code and description filter fields are displayed with appropriate values and color coding to reflect their current state (active, invalid, or normal).
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
32: Search Filter Display
Display type code and description
filter values with appropriate colors

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display and it is not the first entry or entry from the admin program
acceptance_criteria.When: Screen attributes for filter fields are set up (2400-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS)
acceptance_criteria.Then: For the type code filter: if actions are requested, WS-IN-TYPE-CD is displayed in TRTYPEO with skip attribute (DFHBMASF) and blue color (DFHBLUE); if type filter is valid or invalid, WS-IN-TYPE-CD is displayed with editable attribute (DFHBMFSE); if WS-IN-TYPE-CD is zero, LOW-VALUES is displayed; otherwise LOW-VALUES is displayed with editable attribute; if FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK, the type filter color is set to RED (DFHRED) and cursor length to -1; for the description filter: if actions are requested, WS-IN-TYPE-DESC is displayed in TRDESCO with skip attribute and blue color; if description filter is valid or invalid, WS-IN-TYPE-DESC is displayed with editable attribute; otherwise editable attribute is set; if FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK, the description filter color is set to RED and cursor length to -1; if INPUT-OK and no actions requested and not PF7/PF8, cursor length for type filter is set to -1

rules.rule_name: Context-Sensitive Informational Message Display
rules.rule_description: The program displays context-sensitive informational messages to guide the user through the current state of the screen, such as prompting for confirmation, indicating success, or advising on available actions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
33: Informational Message Display
Display context-sensitive messages
to guide user actions

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The informational message is determined (2500-SETUP-MESSAGE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message is selected based on the following priority: if FLG-DELETED-YES, WS-INFORM-DELETE-SUCCESS is set; else if FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED, WS-INFORM-UPDATE-SUCCESS is set; else if FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK or FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK, no info message change; else if ENTER pressed with exactly one delete requested and one valid action and filters unchanged, WS-INFORM-DELETE is set (prompting PF10 confirmation); else if ENTER pressed with exactly one update requested and one valid action and filters unchanged, WS-INFORM-UPDATE is set (prompting PF10 confirmation); else if PF7 on first page, message is 'No previous pages to display'; else if PF8 and no next page and last page already shown, message is 'No more pages to display'; else if PF8 and no next page (first time at last page), WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set and CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set; else if no info message or next page exists, WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set; the WS-RETURN-MSG is placed in ERRMSGO; the WS-INFO-MSG is centered and placed in INFOMSGO with neutral color (DFHNEUTR) if not WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE and not WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND

rules.rule_name: Validation Error Message Display
rules.rule_description: When input validation errors exist, the program displays the error message on the screen and re-displays the current page data so the user can correct their input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
34: Error Message Display
Show validation error messages
on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: Input validation has been performed and errors were found (INPUT-ERROR is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display after validation errors
acceptance_criteria.Then: WS-RETURN-MSG is moved to CCARD-ERROR-MSG, the current program, mapset, and map are set as the source and next destination, WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE is set as WS-START-KEY, a forward read (8000-READ-FORWARD) is performed if both FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK is false and FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK is false, the screen is sent with the error message displayed in ERRMSGO, and control returns to wait for the next user interaction

rules.rule_name: Next Page Existence Check
rules.rule_description: Before scrolling forward, the program checks whether additional records exist beyond the current page to determine if forward navigation is possible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 35: Next Page Exists?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 to scroll forward
acceptance_criteria.When: The next page existence flag is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is true, WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE is set as WS-START-KEY, WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is incremented by 1, the forward read (8000-READ-FORWARD) is performed, all row selection flags (WS-EDIT-SELECT-FLAGS) are cleared, and the screen is displayed with the next page; if CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is true (last page already reached), the 'No more pages to display' message path is followed

rules.rule_name: No Records Found on First Page Notification
rules.rule_description: When no transaction type records are found on the first page (either due to an empty table or filter conditions returning no results), the user is informed that no records exist for the current search conditions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
36: No Records Found
on First Page?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A forward read has been performed
acceptance_criteria.When: The forward cursor returns no records (SQLCODE = +100) AND the current screen number is 1 AND WS-ROW-NUMBER is 0
acceptance_criteria.Then: WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND is set to TRUE, CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is set, and the screen is displayed with the no-records message; the informational message area (INFOMSGO) is not updated with the info message when WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND is true

rules.rule_name: Last Page Tracking and No More Pages Message
rules.rule_description: The program tracks whether the last page has been shown to the user and displays an appropriate message when the user attempts to scroll beyond the last page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
37: Last Page Tracking
No more pages to display

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and no next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The last page status is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is already true (user previously reached the last page), the message 'No more pages to display' is set in WS-RETURN-MSG; if CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN is true (first time reaching the last page), WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set as the informational message and CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set to TRUE; any key press other than PF8 resets CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN to TRUE

rules.rule_name: Session State Persistence to Communication Area
rules.rule_description: Before returning control to CICS, the program saves all current session state (paging keys, screen data, selected row, flags, filter values) to the communication area so it can be restored on the next user interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
38: Session State Persistence
Save paging keys, screen data,
selected row, flags, filter values
to communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has completed all processing and is ready to return to CICS
acceptance_criteria.When: The COMMON-RETURN section is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: LIT-THISTRANID is moved to CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, LIT-THISPGM is moved to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, LIT-THISMAPSET is moved to CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET, LIT-THISMAP is moved to CDEMO-LAST-MAP, CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is moved to WS-COMMAREA, WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA is moved into WS-COMMAREA starting at position (LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + 1) for LENGTH OF WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, and CICS RETURN is issued with TRANSID = LIT-THISTRANID, COMMAREA = WS-COMMAREA, LENGTH = LENGTH OF WS-COMMAREA

rules.rule_name: Informational Message Centering on Screen
rules.rule_description: Informational messages displayed on the screen are centered within the message display area by calculating the trimmed message length and computing the appropriate starting position.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
40: Informational Message Centering
Calculate trimmed message length
Center message on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: An informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) has been determined for display
acceptance_criteria.When: The message is being prepared for placement in the screen output field (INFOMSGO)
acceptance_criteria.Then: WS-STRING-LEN is computed as the length of the trimmed WS-INFO-MSG; WS-STRING-MID is computed as (LENGTH(WS-INFO-MSG) - WS-STRING-LEN) / 2 + 1 to find the centering start position; the trimmed message text WS-INFO-MSG(1:WS-STRING-LEN) is placed into WS-STRING-OUT starting at position WS-STRING-MID for length WS-STRING-LEN; if the message is not WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE and not WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND, WS-STRING-OUT is moved to INFOMSGO and the color is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR)

key_functionalities.title: Program Initialization
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Program Invoked]) --> B[Initialize Working Storage Areas
and Communication Areas]
    B --> C{Is this a Brand
New Session?
No prior session data}
    C -->|Yes - New Session| D[Initialize Common Communication Area
and Program-Specific Communication Area]
    D --> E[Set Current Transaction ID
and Program Name as the Source]
    E --> F[Set User Type to Administrator]
    F --> G[Mark Program Status as
First-Time Entry]
    G --> H[Record Current Screen Name
and Screen Set Name]
    H --> I[Set Paging to Start
from First Page]
    I --> J[Mark Last Page
as Not Yet Shown]
    C -->|No - Existing Session| K[Carry Forward Common
Session Data from
Previous Interaction]
    K --> L[Carry Forward Program-Specific
Session Data from
Previous Interaction]
    J --> M([Initialization Complete
Proceed to Session Processing])
    L --> M

rules.rule_name: Initialize Working Storage and Communication Areas at Program Start
rules.rule_description: At the very start of every program invocation, all working storage areas, communication areas, and message flags are reset to their default empty state before any session logic is applied. This ensures no residual data from prior executions contaminates the current run.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize Working Storage Areas and Communication Areas

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Maintenance program has been invoked by any user action
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen work area (CC-WORK-AREA), miscellaneous storage (WS-MISC-STORAGE), and the outbound communication area (WS-COMMAREA) are all initialized to their default empty values; the current transaction identifier is recorded in WS-TRANID; and the return message flag is set to OFF so no prior message is carried forward

rules.rule_name: Detect Whether the Session is Brand New or a Continuation
rules.rule_description: The program must determine whether the current invocation is the very first entry (no prior session data exists) or a continuation of an existing session. This decision drives whether session state is freshly initialized or restored from the previous interaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this a Brand New Session? No prior session data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has completed its initial working storage reset
acceptance_criteria.When: The program evaluates the length of the communication area passed from the previous interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the communication area length is zero, the session is treated as brand new and all session data is freshly initialized; if the communication area length is greater than zero, the session is treated as a continuation and prior session data is restored

rules.rule_name: Initialize Common and Program-Specific Communication Areas for a New Session
rules.rule_description: When a brand new session is detected, both the shared common communication area (used across all CardDemo programs) and the program-specific communication area (used only by this Transaction Type Maintenance program) must be fully initialized to their default empty values before any defaults are applied.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize Common Communication Area and Program-Specific Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has determined this is a brand new session with no prior session data
acceptance_criteria.When: The new session initialization begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: The common CardDemo communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is initialized to its default empty state, and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is also initialized to its default empty state

rules.rule_name: Record Current Transaction and Program Identity as the Session Source
rules.rule_description: For a new session, the system must record the identity of the current transaction and program as the originating source within the communication area. This establishes the audit trail and enables correct return navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Current Transaction ID and Program Name as the Source

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand new session has been initialized with empty communication areas
acceptance_criteria.When: The session source identity is being established
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current transaction identifier (LIT-THISTRANID) is stored in the communication area field CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, and the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is stored in the communication area field CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM

rules.rule_name: Assign Administrator User Type for New Session
rules.rule_description: When a brand new session is started, the user type must be defaulted to Administrator. This establishes the access level and determines which functions and data are available to the user during the session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set User Type to Administrator

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized for the Transaction Type Maintenance program
acceptance_criteria.When: The default user type is being assigned
acceptance_criteria.Then: The user type indicator in the communication area (CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN) is set to TRUE, designating the session as an Administrator-level session

rules.rule_name: Mark Program Status as First-Time Entry
rules.rule_description: For a new session, the program status must be flagged as a first-time entry. This flag controls downstream processing logic, ensuring the program behaves correctly for an initial entry rather than a re-entry from a user action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Program Status as First-Time Entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized
acceptance_criteria.When: The program entry status is being set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program entry status flag in the communication area (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) is set to TRUE, indicating this is a first-time entry into the program

rules.rule_name: Record the Current Screen and Screen Set as the Active Display Context
rules.rule_description: For a new session, the system must record the name of the current screen and its associated screen set (mapset) in the communication area. This information is used for navigation, return routing, and screen redisplay logic.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record Current Screen Name and Screen Set Name

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized
acceptance_criteria.When: The active screen context is being recorded
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current screen name (LIT-THISMAP) is stored in the communication area field CDEMO-LAST-MAP, and the current screen set name (LIT-THISMAPSET) is stored in the communication area field CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET

rules.rule_name: Set Paging Position to Start from the First Page
rules.rule_description: For a new session, the paging position must be initialized to the first page of transaction type records. This ensures the user always begins viewing data from the beginning of the list when first entering the program.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Paging to Start from First Page

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized for the Transaction Type Maintenance program
acceptance_criteria.When: The initial paging position is being established
acceptance_criteria.Then: The paging indicator (CA-FIRST-PAGE) is set to TRUE, directing the program to display records starting from the very first transaction type in the database

rules.rule_name: Mark the Last Page of Results as Not Yet Displayed
rules.rule_description: For a new session, the system must record that the last page of transaction type records has not yet been shown to the user. This flag controls the display of end-of-list messages and prevents premature 'no more records' notifications.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Last Page as Not Yet Shown

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized and paging has been set to start from the first page
acceptance_criteria.When: The last-page display status is being initialized
acceptance_criteria.Then: The last-page-shown indicator (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN) is set to TRUE, recording that the last page of transaction type records has not yet been presented to the user

rules.rule_name: Restore Common Session Data from Previous Interaction
rules.rule_description: When the session is a continuation (not brand new), the shared common session data from the previous user interaction must be restored. This preserves cross-program context such as user identity, navigation history, and shared state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Carry Forward Common Session Data from Previous Interaction

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has determined this is a continuation of an existing session with prior session data available
acceptance_criteria.When: The common session data is being restored
acceptance_criteria.Then: The common CardDemo communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is populated by extracting the first portion of the passed communication area (DFHCOMMAREA), sized exactly to the length of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, restoring all shared session context from the previous interaction

rules.rule_name: Restore Program-Specific Session Data from Previous Interaction
rules.rule_description: When the session is a continuation, the program-specific session data (filters, paging state, row selections, and other Transaction Type Maintenance-specific context) from the previous user interaction must also be restored alongside the common session data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Carry Forward Program-Specific Session Data from Previous Interaction

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has determined this is a continuation of an existing session and the common session data has already been restored
acceptance_criteria.When: The program-specific session data is being restored
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is populated by extracting the second portion of the passed communication area (DFHCOMMAREA), starting immediately after the common communication area and sized exactly to the length of WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, restoring all Transaction Type Maintenance-specific session context including filters, paging position, and row selections from the previous interaction

key_functionalities.title: Session Context Setup
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Session Context Setup Begin])
    B{Is this a\nNew Session?}
    C[Set Current Transaction ID\nas the originating transaction]

    F[Set Current Mapset Name\nas the last used mapset]

    H[Carry forward Transaction ID,\nProgram Name, Map Name,\nMapset Name from prior session]

    O([Session Context Setup Complete])

    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> I

    I --> J

    N --> O

rules.rule_name: Initialize Originating Transaction ID for New Session
rules.rule_description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the very first time (no prior session exists), the system must record the current transaction identifier as the originating transaction to establish session traceability.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Current Transaction ID as the originating transaction

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time with no existing session communication area (session length equals zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that this is a brand-new session with no prior interaction data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the originating transaction identifier in the session context to the current Transaction Type Maintenance transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID), so that subsequent interactions can identify where the session originated

rules.rule_name: Initialize Originating Program Name for New Session
rules.rule_description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the very first time, the system must record the current program name as the originating program to support navigation and return routing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Current Program Name as the originating program

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time with no existing session communication area (session length equals zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that this is a brand-new session with no prior interaction data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the originating program name in the session context to the current Transaction Type Maintenance program name (LIT-THISPGM), enabling the system to identify which program initiated the session

rules.rule_name: Initialize Last Used Map Name for New Session
rules.rule_description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the very first time, the system must record the current screen map name as the last used map to support screen redisplay and navigation continuity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Current Map Name as the last used map

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time with no existing session communication area (session length equals zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that this is a brand-new session with no prior interaction data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the last used map name in the session context to the current Transaction Type Maintenance map name (LIT-THISMAP), so the system knows which screen was last displayed

rules.rule_name: Initialize Last Used Mapset Name for New Session
rules.rule_description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the very first time, the system must record the current screen mapset name as the last used mapset to support screen group identification and navigation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Current Mapset Name as the last used mapset

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time with no existing session communication area (session length equals zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that this is a brand-new session with no prior interaction data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the last used mapset name in the session context to the current Transaction Type Maintenance mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET), so the system knows which screen group was last active

rules.rule_name: Restore Session Data from Prior Interaction for Returning User
rules.rule_description: When a user returns to the Transaction Type Maintenance screen after a prior interaction, the system must restore all previously saved session data from the communication area passed between interactions, so that the user's context (filters, page position, selections) is preserved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Load existing session data from previous interaction communication area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user returns to the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and a prior session communication area exists (session length is greater than zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that this is a returning user with existing session data in the communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system restores the general session communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) from the first portion of the passed communication area (DFHCOMMAREA), and restores the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) from the subsequent portion of the passed communication area, making all prior session state available for the current interaction

rules.rule_name: Carry Forward Transaction ID, Program Name, Map Name, and Mapset Name from Prior Session
rules.rule_description: When session data is restored from a prior interaction, the transaction ID, program name, map name, and mapset name carried in the communication area are made available to the current processing cycle, ensuring continuity of session identification across interactions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Carry forward Transaction ID, Program Name, Map Name, Mapset Name from prior session

acceptance_criteria.Given: A returning user's session data has been successfully loaded from the prior interaction communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The session context fields (originating transaction ID, originating program name, last map name, last mapset name) are extracted from the restored communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: All four session context fields — originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), last used map name (CDEMO-LAST-MAP), and last used mapset name (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) — are available in working storage for use during the current processing cycle

rules.rule_name: Store Current Transaction ID to Session Context After Processing
rules.rule_description: After all business processing is complete, the system must update the session context with the current transaction ID before returning control, so that the next interaction knows which transaction was last active.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: After processing completes: Store current Transaction ID to session context

acceptance_criteria.Given: All business processing for the current interaction has completed and the system is preparing to return control
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the common return routine (COMMON-RETURN) to finalize the session and pass control back
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the current Transaction Type Maintenance transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) into the originating transaction ID field (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) of the session context, overwriting any prior value

rules.rule_name: Store Current Program Name to Session Context After Processing
rules.rule_description: After all business processing is complete, the system must update the session context with the current program name before returning control, so that the next interaction knows which program was last active.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Store current Program Name to session context

acceptance_criteria.Given: All business processing for the current interaction has completed and the system is preparing to return control
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the common return routine (COMMON-RETURN) to finalize the session and pass control back
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the current Transaction Type Maintenance program name (LIT-THISPGM) into the originating program name field (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) of the session context, overwriting any prior value

rules.rule_name: Store Current Map Name to Session Context After Processing
rules.rule_description: After all business processing is complete, the system must update the session context with the current map name before returning control, so that the next interaction knows which screen map was last displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Store current Map Name to session context

acceptance_criteria.Given: All business processing for the current interaction has completed and the system is preparing to return control
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the common return routine (COMMON-RETURN) to finalize the session and pass control back
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the current Transaction Type Maintenance map name (LIT-THISMAP) into the last used map name field (CDEMO-LAST-MAP) of the session context, overwriting any prior value

rules.rule_name: Store Current Mapset Name to Session Context After Processing
rules.rule_description: After all business processing is complete, the system must update the session context with the current mapset name before returning control, so that the next interaction knows which screen group was last active.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Store current Mapset Name to session context

acceptance_criteria.Given: All business processing for the current interaction has completed and the system is preparing to return control
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the common return routine (COMMON-RETURN) to finalize the session and pass control back
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the current Transaction Type Maintenance mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET) into the last used mapset name field (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) of the session context, overwriting any prior value

rules.rule_name: Pack Session Context into Communication Area for Next Screen Interaction
rules.rule_description: After all session context fields have been updated, the system must combine the general session communication area and the program-specific communication area into a single communication area and pass it to the next interaction, ensuring complete session state continuity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Pack session context into communication area for next screen interaction

acceptance_criteria.Given: All session context fields (transaction ID, program name, map name, mapset name) have been updated in the session context after processing
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to return control to the transaction manager for the next user interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the general session communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) into the first portion of the outgoing communication area (WS-COMMAREA), copies the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) into the immediately following portion of WS-COMMAREA, and issues a return to the same Transaction Type Maintenance transaction (LIT-THISTRANID) passing the fully packed WS-COMMAREA with its total length, so that all session state is available in the next interaction
