rules.rule_name: Detect First-Time Program Entry
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the current execution is a brand-new session (no prior communication area exists) or a returning user session, and routes initialization accordingly.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this the First-Time Entry? No Communication Area Present?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether a communication area was passed from a previous execution (session length equals zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If no communication area is present, the system treats this as a brand-new session and proceeds to initialize all session data; if a communication area is present, the system treats this as a returning user session and loads the existing session data

rules.rule_name: Initialize General Communication Area for New Session
rules.rule_description: On first-time entry, the general communication area shared across all CardDemo programs is initialized to clear any residual data before the session begins.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize General Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected with no prior communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initializes the session for the first time
acceptance_criteria.Then: The general CardDemo communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is fully initialized to its default empty state, clearing all shared session fields including transaction ID, program name, user type, and program state

rules.rule_name: Initialize Program-Specific Communication Area for New Session
rules.rule_description: On first-time entry, the program-specific communication area that holds Transaction Type screen state (filters, paging keys, row data) is initialized to clear any residual data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize Program-Specific Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected and the general communication area has been initialized
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initializes the program-specific session data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is fully initialized to its default empty state, clearing all paging variables, filter values, row selection data, and screen state flags

rules.rule_name: Set Originating Transaction and Program Identity on New Session
rules.rule_description: On first-time entry, the system records the current transaction ID and program name as the originating source in the communication area so that navigation history is established from the start.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize General Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected and communication areas have been initialized
acceptance_criteria.When: The system establishes the session identity
acceptance_criteria.Then: The originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) is set to the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) and the originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) is set to the current program name (LIT-THISPGM)

rules.rule_name: Assign Administrator User Type on New Session
rules.rule_description: When the Transaction Type maintenance screen is accessed for the first time in a session, the user type is automatically set to Administrator, as this is an administrative maintenance function.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set User Type to Administrator

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets up the initial user context
acceptance_criteria.Then: The user type indicator (CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN) is set to TRUE, designating the session as an Administrator-level session

rules.rule_name: Set Program State to First Entry on New Session
rules.rule_description: On first-time entry, the program state is set to indicate that the program is being entered for the first time, which controls how the screen is rendered and which actions are available.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Program State to First Entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system establishes the initial program state
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program entry state flag (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) is set to TRUE, indicating this is a fresh entry into the program rather than a re-entry from a user action

rules.rule_name: Set Current Screen to Transaction Type List Screen on New Session
rules.rule_description: On first-time entry, the system records the Transaction Type list screen and its mapset as the current active screen in the session context, establishing the navigation baseline.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Current Screen to Transaction Type List Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected and program state has been set to first entry
acceptance_criteria.When: The system establishes the initial screen context
acceptance_criteria.Then: The last active map name (CDEMO-LAST-MAP) is set to the Transaction Type list screen map name (LIT-THISMAP) and the last active mapset (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) is set to the Transaction Type list mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET)

rules.rule_name: Set Paging to First Page on New Session
rules.rule_description: On first-time entry, the paging state is initialized so that the display begins from the very first page of transaction type records, ensuring the user always starts at the beginning of the list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Paging to First Page

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initializes the paging state
acceptance_criteria.Then: The first-page indicator (CA-FIRST-PAGE) is set to TRUE, signaling that the current display position is at the beginning of the transaction type list

rules.rule_name: Mark Last Page as Not Yet Shown on New Session
rules.rule_description: On first-time entry, the last-page-shown indicator is set to 'not yet shown' so that the system correctly tracks whether the user has reached the end of the transaction type list during this session.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Last Page as Not Yet Shown

acceptance_criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected and paging has been set to the first page
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initializes the last-page tracking state
acceptance_criteria.Then: The last-page-shown indicator (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN) is set to TRUE, indicating that the final page of transaction type records has not yet been displayed to the user in this session

rules.rule_name: Load Existing Session Data for Returning User
rules.rule_description: When a returning user re-enters the Transaction Type maintenance screen, the system restores all previously saved session state — including filters, paging position, and screen context — from the communication area passed by the previous execution.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Load Existing Session Data from Communication Area into Working Storage

acceptance_criteria.Given: A returning user session is detected with a communication area present from a prior execution
acceptance_criteria.When: The system loads the existing session context
acceptance_criteria.Then: The general CardDemo communication area is restored by copying the first portion of the passed communication area (DFHCOMMAREA) into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA for the length of that structure, AND the program-specific communication area is restored by copying the subsequent portion of DFHCOMMAREA into WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA starting at the offset immediately after the general communication area, for the length of the program-specific structure — thereby fully restoring all prior session state including filters, paging keys, row selections, and screen flags

rules.rule_name: Detect PF3 Return from Add/Update Transaction Type Screen
rules.rule_description: When the user presses PF3 (Back/Exit) from the Add or Update Transaction Type screen, the system must detect this specific navigation event by checking that PF3 was pressed and that the originating transaction is the Add Transaction Type transaction. If both conditions are true, the list screen is reset to a fresh state. If only PF3 is pressed from a different context, normal navigation continues.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was PF3 pressed from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type List screen is active and the user has navigated from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen (the originating transaction ID matches the Add Transaction Type transaction identifier)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF3 (Back/Exit key) while the originating transaction ID is equal to the Add Transaction Type transaction ID
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies this as a return from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen and proceeds to reset the list screen to a fresh state; if PF3 is pressed from any other context or the originating transaction is not the Add Transaction Type transaction, the system continues with the current session state without resetting

rules.rule_name: Clear All Saved List Screen Session Data on Return from Add/Update Screen
rules.rule_description: When a return from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen is detected, all previously saved session data for the Transaction Type List screen — including filter values, paging positions, row selections, and any pending actions — must be cleared so the user starts with a completely clean list screen state.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear all saved list screen session data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has detected that the user pressed PF3 from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The reset process is triggered for the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: All saved list screen session data is cleared, including: any active type code filter, any active description filter, all paging variables (current page number, first and last transaction codes on page), all row selections and pending action flags, and any previously selected row information

rules.rule_name: Set Screen Navigation State to Fresh Entry on Return from Add/Update Screen
rules.rule_description: After clearing saved session data, the system must set the navigation state flags so that the Transaction Type List screen behaves exactly as if the user is entering it for the first time. This ensures the screen initializes correctly and does not attempt to process any prior user input or pending actions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set screen navigation to treat as fresh entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: The saved list screen session data has been cleared following a PF3 return from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The navigation state is being reset
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program entry state is set to indicate a fresh program entry (not a re-entry), the key action is set to ENTER (as if the user pressed Enter for the first time), and the current map and mapset are recorded as this program's own map and mapset

rules.rule_name: Reset Page Position to First Page on Return from Add/Update Screen
rules.rule_description: When returning from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen, the list display position must be reset to the very first page of transaction types, regardless of which page the user was viewing before navigating to the Add/Update screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set current position to First Page

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen navigation state has been set to fresh entry following a PF3 return from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The page position is being reset
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current page position is set to the first page, meaning the Transaction Type List will be displayed starting from the beginning of the transaction type records (ordered by transaction type code ascending)

rules.rule_name: Mark Last Page as Not Yet Shown on Return from Add/Update Screen
rules.rule_description: When returning from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen and resetting to the first page, the system must also reset the indicator that tracks whether the last page of results has been displayed to the user. This ensures that end-of-list messaging and paging behavior are correct for the fresh display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark that Last Page has not yet been shown

acceptance_criteria.Given: The page position has been reset to the first page following a PF3 return from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The last-page tracking indicator is being reset
acceptance_criteria.Then: The last-page-shown indicator is set to 'not yet shown', meaning the system will not display 'No more pages to display' prematurely and will correctly evaluate whether the end of the transaction type list has been reached as the user pages forward through the refreshed results

key_functionalities.title: Screen Input Reception
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Start: Receive Screen Input])
    RECEIVE[Receive Transaction Type List Screen\nCapture all user-entered data]
    TYPECODE[Capture Type Code Filter\nStore entered type code filter value]
    DESCINPUT[Capture Description Filter\nStore entered description filter value]
    LOOPSTART[Begin processing each row\nLoop through all 7 display rows]
    ROWSEL[Capture Row Selection Flag\nStore action code entered by user\nfor this row - U, D, or blank]
    ROWTYPECODE[Capture Transaction Type Code\nStore the type code displayed\non this row]
    CHECKDESC{Row Description\nEntered by User?\nNot asterisk and not blank?}
    CAPTUREDESC[Capture Row Description\nTrim and store the description\nentered by user for this row]
    SKIPDESC[Skip Row Description\nSet description to empty\nfor this row]
    MOREROWS{More Rows\nto Process?}
    END([End: All Screen Input Captured\nProceed to Input Validation])

    START --> RECEIVE
    RECEIVE --> TYPECODE
    TYPECODE --> DESCINPUT
    DESCINPUT --> LOOPSTART
    LOOPSTART --> ROWSEL
    ROWSEL --> ROWTYPECODE
    ROWTYPECODE --> CHECKDESC
    CHECKDESC -->|Yes - Description Entered| CAPTUREDESC
    CHECKDESC -->|No - Blank or Asterisk| SKIPDESC
    CAPTUREDESC --> MOREROWS
    SKIPDESC --> MOREROWS
    MOREROWS -->|Yes - Next Row| ROWSEL
    MOREROWS -->|No - All Rows Done| END

rules.rule_name: Receive Transaction Type List Screen Input
rules.rule_description: When the user submits the Transaction Type List screen, the system must receive and capture all data entered by the user from the screen into working storage for subsequent validation and processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Receive Transaction Type List Screen
Capture all user-entered data

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction Type List screen by pressing a key (Enter, PF key, etc.)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system receives the screen input from the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: All user-entered data from the Transaction Type List screen is captured into working storage, including the type code filter field, description filter field, all row selection flags, all row transaction type codes, and all row descriptions, making them available for subsequent input validation

rules.rule_name: Capture Type Code Filter Value from Screen
rules.rule_description: After receiving the screen, the system captures the value entered by the user in the Type Code filter field and stores it in working storage for subsequent validation and filtering of transaction type records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture Type Code Filter
Store entered type code filter value

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type List screen has been received successfully
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the Type Code filter field from the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The value entered by the user in the Type Code filter field (TRTYPEI) is stored in the working storage variable WS-IN-TYPE-CD, preserving exactly what the user typed including blanks or zeros if the field was left empty

rules.rule_name: Capture Description Filter Value from Screen
rules.rule_description: After receiving the screen, the system captures the value entered by the user in the Description filter field and stores it in working storage for subsequent validation and partial-match filtering of transaction type records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture Description Filter
Store entered description filter value

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type List screen has been received successfully
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the Description filter field from the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The value entered by the user in the Description filter field (TRDESCI) is stored in the working storage variable WS-IN-TYPE-DESC, preserving exactly what the user typed including blanks if the field was left empty

rules.rule_name: Iterate Through All Display Rows to Capture Row-Level Input
rules.rule_description: The system must process every row displayed on the Transaction Type List screen to capture any user-entered selections or description changes. All rows are processed regardless of whether they contain data, ensuring no user input is missed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Begin processing each row
Loop through all 7 display rows

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type List screen has been received and the type code and description filter values have been captured
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins processing row-level input
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system iterates through every row from row 1 to the maximum number of display rows (WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES, which is 7), processing each row's selection flag, transaction type code, and description in sequence before moving to the next row

rules.rule_name: Capture Row Action Selection Flag
rules.rule_description: For each displayed row, the system captures the action code entered by the user in the row's selection field. This action code indicates the user's intended operation for that row — Update (U), Delete (D), or no action (blank).
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture Row Selection Flag
Store action code entered by user
for this row - U, D, or blank

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing a specific row during the row iteration loop
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the selection field for the current row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The value from the row's selection field on screen (TRTSELI for the current row index I) is stored in the working storage array WS-EDIT-SELECT at position I, capturing whatever the user entered — U for update, D for delete, or blank for no action

rules.rule_name: Capture Transaction Type Code for Each Row
rules.rule_description: For each displayed row, the system captures the transaction type code shown on that row. This code is read-only on the screen and identifies which transaction type record the user is acting upon.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture Transaction Type Code
Store the type code displayed
on this row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing a specific row during the row iteration loop and has captured the row's selection flag
acceptance_criteria.When: The system reads the transaction type code field for the current row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction type code value from the screen field TRTTYPI at position I is stored in the working storage array WS-ROW-TR-CODE-IN at position I, identifying the transaction type record associated with this row

rules.rule_name: Initialize Row Description to Empty Before Conditional Capture
rules.rule_description: Before evaluating whether a user has entered a description for a row, the system pre-initializes the row description storage to empty. This ensures that if the description is subsequently skipped, the stored value is clean and does not carry over stale data from a previous execution.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture Row Description
Trim and store the description
entered by user for this row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing a specific row during the row iteration loop and has captured the row's selection flag and transaction type code
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to evaluate the row description field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The working storage array WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN at position I is set to LOW-VALUES (empty) before any conditional check on the description field content, ensuring a clean default state regardless of what the description field contains

rules.rule_name: Skip Row Description When Field Contains Asterisk or Is Blank
rules.rule_description: If the description field for a row contains an asterisk (*) or is blank/spaces, the system treats the description as not entered by the user and retains the empty value. An asterisk is used as a system placeholder to indicate a blank or unchanged description, and spaces indicate the user left the field empty.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Skip Row Description
Set description to empty
for this row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing the description field for a specific row during the row iteration loop
acceptance_criteria.When: The row description field (TRTYPDI at position I) contains either an asterisk character (LIT-ASTERISK) or spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system skips capturing the description for this row — the working storage array WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN at position I retains the LOW-VALUES (empty) value that was set during initialization, and no description value is stored for this row

rules.rule_name: Capture and Trim Row Description When User Has Entered a Value
rules.rule_description: If the user has entered an actual description value in a row's description field (not an asterisk and not blank), the system captures it by trimming leading and trailing spaces before storing it. This ensures clean description data is available for subsequent update validation and comparison against the existing stored description.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Capture Row Description
Trim and store the description
entered by user for this row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing the description field for a specific row during the row iteration loop
acceptance_criteria.When: The row description field (TRTYPDI at position I) contains a value that is neither an asterisk (LIT-ASTERISK) nor spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system applies the TRIM function to remove leading and trailing spaces from the description value in TRTYPDI at position I, and stores the trimmed result in the working storage array WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN at position I, making the cleaned description available for update validation

key_functionalities.title: Row Selection Validation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Start: Row Selection Validation])
    FILTERCHANGED{Type Code or Description\nFilter Changed?}
    CLEARSELECTIONS[Clear all row selections\nSkip row validation]
    INITCOUNTERS[Initialize Counters:\nTotal Actions = 0\nDeletes Requested = 0\nUpdates Requested = 0\nValid Actions = 0]
    COUNTACTIONS[Scan all row selection fields:\nCount blank/empty rows\nCount D - Delete selections\nCount U - Update selections\nCalculate total actions requested]
    LOOPROWS[Loop through each row\nfrom last to first]
    CHECKROW{Row Selection\nValue?}
    VALIDACTION[Valid action found\nRecord row number as selected]
    MORETHAN1{More than one\naction already found?}
    FLAGMULTI[Flag this row with error\nMark multiple actions error]
    UPDATECHECK{Is this row\nrequesting Update U?}
    DESCVALIDATION[Proceed to validate\nrow description content]
    BLANKROW[Row is blank\nNo action - skip row]
    INVALIDENTRY[Invalid action code entered\nFlag row with error in red\nSet overall input error\nSet invalid action code message]
    NEXTROW[Move to next row]
    MOREROWS{More rows\nto check?}
    ROWCHANGED{Selected row number\nchanged from previous?}
    SAVESELECTED[Save new selected\nrow number]
    MULTICHECK{More than one\ntotal action requested?}
    MULTIERROR[Set overall input error\nSet message: only one\naction allowed at a time]
    END([End: Row Validation Complete\nCounts and error flags set])

    START --> FILTERCHANGED
    FILTERCHANGED -->|Yes - Filter Changed| CLEARSELECTIONS
    CLEARSELECTIONS --> END
    FILTERCHANGED -->|No - Same Filter| INITCOUNTERS
    INITCOUNTERS --> COUNTACTIONS
    COUNTACTIONS --> LOOPROWS
    LOOPROWS --> CHECKROW
    CHECKROW -->|Valid D or U| VALIDACTION
    CHECKROW -->|Blank or Empty| BLANKROW
    CHECKROW -->|Any Other Value| INVALIDENTRY
    VALIDACTION --> MORETHAN1
    MORETHAN1 -->|Yes - Multiple Actions| FLAGMULTI
    MORETHAN1 -->|No - First Valid Action| UPDATECHECK
    FLAGMULTI --> NEXTROW
    UPDATECHECK -->|Yes - Update U| DESCVALIDATION
    UPDATECHECK -->|No - Delete D| NEXTROW
    DESCVALIDATION --> NEXTROW
    BLANKROW --> NEXTROW
    INVALIDENTRY --> NEXTROW
    NEXTROW --> MOREROWS
    MOREROWS -->|Yes| LOOPROWS
    MOREROWS -->|No - All Rows Checked| ROWCHANGED
    ROWCHANGED -->|Yes - Row Changed| SAVESELECTED
    ROWCHANGED -->|No - Same Row| MULTICHECK
    SAVESELECTED --> MULTICHECK
    MULTICHECK -->|Yes - More Than 1 Action| MULTIERROR
    MULTICHECK -->|No - Single Action| END
    MULTIERROR --> END

rules.rule_name: Clear Row Selections When Filter Changes
rules.rule_description: When either the Transaction Type Code filter or the Description filter has been changed by the user, all previously entered row action selections must be cleared and row-level validation must be skipped entirely to prevent stale selections from being processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Type Code or Description Filter Changed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and has previously made row action selections (Delete or Update flags on rows)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user changes the Transaction Type Code filter value OR changes the Description filter value from their previous submitted values
acceptance_criteria.Then: All row selection flags across all screen rows are cleared (reset to empty/spaces), no row-level action validation is performed, and the program proceeds directly to the end of row validation with zero counts for all action types

rules.rule_name: Initialize Row Action Counters Before Validation
rules.rule_description: Before scanning and validating row action selections, all action counters must be reset to zero to ensure accurate counting of the current screen submission's requested actions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize Counters: Total Actions = 0, Deletes Requested = 0, Updates Requested = 0, Valid Actions = 0

acceptance_criteria.Given: The filter values have not changed from the previous submission and row validation is about to begin
acceptance_criteria.When: Row selection validation is initiated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following counters are all set to zero: Total Actions Requested, No-Action rows count, Deletes Requested count, Updates Requested count, and Valid Actions Selected count

rules.rule_name: Count Delete and Update Selections Across All Rows
rules.rule_description: The system scans all row selection fields simultaneously to tally the number of blank/empty rows, Delete requests, and Update requests, then calculates the total number of actions requested and the total number of valid actions selected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Scan all row selection fields: Count blank/empty rows, Count D - Delete selections, Count U - Update selections, Calculate total actions requested

acceptance_criteria.Given: All row action counters have been initialized to zero and the filter has not changed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system scans all row selection fields across the entire screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system counts: (1) the number of rows with no action (blank or empty), (2) the number of rows with a Delete action flag, (3) the number of rows with an Update action flag; then calculates Total Actions Requested as (Maximum Screen Lines minus No-Action rows count), and Valid Actions Selected as (Deletes Requested plus Updates Requested)

rules.rule_name: Validate Each Row Action Selection Code
rules.rule_description: Each row on the screen is examined individually (from the last row to the first row) to determine whether the action selection field contains a valid action code (Delete or Update), is blank (no action), or contains an invalid value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Row Selection Value?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is iterating through each screen row from the last row to the first row
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the action selection field value for the current row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The row is classified into one of three categories: (1) Valid action — the selection contains a recognized Delete or Update action code; (2) Blank/Empty — the selection field is blank or empty, meaning no action is requested for this row; (3) Invalid — the selection contains any value other than a valid Delete or Update code or blank

rules.rule_name: Record the Row Number of the Selected Action
rules.rule_description: When a valid action (Delete or Update) is found on a row, the row number is recorded as the currently selected row for subsequent processing of the action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Valid action found - Record row number as selected

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is iterating through screen rows and has found a row with a valid Delete or Update action code
acceptance_criteria.When: A valid action code is identified on a row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The row number (position on screen) is saved as the selected row number (I-SELECTED) for use in subsequent delete or update operations

rules.rule_name: Enforce Single Action Selection Rule - Flag Multiple Selections
rules.rule_description: Only one row action (Delete or Update) is permitted per screen submission. If a valid action is found on a row but another valid action has already been found on a previous row during the same loop iteration, the current row is flagged as an error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: More than one action already found?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has already found and recorded a valid action on a previous row during the current loop iteration
acceptance_criteria.When: Another row is found with a valid Delete or Update action code
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current row's selection field is flagged with an error indicator (highlighted in red), and the overall multiple-actions error flag is set to indicate that more than one action has been selected

rules.rule_name: Trigger Description Validation for Update Action
rules.rule_description: When a row has a valid Update action selected and it is the first (only) valid action found so far, the description field for that row must be validated to ensure the new description value is acceptable before the update can proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this row requesting Update U?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A row has a valid Update action code selected and it is the only valid action found so far (no multiple-action error condition)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system identifies the action on the row as an Update request
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to validate the description content for that row (description validation sub-process is invoked), checking that the description is not blank and contains only alphanumeric characters

rules.rule_name: Skip Validation for Blank Row Selections
rules.rule_description: Rows where the action selection field is blank or empty represent no user intent and require no validation or processing; they are simply skipped.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Row is blank - No action - skip row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is evaluating a row's action selection field during the row validation loop
acceptance_criteria.When: The row's action selection field is blank or empty (no action code entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The row is skipped with no error flagging, no counter increments for this row, and processing continues to the next row

rules.rule_name: Flag Invalid Action Code Entry
rules.rule_description: If a user enters any value in a row's selection field that is not a recognized action code (not Delete, not Update, and not blank), the entry is invalid and must be flagged as an error with appropriate messaging.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Invalid action code entered - Flag row with error in red - Set overall input error - Set invalid action code message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is evaluating a row's action selection field during the row validation loop
acceptance_criteria.When: The row's action selection field contains any value other than a valid Delete code, a valid Update code, or blank/empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following error conditions are set: (1) the row's selection field is flagged with an error indicator (to be displayed in red on screen), (2) the overall bad-actions-selected flag is set to Yes, (3) the overall input error flag is set, and (4) the error message is set to indicate an invalid action code was entered

rules.rule_name: Detect Change in Selected Row Between Submissions
rules.rule_description: After completing the row loop, the system compares the currently selected row number with the row number that was selected in the previous screen submission to detect whether the user has changed their row selection.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Selected row number changed from previous?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The row validation loop has completed and a selected row number has been identified (or remains at zero if no row was selected)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system compares the current selected row number against the previously stored selected row number from the communication area
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the selected row number is the same as the previously stored value, the row-selection-changed flag is set to No (unchanged); if the selected row number is different from the previously stored value, the row-selection-changed flag is set to Yes (changed) and the new selected row number is saved to the communication area for use in subsequent PF10 confirmation validation

rules.rule_name: Enforce Single Action Rule - Set Final Error for Multiple Actions
rules.rule_description: After all rows have been evaluated, if the total count of actions requested across all rows exceeds one, a final overall input error is set with a message instructing the user that only one action is permitted at a time.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: More than one total action requested?

acceptance_criteria.Given: All screen rows have been evaluated and the total actions requested count has been determined
acceptance_criteria.When: The total number of action selections (Delete plus Update) across all rows is greater than one
acceptance_criteria.Then: The overall input error flag is set to indicate an error condition, and the error message is set to communicate that only one action is allowed at a time per screen submission

sub_functionalities.title: Proceed to validate row description content
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Update Action Requested\non a Row])
    COMPARE{Compare Entered Description\nvs Stored Description\nCase-insensitive, trimmed match?}
    NOCHANGE[Set Message:\nNo Changes Detected\nNo update needed]
    EXIT_NOCHANGE([Exit - No Action Required])
    SETCHANGED[Mark: Changes Have Occurred\nProceed to Validate Description Content]
    BLANKCHECK{Is Entered Description\nBlank or Empty?}
    BLANKERROR[Set Error Flag:\nDescription is Blank\nSet Message:\nTransaction Desc must be supplied]
    SETINPUTERROR1[Mark Input as Invalid]
    ALPHANUMCHECK{Does Description Contain\nOnly Alphanumeric Characters?\nNo special characters allowed}
    ALPHANUMERROR[Set Error Flag:\nDescription has Invalid Characters\nSet Message:\nTransaction Desc can have\nnumbers or alphabets only]
    SETINPUTERROR2[Mark Input as Invalid]
    VALID[Set Flag:\nDescription is Valid\nAlphanumeric check passed]
    EXIT_VALID([Exit - Description Validated\nReady for Update Confirmation])

    START --> COMPARE
    COMPARE -->|Descriptions Match\nNo Changes| NOCHANGE
    NOCHANGE --> EXIT_NOCHANGE
    COMPARE -->|Descriptions Differ\nChanges Detected| SETCHANGED
    SETCHANGED --> BLANKCHECK
    BLANKCHECK -->|Yes - Blank or Empty| BLANKERROR
    BLANKERROR --> SETINPUTERROR1
    SETINPUTERROR1 --> EXIT_VALID
    BLANKCHECK -->|No - Has Content| ALPHANUMCHECK
    ALPHANUMCHECK -->|No - Invalid Characters Found| ALPHANUMERROR
    ALPHANUMERROR --> SETINPUTERROR2
    SETINPUTERROR2 --> EXIT_VALID
    ALPHANUMCHECK -->|Yes - All Characters Valid| VALID
    VALID --> EXIT_VALID

rules.rule_name: Detect No Changes in Transaction Description for Update
rules.rule_description: When a user selects the Update action on a transaction type row, the system compares the entered description against the currently stored description using a case-insensitive, trimmed comparison. If both the content and length match exactly after trimming and uppercasing, the system determines no changes have been made and skips the update without raising an error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Compare Entered Description vs Stored Description Case-insensitive, trimmed match?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action on a transaction type row and has entered a description in the description field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered description, after trimming leading and trailing spaces and converting to uppercase, is equal to the stored description after the same transformation, AND the trimmed length of the entered description equals the trimmed length of the stored description
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'No Changes Detected', does not mark the input as invalid, does not set any error message, and exits the description validation without proceeding to further content checks

rules.rule_name: Mark Description as Changed When Differences Are Detected
rules.rule_description: When the entered transaction description differs from the stored description (either in content or trimmed length after case-insensitive comparison), the system marks that changes have occurred and proceeds to validate the content of the new description.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Descriptions Differ Changes Detected → Mark: Changes Have Occurred Proceed to Validate Description Content

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action on a transaction type row and has entered a description in the description field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered description does NOT match the stored description after trimming and case-insensitive comparison, OR the trimmed lengths differ
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the 'Changes Have Occurred' flag to TRUE and proceeds to validate the entered description for blank content and alphanumeric character constraints

rules.rule_name: Reject Blank or Empty Transaction Description on Update
rules.rule_description: When a user attempts to update a transaction type description and the entered description is blank, empty, or contains only spaces or low-values, the system rejects the input, marks it as invalid, and displays a mandatory field error message. The field label used in the message is 'Transaction Desc'.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Entered Description Blank or Empty? → Set Error Flag: Description is Blank / Set Message: Transaction Desc must be supplied

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action on a transaction type row, changes have been detected in the description field, and the system is validating the entered description content
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered description value (up to 50 characters) is equal to low-values, OR equal to spaces, OR the trimmed length of the entered description is zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid (Input Error), sets the description blank error flag, and sets the error message to 'Transaction Desc must be supplied.' — no further alphanumeric validation is performed for this row

rules.rule_name: Reject Transaction Description Containing Non-Alphanumeric Characters
rules.rule_description: When a user enters a non-blank transaction description for an update, the system validates that the description contains only letters and numbers. Special characters are not permitted. If any non-alphanumeric characters are found, the input is rejected with a specific error message. The field label used in the message is 'Transaction Desc'.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does Description Contain Only Alphanumeric Characters? No special characters allowed → Set Error Flag: Description has Invalid Characters / Set Message: Transaction Desc can have numbers or alphabets only

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action on a transaction type row, changes have been detected, the entered description is not blank, and the system is performing alphanumeric character validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered description (up to 50 characters) contains one or more characters that are not letters (A-Z, a-z) or digits (0-9) — i.e., special characters, punctuation, or symbols are present — determined by converting all valid alphanumeric characters to spaces and checking if any non-space content remains
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid (Input Error), sets the alphanumeric invalid character error flag, and sets the error message to 'Transaction Desc can have numbers or alphabets only.'

rules.rule_name: Accept Valid Alphanumeric Transaction Description for Update
rules.rule_description: When the entered transaction description is non-blank and contains only alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers), the system marks the description as valid and ready for update confirmation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Yes - All Characters Valid → Set Flag: Description is Valid Alphanumeric check passed

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action on a transaction type row, changes have been detected in the description, the entered description is not blank, and the system has completed the alphanumeric character check
acceptance_criteria.When: All characters in the entered description (up to 50 characters) are letters or digits with no special characters present
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the description validation flag to 'Valid' (alphanumeric check passed), does not set any error message, and exits the validation — the description is ready for update confirmation

rules.rule_name: Prepare and Invoke Description Content Validation for Update Row
rules.rule_description: When changes are detected in the transaction description for an update action, the system prepares the validation context by setting the field name to 'Transaction Desc', loading the entered description, setting the maximum allowed length to 50 characters, and invoking the alphanumeric required field validation routine. After validation, the resulting validation flags are stored against the specific row being updated.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark: Changes Have Occurred Proceed to Validate Description Content

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action on a transaction type row and changes have been detected in the entered description compared to the stored description
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to validate the description content by setting the field label to 'Transaction Desc', copying the entered description into the validation work area, setting the maximum validation length to 50 characters, and calling the alphanumeric required field validation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The alphanumeric required field validation is executed against the entered description with a maximum length of 50 characters, and the resulting validation status flags (blank, invalid characters, or valid) are stored back against the specific row's description flags in the screen array

key_functionalities.title: Multiple Action Prevention
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Start: Row Selection Check])
    COUNT[Count all row selections\nfrom the screen:\n- Total actions requested\n- Delete actions\n- Update actions\n- Valid actions = Deletes + Updates]
    LOOP[Examine each selected row\none by one]
    SELECTED{Is this row\nselected for action?}
    MORETHAN1{More than one\nrow already selected?}
    MARKERROR1[Flag this row with\nselection error indicator]
    CHECKUPDATE{Is this row\nselected for Update?}
    VALDESC[Proceed to validate\ndescription for update]
    NEXTROW[Move to next row]
    ALLROWS{All rows\nexamined?}
    MORETHAN1FINAL{Was more than\none action selected\nin total?}
    SETERROR[Set Error Condition:\nOnly one action allowed\nat a time]
    HIGHLIGHTROWS[Highlight all rows with\nerrors in red on screen\nto show invalid selections]
    SHOWMSG[Display Error Message:\nUser must select only\none action at a time]
    PROCEEDONE[Proceed with the\nsingle valid action\nselected by user]
    END([End: Multiple Action Check Complete])

    START --> COUNT
    COUNT --> LOOP
    LOOP --> SELECTED
    SELECTED -->|Yes - U or D entered| MORETHAN1
    SELECTED -->|No - Row is blank| NEXTROW
    MORETHAN1 -->|Yes - Already have one| MARKERROR1
    MARKERROR1 --> NEXTROW
    MORETHAN1 -->|No - First selection| CHECKUPDATE
    CHECKUPDATE -->|Yes - Update requested| VALDESC
    VALDESC --> NEXTROW
    CHECKUPDATE -->|No - Delete requested| NEXTROW
    NEXTROW --> ALLROWS
    ALLROWS -->|No - More rows| LOOP
    ALLROWS -->|Yes - All rows done| MORETHAN1FINAL
    MORETHAN1FINAL -->|Yes - Multiple actions found| SETERROR
    SETERROR --> HIGHLIGHTROWS
    HIGHLIGHTROWS --> SHOWMSG
    SHOWMSG --> END
    MORETHAN1FINAL -->|No - Only one action| PROCEEDONE
    PROCEEDONE --> END

rules.rule_name: Count All Row Actions Before Validation
rules.rule_description: Before validating individual row selections, the system tallies all action flags entered across all screen rows to determine the total number of delete requests, update requests, and blank (no-action) rows. Valid actions are computed as the sum of deletes and updates.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Count all row selections from the screen:
- Total actions requested
- Delete actions
- Update actions
- Valid actions = Deletes + Updates

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the Transaction Type maintenance screen with one or more rows potentially having action codes entered in the selection fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins processing the submitted screen input and prepares to validate row selections
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Count the number of rows with no action (blank or low-values) as 'no actions selected'; (2) Count the number of rows with a Delete action flag as 'deletes requested'; (3) Count the number of rows with an Update action flag as 'updates requested'; (4) Compute total actions requested as: Maximum Screen Lines minus No-Action rows; (5) Compute valid actions selected as: Deletes Requested plus Updates Requested. All counts are reset to zero before tallying begins.

rules.rule_name: Skip Row Validation When Filters Have Changed
rules.rule_description: If the user has changed either the Type Code filter or the Description filter on the same screen submission, all previously entered row selections are automatically cleared and row-level validation is bypassed entirely, since the filter change will reload new data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Count all row selections from the screen:
- Total actions requested
- Delete actions
- Update actions
- Valid actions = Deletes + Updates

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the Transaction Type maintenance screen with changes to the Type Code filter field or the Description filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins processing row selections
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must immediately clear all row selection flags (reset all selection indicators to blank/empty) and skip all row-level action validation, proceeding directly to filter validation instead. No row action counts are computed and no row errors are flagged.

rules.rule_name: Identify and Track the Selected Row
rules.rule_description: The system iterates through all screen rows from the last row to the first row to identify which row has an action selected. The row number of the selected row is tracked so it can be used for subsequent update or delete operations.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Examine each selected row one by one

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing submitted screen rows and filters have not changed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system examines each row from the last row to the first row
acceptance_criteria.Then: For each row where a valid action code (Delete or Update) is found, the system records that row's position number as the currently selected row. The loop continues examining all rows regardless of whether a selection has already been found, to detect multiple selections.

rules.rule_name: Reject Invalid Action Codes in Row Selection Field
rules.rule_description: Each row's selection field must contain only a recognized action code (Delete or Update flag) or be blank. Any other value entered in the selection field is treated as an invalid action code, triggering an error condition on that specific row.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this row selected for action?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered a value in a row's selection field on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the value in the selection field and it is not a valid Delete flag, not a valid Update flag, and not blank
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set an overall input error condition; (2) Flag that specific row with a selection error indicator (value '1'); (3) Set the bad-actions-selected flag to YES; (4) Set the error message to indicate an invalid action code was entered. The row is marked for red highlighting on the screen.

rules.rule_name: Prevent Multiple Simultaneous Row Actions
rules.rule_description: Only one transaction type record can be actioned (updated or deleted) at a time. If the system detects that a second row has been selected for action while a first row is already selected, the second (and any subsequent) row is flagged as an error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: More than one row already selected?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is iterating through screen rows and has already identified at least one row with a valid action selected
acceptance_criteria.When: The system encounters another row that also has a valid action code (Delete or Update) entered
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Flag the additional selected row with a selection error indicator (value '1'); (2) Set the bad-actions-selected flag to YES. The first selected row is not flagged as an error — only the additional rows beyond the first are marked as errors.

rules.rule_name: Trigger Description Validation for Update Action
rules.rule_description: When a row is selected with an Update action and it is the first (only) selection found so far, the system must immediately validate the description field entered for that row before continuing to examine remaining rows.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this row selected for Update?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is examining a row that has a valid action code entered and it is the first selected row encountered
acceptance_criteria.When: The action code on that row is an Update request
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must invoke the description validation routine (1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC) for that row to verify the new description value is acceptable before proceeding to the next row. If the action is a Delete request (not Update), description validation is skipped and the system proceeds directly to the next row.

rules.rule_name: Set Final Error Condition When Multiple Actions Detected
rules.rule_description: After all rows have been examined, if the total count of actions requested exceeds one, the system sets a final error condition preventing any action from being processed and prepares the appropriate error message for display.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was more than one action selected in total?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has finished examining all screen rows for action selections
acceptance_criteria.When: The total number of actions requested across all rows is more than one (WS-MORETHAN1ACTION condition is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Set the overall input error condition to ERROR; (2) Set the error message indicator to 'More Than 1 Action' message. No delete or update operation will be executed. The screen will be redisplayed with error indicators.

rules.rule_name: Highlight Invalid Row Selections in Red on Screen
rules.rule_description: Any row that has been flagged with a selection error — either because it was an additional selection beyond the first, or because it contained an invalid action code — must be visually highlighted in red on the screen so the user can clearly identify which rows have problems.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Highlight all rows with errors in red on screen to show invalid selections

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing the screen display after processing row selections and one or more rows have been flagged with a selection error indicator (value '1')
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets up screen field attributes for each row
acceptance_criteria.Then: For every row where the selection error indicator equals '1': (1) The selection field color must be set to RED; (2) The cursor must be positioned to that selection field (length set to -1). Rows without a selection error indicator are not highlighted in red.

rules.rule_name: Display Error Message for Multiple Action Selection
rules.rule_description: When the system has determined that more than one row action was selected simultaneously, the appropriate error message must be set and displayed to the user on the screen, clearly communicating that only one action is permitted at a time.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Error Message: User must select only one action at a time

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has set the input error condition and the 'More Than 1 Action' message indicator after detecting multiple row selections
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the message area of the screen for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The 'More Than 1 Action' error message must be displayed in the error message area of the screen. The informational message area remains blank (no informational message is shown when there is an error condition). The screen is sent to the user showing the error.

rules.rule_name: Proceed with Single Valid Action
rules.rule_description: When exactly one row has a valid action selected (either Delete or Update), no error conditions are set for multiple selections, and the system proceeds to process the intended action for that single selected row.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Proceed with the single valid action selected by user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has finished examining all screen rows and exactly one row has a valid action code (Delete or Update) entered, with no other rows having any action selected
acceptance_criteria.When: The multiple-action check determines that WS-MORETHAN1ACTION is false (only one action exists)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) Not set any multiple-action error condition; (2) Retain the recorded selected row number (I-SELECTED) for use in subsequent delete or update processing; (3) Allow the flow to continue to the appropriate action handler (delete confirmation or update confirmation) based on the action type selected. If the single action is an Update, the description validation result from the earlier step is also carried forward.

rules.rule_name: Detect Change in Row Selection Between Screen Submissions
rules.rule_description: The system compares the currently selected row number with the row number that was selected in the previous screen submission. If the selection has changed, this is recorded so that PF10 confirmation actions can be invalidated when the user changes their selection.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Examine each selected row one by one

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed examining all rows and has identified the currently selected row number (I-SELECTED)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system compares the current selected row number with the previously stored selected row number from the communication area (WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED)
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the current selected row number equals the previously stored row number, the system sets the row-selection-changed flag to NO (unchanged). If the current selected row number differs from the previously stored row number, the system sets the row-selection-changed flag to YES (changed) and updates the stored row number to the new selection. This flag is later used to invalidate PF10 confirmation if the selection changed.

key_functionalities.title: Row Description Change Detection
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Row Description Change Detection\nTriggered for Update-Requested Row])
    INIT[Set initial state:\nNo Changes Found]
    COMPARE{Compare entered description\nagainst stored description\nCase-insensitive, trimmed comparison\nof both content AND length}
    MATCH{Do they\nmatch?}
    NOCHANGE[Set flag:\nNo Changes Detected\nInform user no changes were made]
    CHANGED[Set flag:\nChanges Have Occurred\nProceed to validate\nnew description value]
    EXIT([Exit - Return to\nRow Validation])

    START --> INIT
    INIT --> COMPARE
    COMPARE -->|Entered Description| MATCH
    MATCH -->|Yes - Descriptions are identical| NOCHANGE
    MATCH -->|No - Descriptions differ| CHANGED
    NOCHANGE --> EXIT
    CHANGED --> EXIT

rules.rule_name: Initialize Description Change Detection State
rules.rule_description: Before comparing the entered transaction description against the stored description for an update-requested row, the system initializes the change detection state to 'No Changes Found' as the default assumption.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set initial state:
No Changes Found

acceptance_criteria.Given: A row on the Transaction Type maintenance screen has an Update action (U) selected by the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins the description change detection process for that row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the initial change detection state to 'No Changes Found' before performing any comparison, ensuring a clean baseline for the comparison logic

rules.rule_name: Compare Entered Description Against Stored Description
rules.rule_description: When an update is requested on a Transaction Type row, the system performs a precise comparison between the newly entered description and the original stored description. The comparison is case-insensitive, ignores leading and trailing spaces, and validates both the content and the trimmed length of both values to determine if a genuine change has been made.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Compare entered description
against stored description
Case-insensitive, trimmed comparison
of both content AND length

acceptance_criteria.Given: A row on the Transaction Type maintenance screen has an Update action (U) selected, and the user has entered a value in the Transaction Description field for that row
acceptance_criteria.When: The system compares the entered description (from the screen input field WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN for the selected row) against the stored description (from the communication area WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT for the same row)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The comparison must satisfy ALL of the following conditions simultaneously to be considered a match: (1) the trimmed, uppercased content of the entered description equals the trimmed, uppercased content of the stored description, AND (2) the trimmed length of the entered description equals the trimmed length of the stored description; if both conditions are true the descriptions are considered identical, otherwise they are considered different

rules.rule_name: No Changes Detected in Transaction Description
rules.rule_description: When the entered transaction description is determined to be identical to the stored description (after case-insensitive, trimmed comparison of both content and length), the system flags the situation as 'No Changes Detected' and informs the user that no modifications were made, bypassing further description validation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Yes - Descriptions are identical
Set flag:
No Changes Detected
Inform user no changes were made

acceptance_criteria.Given: A row on the Transaction Type maintenance screen has an Update action (U) selected, and the system has performed the case-insensitive trimmed comparison of the entered description against the stored description
acceptance_criteria.When: The trimmed uppercased content of the entered description matches the trimmed uppercased content of the stored description AND the trimmed length of the entered description equals the trimmed length of the stored description
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the 'No Changes Detected' message flag (WS-MESG-NO-CHANGES-DETECTED) to inform the user that no changes were made to the description, and immediately exits the description validation process without performing any further validation on the description field

rules.rule_name: Changes Detected in Transaction Description
rules.rule_description: When the entered transaction description differs from the stored description (based on case-insensitive, trimmed comparison of content or length), the system flags that changes have occurred and proceeds to validate the new description value for correctness before allowing the update to proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No - Descriptions differ
Set flag:
Changes Have Occurred
Proceed to validate
new description value

acceptance_criteria.Given: A row on the Transaction Type maintenance screen has an Update action (U) selected, and the system has performed the case-insensitive trimmed comparison of the entered description against the stored description
acceptance_criteria.When: The trimmed uppercased content of the entered description does NOT match the trimmed uppercased content of the stored description, OR the trimmed length of the entered description does NOT equal the trimmed length of the stored description (i.e., at least one of the two comparison conditions fails)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the 'Changes Have Occurred' flag and continues processing to validate the new description value — specifically checking that the Transaction Description field is not blank and contains only alphanumeric characters, with a maximum length of 50 characters

key_functionalities.title: Row Description Validation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

rules.rule_name: Detect No Change in Transaction Description Before Validation
rules.rule_description: When a user selects an Update action on a transaction type row, the system compares the newly entered description against the previously stored description. If no change is detected, validation is skipped and a 'No Changes Detected' message is set.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 8: Has Description Changed? Compare entered value against stored value

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action on a transaction type row, and the screen contains the entered description value alongside the previously stored description value for that row
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered description, after trimming leading and trailing spaces, matches the stored description (case-insensitive comparison) AND the trimmed length of the entered description equals the trimmed length of the stored description
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the message 'No Changes Detected', skips all further description validation for that row, and proceeds to the next validation step without marking any error

rules.rule_name: Detect Change in Transaction Description to Trigger Validation
rules.rule_description: When a user selects an Update action on a transaction type row, if the entered description differs from the stored description, the system marks that a change has occurred and proceeds to validate the new description value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 8: Has Description Changed? Compare entered value against stored value

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action on a transaction type row, and the screen contains the entered description value alongside the previously stored description value for that row
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered description (trimmed, case-insensitive) does NOT match the stored description, OR the trimmed length of the entered description does NOT equal the trimmed length of the stored description
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks that a change has occurred and proceeds to validate the new description value for blank/empty check and alphanumeric character check

rules.rule_name: Reject Blank or Empty Transaction Description on Update
rules.rule_description: When a change has been detected in the transaction description during an update action, the system validates that the new description is not blank or empty. A description is mandatory and must contain at least one non-space character.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is the entered Description blank or empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A change has been detected in the transaction description for a row where the Update action is selected, and the system is performing description validation for the field named 'Transaction Desc' with a maximum length of 50 characters
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered description value (up to 50 characters) is entirely blank spaces, low-values (empty binary), OR the trimmed length of the entered description equals zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the overall input as invalid, sets the description field status to blank-error, and sets the error message to 'Transaction Desc must be supplied.' The description field is highlighted in red on the screen, and no further alphanumeric validation is performed for this field

rules.rule_name: Reject Non-Alphanumeric Characters in Transaction Description on Update
rules.rule_description: When the entered transaction description is not blank, the system validates that it contains only letters (A-Z, a-z) and numbers (0-9). Special characters, punctuation, and symbols are not permitted in the transaction description.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does Description contain only letters and numbers?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A change has been detected in the transaction description for a row where the Update action is selected, the entered description is not blank or empty, and the system is performing alphanumeric validation for the field named 'Transaction Desc' with a maximum length of 50 characters
acceptance_criteria.When: After converting all valid alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers) to spaces within the entered description, the remaining trimmed content is NOT empty — meaning non-alphanumeric characters are present in the description
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the overall input as invalid, sets the description field status to not-ok, and sets the error message to 'Transaction Desc can have numbers or alphabets only.' The description field is highlighted in red on the screen

rules.rule_name: Accept Valid Alphanumeric Transaction Description on Update
rules.rule_description: When the entered transaction description passes both the blank check and the alphanumeric character check, the system marks the description as valid and allows the update process to continue.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Description Validated Successfully - Mark as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A change has been detected in the transaction description for a row where the Update action is selected, the entered description is not blank or empty, and the system has performed alphanumeric validation for the field named 'Transaction Desc' with a maximum length of 50 characters
acceptance_criteria.When: After converting all valid alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers) to spaces within the entered description, the remaining trimmed content IS empty — meaning the description contains only letters and numbers with no invalid characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the description field status as valid (alphanumeric-is-valid), no error message is set, and the description field is not highlighted in red. The validation result is stored back into the row's description validation flags, and processing continues to the next step

rules.rule_name: Treat Blank or Empty Type Code Filter as No Filter
rules.rule_description: When the user does not enter a Type Code Filter value (leaves it blank, enters zeros, or the field is empty), the system should treat it as if no filter was requested and clear any previously stored type code filter value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Treat as Blank
No filter will be applied

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and the Type Code Filter field is available for input
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen with the Type Code Filter field left blank, containing only spaces, zeros, or empty (low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the Type Code Filter as blank (no filter active), clears the stored type code filter value to zeros, and proceeds without applying any type code restriction to the transaction type list

rules.rule_name: Reject Non-Numeric Type Code Filter Value
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a Type Code Filter value that is not numeric, the system must reject it, display a specific error message, and prevent the user from selecting any rows until the filter is corrected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark filter as INVALID
Set error message:
'TYPE CODE FILTER, IF SUPPLIED
MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER'
Protect row selection fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and has entered a value in the Type Code Filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Type Code Filter value is not a numeric value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid, marks the Type Code Filter as invalid (not OK), sets the error message to 'TYPE CODE FILTER, IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER', protects all row selection fields so no row action can be selected, and stops further processing of the type code filter

rules.rule_name: Accept Valid Numeric Type Code Filter Value
rules.rule_description: When the user enters a numeric value in the Type Code Filter field, the system accepts it as a valid filter and stores it for use in filtering the transaction type list.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Accept value as
valid Type Code Filter

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and has entered a value in the Type Code Filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The entered Type Code Filter value is numeric
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system stores the entered value as the active Type Code Filter and marks the Type Code Filter status as valid

rules.rule_name: Reset Paging When Type Code Filter Changes
rules.rule_description: When the user changes the Type Code Filter value from what was previously used, the system must reset the paging position to the beginning of the results and save the new filter value, ensuring the user sees results from the first page with the new filter applied.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reset paging variables
to start from beginning
Save new filter value

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and a Type Code Filter value (blank or valid numeric) has been processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The current Type Code Filter value is different from the previously stored Type Code Filter value — specifically, the new value does not equal the previously saved value, OR the filter is now blank but the previously saved value was not blank, zeros, or empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system resets all paging variables to their initial state (so display starts from the first page), saves the new Type Code Filter value as the current filter, and marks the Type Code Filter as changed

rules.rule_name: Preserve Paging Position When Type Code Filter Is Unchanged
rules.rule_description: When the user submits the screen without changing the Type Code Filter value from the previously used value, the system preserves the current paging position so the user remains on the same page of results.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Keep existing
paging position
No reset needed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and a Type Code Filter value (blank or valid numeric) has been processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The current Type Code Filter value is the same as the previously stored value — specifically, the new value equals the previously saved value, OR both the new filter is blank AND the previously saved filter was also blank, zeros, or empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the Type Code Filter as not changed and retains the existing paging position without any reset, so the user continues viewing the same page of transaction types
