acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'Changes Have Occurred' and proceeds to validate the new description by: (1) setting the field name context to 'Transaction Desc', (2) copying the entered description into the alphanumeric validation work area, (3) setting the maximum validation length to 50 characters, and (4) invoking the alphanumeric required field validation routine (1240-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD) to verify the new description is non-blank and contains only alphanumeric characters

rules.rule_name: Trigger Description Change Detection Only When Update Action Is Selected
rules.rule_description: The no-change detection comparison for a row's description is only triggered when the user has explicitly selected the Update action (U) for that specific row. Rows with no action selected or with a Delete action selected do not undergo description comparison.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: User Enters Update Action on a Transaction Type Row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing the array of row selections submitted by the user on the Transaction Type maintenance screen, and is iterating through each row to evaluate the action selected
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines that the Update action has been requested on a specific row (UPDATE-REQUESTED-ON for row index I is true), meaning the user has entered the Update action code in the selection field for that row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the description change detection routine (1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC) specifically for that row, passing the row index (I) as context so that the entered description for that row is compared against the stored description for that same row

rules.rule_name: Initialise Change Detection Status Before Comparison
rules.rule_description: Before performing the description comparison for an update action, the system initialises the change detection status to 'No Changes Found' as a default state. This ensures that the comparison result is always explicitly set based on the actual comparison outcome rather than any residual state from a previous operation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Change Detection for Update - If the user requests an update but the description entered is identical to the existing database value, inform the user that no changes were detected

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has been triggered to perform description change detection for a row where the Update action has been selected
acceptance_criteria.When: The description change detection routine (1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC) begins execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the change detection status flag to 'No Changes Found' (NO-CHANGES-FOUND) as the initial default state before any comparison is performed, ensuring a clean baseline for the subsequent description comparison logic

key_functionalities.title: F10 with Changed Criteria Handling
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([User Presses PF10\nto Confirm Delete or Update])
    B{Is a Delete or Update\naction currently pending?}
    C{Has the Type Code\nFilter changed?}
    D{Has the Description\nFilter changed?}
    E{Has the Row\nSelection changed?}
    F[All criteria unchanged\nProceed as PF10 Confirmation\nExecute the requested\nDelete or Update action]
    G[Criteria has changed\nTreat PF10 as a regular\nEnter key press\nDo NOT execute Delete or Update]
    H[Re-display the screen\nwith current data and\nfilter results only]

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Delete or Update Pending| C
    B -->|No - Nothing Pending| H
    C -->|No - Unchanged| D
    C -->|Yes - Changed| G
    D -->|No - Unchanged| E
    D -->|Yes - Changed| G
    E -->|No - Unchanged| F
    E -->|Yes - Changed| G
    G --> H

rules.rule_name: PF10 Confirmation Requires Active Pending Action
rules.rule_description: PF10 is only recognized as a confirmation key when there is an active pending delete or update action. If no action is pending, the key press results in a screen re-display without executing any action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is a Delete or Update action currently pending?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and presses PF10
acceptance_criteria.When: There is NO pending delete action (CA-DELETE-REQUESTED is not set) AND there is NO pending update action (CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED is not set)
acceptance_criteria.Then: PF10 is treated as an invalid confirmation key; the screen is re-displayed with current transaction type data and filter results without executing any delete or update operation

rules.rule_name: PF10 Confirmation Blocked When Type Code Filter Has Changed
rules.rule_description: When PF10 is pressed to confirm a pending delete or update, the system checks whether the Type Code filter value has been modified since the action was originally selected. If the filter has changed, the confirmation is blocked and PF10 is demoted to a regular Enter key press.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Has the Type Code Filter changed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has a pending delete or update action selected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and presses PF10 to confirm
acceptance_criteria.When: The Type Code filter value on the current screen submission is DIFFERENT from the Type Code filter value stored from the previous screen submission (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is NOT set, meaning the filter has changed)
acceptance_criteria.Then: PF10 is NOT treated as a confirmation key; instead it is converted to a regular Enter key press (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE), and the delete or update action is NOT executed; the screen is re-displayed with current data

rules.rule_name: PF10 Confirmation Blocked When Description Filter Has Changed
rules.rule_description: When PF10 is pressed to confirm a pending delete or update, the system checks whether the Description filter value has been modified since the action was originally selected. If the description filter has changed, the confirmation is blocked and PF10 is demoted to a regular Enter key press.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Has the Description Filter changed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has a pending delete or update action selected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen, the Type Code filter is confirmed unchanged, and the user presses PF10 to confirm
acceptance_criteria.When: The Description filter value on the current screen submission is DIFFERENT from the Description filter value stored from the previous screen submission (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is NOT set, meaning the description filter has changed)
acceptance_criteria.Then: PF10 is NOT treated as a confirmation key; instead it is converted to a regular Enter key press (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE), and the delete or update action is NOT executed; the screen is re-displayed with current data

rules.rule_name: PF10 Confirmation Blocked When Row Selection Has Changed
rules.rule_description: When PF10 is pressed to confirm a pending delete or update, the system checks whether the selected row has changed since the action was originally chosen. If a different row is now selected, the confirmation is blocked and PF10 is demoted to a regular Enter key press.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Has the Row Selection changed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has a pending delete or update action selected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen, both the Type Code filter and Description filter are confirmed unchanged, and the user presses PF10 to confirm
acceptance_criteria.When: The row number currently selected (I-SELECTED) is DIFFERENT from the row number stored in the communication area from the previous screen submission (WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED), meaning FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-NO is NOT set
acceptance_criteria.Then: PF10 is NOT treated as a confirmation key; instead it is converted to a regular Enter key press (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE), and the delete or update action is NOT executed; the screen is re-displayed with current data

rules.rule_name: PF10 Confirmation Proceeds When All Criteria Are Unchanged
rules.rule_description: PF10 is accepted as a valid confirmation key and the pending delete or update action is executed only when all three criteria — Type Code filter, Description filter, and row selection — are confirmed to be unchanged from the previous screen submission.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
All criteria unchanged
Proceed as PF10 Confirmation
Execute the requested
Delete or Update action

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has a pending delete or update action selected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and presses PF10 to confirm
acceptance_criteria.When: A delete or update action is pending (CA-DELETE-REQUESTED or CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED is set) AND the Type Code filter has NOT changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is set) AND the Description filter has NOT changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is set) AND the selected row has NOT changed (FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-NO is set)
acceptance_criteria.Then: PF10 is accepted as a valid confirmation; processing continues as a PF10 confirmation action and the pending delete or update operation is executed against the Transaction Type record

rules.rule_name: Changed Criteria Converts PF10 to Enter Key and Suppresses Action
rules.rule_description: When any of the confirmation criteria (Type Code filter, Description filter, or row selection) have changed since the action was selected, PF10 is silently converted to an Enter key press, preventing accidental execution of a delete or update against unintended data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Criteria has changed
Treat PF10 as a regular
Enter key press
Do NOT execute Delete or Update

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user presses PF10 on the Transaction Type maintenance screen with a pending delete or update action
acceptance_criteria.When: At least one of the following conditions is true: the Type Code filter has changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is NOT set), OR the Description filter has changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is NOT set), OR the selected row has changed (FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-NO is NOT set)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The PF10 key action is overridden and replaced with an Enter key action (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE); the delete or update operation is NOT executed; processing continues as if the user had pressed Enter

rules.rule_name: Screen Re-Display After PF10 Criteria Failure or No Pending Action
rules.rule_description: When PF10 confirmation is blocked due to changed criteria or no pending action, the screen is refreshed showing the current transaction type records matching the active filter conditions, without performing any data modification.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Re-display the screen
with current data and
filter results only

acceptance_criteria.Given: PF10 was pressed but either no delete or update action was pending, OR the confirmation criteria check failed due to changed filter or row selection
acceptance_criteria.When: The PF10 action has been converted to an Enter key press (CCARD-AID-ENTER is TRUE) and processing flows to the default screen refresh path
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system reads transaction type records forward from the current first transaction code (WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE used as WS-START-KEY), applies any active Type Code and Description filters, populates the screen with matching records up to the maximum screen lines, and re-displays the screen with current data — no delete or update is performed

rules.rule_name: PF10 Key Validity Requires Pending Delete or Update Action
rules.rule_description: PF10 is only classified as a valid function key when there is an active pending delete or update action. Without a pending action, PF10 is not in the set of recognized valid keys and is treated as an invalid key press, which defaults to Enter behavior.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is a Delete or Update action currently pending?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses PF10 AND there is a pending delete action (CA-DELETE-REQUESTED is set) OR there is a pending update action (CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED is set)
acceptance_criteria.Then: PF10 is classified as a valid key (PFK-VALID is set to TRUE) and processing proceeds to the PF10 criteria validation checks; if neither a delete nor update is pending, PF10 is not in the valid key set and is treated as an Enter key press

key_functionalities.title: Transaction Type List Display
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Start: Build & Send\nTransaction Type List Screen])

    HEADER[Initialize Screen\nSet screen titles, transaction ID,\nprogram name]

    DATETIME[Set Current Date & Time\nFormat and place current date\nand current time on screen]

    PAGENUM[Set Page Number\nDisplay current page number\non screen]

    ROWATTRIBS{For Each of Up to\n7 Rows - Set Display Attributes}

    ROWEMPTY{Is Row Empty?}
    PROTECTROW[Protect Row\nRow is not selectable\nno data to display]

    ACTIONPENDING{Any Action\nErrors or Row\nProtection Required?}
    PROTECTSELECT[Protect Selection Field\nUser cannot select\nthis row for action]

    INVALIDSEL{Invalid Selection\nCode Entered on Row?}
    HIGHLIGHTERROR[Highlight Row in Red\nMark invalid selection\nplace cursor on error row]

    DELETEROW{Delete Requested\non This Row?\nOnly 1 Valid Action?}
    HIGHLIGHTDELETE[Highlight Row for Delete\nShow row in neutral color\nplace cursor on selection field]

    UPDATEROW{Update Requested\non This Row?\nOnly 1 Valid Action?}
    UPDATECOMPLETE{Update Already\nCompleted?}
    HIGHLIGHTUPDATEDONE[Highlight Updated Row\nShow row in neutral color\ncursor on selection field]
    HIGHLIGHTUPDATEEDIT[Enable Description Edit\nMake description field editable\nplace cursor on description field]
    DESCERROR{Description\nValidation Error?}
    HIGHLIGHTDESCERROR[Highlight Description in Red\nIndicate invalid description\nentered by user]

    ROWDATA{For Each of Up to\n7 Rows - Populate Row Data}

    ROWHASDATA{Does Row\nHave Data?}
    SKIPROW[Skip Empty Row\nLeave row blank\non screen]

    POPULATECODE[Display Transaction Type Code\nShow 2-digit type code\nfor this row]

    UPDATEREQUESTED{Update Requested\non This Row?}
    CHANGESDETECTED{Description\nChanges Detected?}
    SHOWNEWINPUT[Show New Description\nDisplay the updated description\nentered by user]
    SHOWBLANK[Show Asterisk\nDescription field was\nleft blank by user]
    SHOWORIGINAL[Show Original Description\nDisplay existing description\nfrom database]

    SHOWSELECTION[Display Selection Field\nShow action code U or D\nentered by user]

    FILTERATTRIBS[Set Filter Field Display\nApply colors and protection\nto type code and description\nfilter fields based on action state]

    MESSAGES[Determine Message to Display]

    DELETESUCCESS{Delete\nSucceeded?}
    SHOWDELSUCCESS[Show Delete Success Message\nRecord deleted successfully]

    UPDATESUCCESS{Update\nSucceeded?}
    SHOWUPDSUCCESS[Show Update Success Message\nRecord updated successfully]

    FILTERERROR{Filter\nValidation Error?}
    SKIPINFOMSG[No Informational Message\nError message already\nset for filter issue]

    ENTERDELETE{Enter Pressed\nwith Delete\nRequested?}
    SHOWDELCONFIRM[Show Delete Confirmation\nPress PF10 to confirm deletion]

    ENTERUPDATE{Enter Pressed\nwith Update\nRequested?}
    SHOWUPDCONFIRM[Show Update Confirmation\nPress PF10 to save update]

    PF7FIRST{PF7 on\nFirst Page?}
    SHOWNOPREV[Show No Previous Pages\nNo previous pages to display]

    PF8LAST{PF8 on\nLast Page Already Shown?}
    SHOWNOMOREOLD[Show No More Pages\nNo more pages to display]

    PF8LASTFIRST{PF8 Reached\nLast Page Now?}
    SHOWLASTPAGE[Show Record Actions Prompt\nMark last page as shown\nType U or D to select action]

    DEFAULTMSG[Show Record Actions Prompt\nType U to update\nD to delete a record]

    CENTERMSG[Center Informational Message\nCalculate message length\ncompute midpoint offset\ndisplay message centered on screen]

    SHOWERRORMSG[Display Error Message\nShow validation or\naction error to user]

    SENDSCREEN([Send Completed Screen\nto User])

    START --> HEADER
    HEADER --> DATETIME
    DATETIME --> PAGENUM
    PAGENUM --> ROWATTRIBS

    ROWATTRIBS --> ROWEMPTY
    ROWEMPTY -->|Yes - Empty Row| PROTECTROW
    ROWEMPTY -->|No - Has Data| ACTIONPENDING

    ACTIONPENDING -->|Yes - Protect All Rows| PROTECTSELECT
    ACTIONPENDING -->|No| INVALIDSEL

    INVALIDSEL -->|Yes - Bad Code| HIGHLIGHTERROR
    INVALIDSEL -->|No| DELETEROW

    DELETEROW -->|Yes| HIGHLIGHTDELETE
    DELETEROW -->|No| UPDATEROW

    UPDATEROW -->|Yes| UPDATECOMPLETE
    UPDATECOMPLETE -->|Yes - Done| HIGHLIGHTUPDATEDONE
    UPDATECOMPLETE -->|No - In Progress| HIGHLIGHTUPDATEEDIT
    HIGHLIGHTUPDATEEDIT --> DESCERROR
    DESCERROR -->|Yes| HIGHLIGHTDESCERROR

    PROTECTROW --> ROWDATA
    PROTECTSELECT --> ROWDATA
    HIGHLIGHTERROR --> ROWDATA
    HIGHLIGHTDELETE --> ROWDATA
    HIGHLIGHTUPDATEDONE --> ROWDATA
    HIGHLIGHTDESCERROR --> ROWDATA
    UPDATEROW -->|No - No Action| ROWDATA

    ROWDATA --> ROWHASDATA
    ROWHASDATA -->|No - Empty| SKIPROW
    ROWHASDATA -->|Yes - Has Data| POPULATECODE

    POPULATECODE --> UPDATEREQUESTED
    UPDATEREQUESTED -->|Yes| CHANGESDETECTED
    CHANGESDETECTED -->|Yes - Changed| SHOWNEWINPUT
    SHOWNEWINPUT --> DESCVALIDCHECK{Description\nBlank?}
    DESCVALIDCHECK -->|Yes| SHOWBLANK
    DESCVALIDCHECK -->|No| SHOWSELECTION
    SHOWBLANK --> SHOWSELECTION
    CHANGESDETECTED -->|No - Unchanged| SHOWORIGINAL
    SHOWORIGINAL --> SHOWSELECTION
    UPDATEREQUESTED -->|No| SHOWORIGINAL

    SKIPROW --> FILTERATTRIBS
    SHOWSELECTION --> FILTERATTRIBS

    FILTERATTRIBS --> MESSAGES

    MESSAGES --> DELETESUCCESS
    DELETESUCCESS -->|Yes| SHOWDELSUCCESS
    DELETESUCCESS -->|No| UPDATESUCCESS
    UPDATESUCCESS -->|Yes| SHOWUPDSUCCESS
    UPDATESUCCESS -->|No| FILTERERROR
    FILTERERROR -->|Yes| SKIPINFOMSG
    FILTERERROR -->|No| ENTERDELETE
    ENTERDELETE -->|Yes - 1 Delete Pending| SHOWDELCONFIRM
    ENTERDELETE -->|No| ENTERUPDATE
    ENTERUPDATE -->|Yes - 1 Update Pending| SHOWUPDCONFIRM
    ENTERUPDATE -->|No| PF7FIRST
    PF7FIRST -->|Yes| SHOWNOPREV
    PF7FIRST -->|No| PF8LAST
    PF8LAST -->|Yes - Already Shown| SHOWNOMOREOLD
    PF8LAST -->|No| PF8LASTFIRST
    PF8LASTFIRST -->|Yes - Just Reached Last| SHOWLASTPAGE
    PF8LASTFIRST -->|No| DEFAULTMSG

    SHOWDELSUCCESS --> CENTERMSG
    SHOWUPDSUCCESS --> CENTERMSG
    SKIPINFOMSG --> SHOWERRORMSG
    SHOWDELCONFIRM --> CENTERMSG
    SHOWUPDCONFIRM --> CENTERMSG
    SHOWNOPREV --> SHOWERRORMSG
    SHOWNOMOREOLD --> SHOWERRORMSG
    SHOWLASTPAGE --> CENTERMSG
    DEFAULTMSG --> CENTERMSG

    CENTERMSG --> SHOWERRORMSG
    SHOWERRORMSG --> SENDSCREEN

rules.rule_name: Initialize Screen Header with Program Identity Information
rules.rule_description: When building the Transaction Type List screen, the system initializes the screen output area and populates the screen header with standard titles, the current transaction ID, and the current program name.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize Screen
Set screen titles, transaction ID,
program name

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is preparing to display the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen build process begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen output area is cleared to low values, the application title lines (CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02) are placed in the screen header, the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) is displayed in the transaction name field (TRNNAMEO), and the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is displayed in the program name field (PGMNAMEO)

rules.rule_name: Display Current Date and Time on Screen
rules.rule_description: The screen must display the current system date formatted as MM/DD/YY and the current system time formatted as HH:MM:SS in the designated screen fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Current Date & Time
Format and place current date
and current time on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is building the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen header is being populated
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current system date is retrieved, formatted by extracting the month (WS-CURDATE-MONTH into WS-CURDATE-MM), day (WS-CURDATE-DAY into WS-CURDATE-DD), and last two digits of the year (WS-CURDATE-YEAR positions 3-4 into WS-CURDATE-YY), and placed in the date field (CURDATEO) in MM/DD/YY format; the current system time is formatted by extracting hours (WS-CURTIME-HOURS into WS-CURTIME-HH), minutes (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE into WS-CURTIME-MM), and seconds (WS-CURTIME-SECOND into WS-CURTIME-SS), and placed in the time field (CURTIMEO) in HH:MM:SS format

rules.rule_name: Display Current Page Number on Screen
rules.rule_description: The screen must show the current page number so the user knows which page of transaction type records they are viewing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Page Number
Display current page number
on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is building the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen header fields are being set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current screen/page number stored in WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is moved to the page number display field (PAGENOO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Protect Selection Field for Empty Rows
rules.rule_description: Rows that contain no transaction type data must have their selection field protected so the user cannot attempt to select an empty row for an action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Row Empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for each of up to 7 rows on the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: A row's data area (WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT for that row index) is equal to LOW-VALUES, indicating no data exists for that row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field attribute (TRTSELA) for that row is set to protected (DFHBMPRO), preventing the user from entering a selection code on that row; additionally, the transaction type code field attribute (TRTYPDA) is set to protected (DFHBMPRF) for all rows regardless

rules.rule_name: Protect All Row Selection Fields When Row Protection Is Required
rules.rule_description: When a condition exists that requires all row selections to be locked (such as a filter validation error), every row's selection field must be protected regardless of whether the row contains data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Protect Row
Row is not selectable
no data to display

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for rows on the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The row protection flag (FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES) is active, indicating that row selections must be locked
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field attribute (TRTSELA) for every row is set to protected (DFHBMPRO), preventing the user from entering any selection code on any row

rules.rule_name: Highlight Row Selection Field in Red for Invalid Selection Code
rules.rule_description: If a user enters an invalid action code in a row's selection field (anything other than D for Delete or U for Update), that selection field must be highlighted in red and the cursor positioned there to draw attention to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Invalid Selection
Code Entered on Row?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for a row that has data and row protection is not required
acceptance_criteria.When: The row's selection error flag (WS-ROW-TRTSELECT-ERROR for that row index) is set to '1', indicating an invalid selection code was entered
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field color attribute (TRTSELC) for that row is set to red (DFHRED) and the selection field cursor length (TRTSELL) is set to -1 to position the cursor on that field

rules.rule_name: Highlight Row in Neutral Color When Delete Action Is Pending
rules.rule_description: When a user has selected the Delete action on a row and it is the only valid action selected (no errors), the transaction type code and description fields for that row are highlighted in neutral color to visually indicate the pending delete action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Delete Requested
on This Row?
Only 1 Valid Action?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for a row that has data, row protection is not required, and no invalid selection error exists on the row
acceptance_criteria.When: A delete action is requested on that row (DELETE-REQUESTED-ON for that row index is true) AND only one valid action is selected across all rows (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION is true) AND no bad action selections exist (FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction type code color attribute (TRTTYPC) for that row is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR), the description color attribute (TRTYPDC) for that row is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR), and the selection field cursor length (TRTSELL) is set to -1 to position the cursor on the selection field

rules.rule_name: Highlight Row in Neutral Color When Update Action Is Pending
rules.rule_description: When a user has selected the Update action on a row and it is the only valid action selected, the transaction type code field is highlighted in neutral color. The description field behavior depends on whether the update has already been completed or is still pending confirmation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Update Requested
on This Row?
Only 1 Valid Action?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for a row that has data, row protection is not required, no invalid selection error exists, and no delete action is requested on the row
acceptance_criteria.When: An update action is requested on that row (UPDATE-REQUESTED-ON for that row index is true) AND only one valid action is selected (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION is true) AND no bad action selections exist (FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction type code color attribute (TRTTYPC) for that row is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR); if the update has already been completed (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is true), the selection field cursor length (TRTSELL) is set to -1 and the description color attribute (TRTYPDC) is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR); if the update is still in progress (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is false), the description cursor length (TRTYPDL) is set to -1 and the description field attribute (TRTYPDA) is set to editable/storable (DFHBMFSE) to allow the user to type a new description

rules.rule_name: Highlight Description Field in Red When Description Validation Fails During Update
rules.rule_description: When an update is in progress and the description entered by the user fails validation, the description field must be highlighted in red to indicate the invalid input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Description
Validation Error?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An update action is in progress on a row, the update is not yet completed, and the description field has been made editable
acceptance_criteria.When: The description validation flag (FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-ISVALID) is NOT set to valid, indicating the description entered by the user failed validation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The description field color attribute (TRTYPDC) for that row is set to red (DFHRED) to visually indicate the description is invalid

rules.rule_name: Enable Description Field for Editing When Update Is in Progress
rules.rule_description: When a user has selected the Update action and the update has not yet been confirmed, the description field for that row must be made editable so the user can type a new description value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Enable Description Edit
Make description field editable
place cursor on description field

acceptance_criteria.Given: An update action is requested on a row, it is the only valid action, no bad selections exist, and the update has not yet been completed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the display attributes for the update-pending row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The description field attribute (TRTYPDA) is set to editable and storable (DFHBMFSE), the description field cursor length (TRTYPDL) is set to -1 to position the cursor on the description field, allowing the user to enter a new description value

rules.rule_name: Skip Empty Rows When Populating Row Data
rules.rule_description: When populating the data fields for each row on the screen, rows that contain no transaction type data are skipped and left blank.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Does Row
Have Data?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating row data fields for each of up to 7 rows on the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: A row's stored output data (WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT for that row index) is equal to LOW-VALUES, indicating no transaction type record exists for that row position
acceptance_criteria.Then: The row is skipped entirely and no data fields are populated for that row, leaving it blank on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Transaction Type Code for Each Data Row
rules.rule_description: For every row that contains transaction type data, the 2-character transaction type code stored from the database must be displayed in the type code field. This field is always read-only and cannot be modified by the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Transaction Type Code
Show 2-digit type code
for this row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating row data fields and the row contains transaction type data
acceptance_criteria.When: The row data population process executes for a non-empty row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction type code stored in WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT for that row index is moved to the type code display field (TRTTYPO) for that row on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Updated Description When User Has Made Changes During Update
rules.rule_description: When an update action is in progress and the user has changed the description value, the screen must show the new description entered by the user rather than the original database value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Description
Changes Detected?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An update action is requested on a row, it is the only valid action, no bad selections exist, and the update has not yet been completed
acceptance_criteria.When: Changes have been detected in the description field (CHANGES-HAVE-OCCURRED is true), meaning the user's input differs from the original stored description
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the description entered by the user (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN for that row) is not blank, the new description input is moved to the description display field (TRTYPDO) for that row; if the description is blank (FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-BLANK is true), an asterisk (LIT-ASTERISK) is placed in the description display field to indicate the field was left empty

rules.rule_name: Display Asterisk When Description Is Left Blank During Update
rules.rule_description: When a user is performing an update and leaves the description field blank, an asterisk symbol is displayed in the description field to visually indicate that the field is empty and requires a value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Show Asterisk
Description field was
left blank by user

acceptance_criteria.Given: An update action is in progress on a row, changes have been detected in the description field
acceptance_criteria.When: The description blank flag (FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-BLANK) is true, indicating the user left the description field empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: The literal asterisk value (LIT-ASTERISK) is moved to the description display field (TRTYPDO) for that row to signal to the user that the description is missing

rules.rule_name: Display Original Database Description When No Update Changes Detected
rules.rule_description: When no update action is in progress, or when an update is in progress but no changes have been made to the description, the original description value from the database is displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Show Original Description
Display existing description
from database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating row data fields for a non-empty row
acceptance_criteria.When: Either no update action is requested on that row, OR an update is requested but no description changes have been detected (CHANGES-HAVE-OCCURRED is false)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The original description stored in WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT for that row index is moved to the description display field (TRTYPDO) for that row

rules.rule_name: Display User's Action Selection Code on Row
rules.rule_description: The action code entered by the user (U for Update or D for Delete) must be reflected back in the selection field of the corresponding row so the user can see their pending selection.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Selection Field
Show action code U or D
entered by user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is populating row data fields for a non-empty row
acceptance_criteria.When: The row data population process completes setting the type code and description fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection code stored in WS-EDIT-SELECT for that row index is moved to the selection display field (TRTSELO) for that row

rules.rule_name: Clear Selection Field After Successful Delete
rules.rule_description: After a transaction type record has been successfully deleted, the selection field for that row must be cleared to reflect that the record no longer exists and no action is pending.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Delete Requested
on This Row?
Only 1 Valid Action?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A delete action was requested on a row, it was the only valid action, and no bad selections existed
acceptance_criteria.When: The delete operation has been completed successfully (FLG-DELETED-YES is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection flag for that row (SELECT-BLANK for that row index) is set to blank/empty, clearing the selection field on the screen

rules.rule_name: Maintain Delete Requested State When Delete Not Yet Confirmed
rules.rule_description: When a delete action has been selected but not yet confirmed with PF10, the system must maintain the delete-requested state so the confirmation prompt remains active.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Delete Requested
on This Row?
Only 1 Valid Action?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A delete action was requested on a row, it is the only valid action, and no bad selections exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The delete has not yet been completed (FLG-DELETED-YES is false)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The communication area flag CA-DELETE-REQUESTED is set to true, preserving the delete-pending state for the next screen interaction

rules.rule_name: Clear Selection Field After Successful Update
rules.rule_description: After a transaction type description has been successfully updated, the selection field for that row must be cleared to indicate the action has been completed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Update Requested
on This Row?
Only 1 Valid Action?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An update action was requested on a row, it was the only valid action, and no bad selections existed
acceptance_criteria.When: The update operation has been completed successfully (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection flag for that row (SELECT-BLANK for that row index) is set to blank/empty, clearing the selection field on the screen

rules.rule_name: Maintain Update Requested State When Update Not Yet Confirmed
rules.rule_description: When an update action has been selected but not yet confirmed with PF10, the system must maintain the update-requested state so the confirmation prompt remains active.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Update Requested
on This Row?
Only 1 Valid Action?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An update action was requested on a row, it is the only valid action, and no bad selections exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The update has not yet been completed (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is false)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The communication area flag CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED is set to true, preserving the update-pending state for the next screen interaction

rules.rule_name: Set Filter Field Display Attributes Based on Action State
rules.rule_description: The type code and description filter fields on the screen must have their display attributes (color, editability, cursor position) set based on the current state of user actions and filter validity.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Filter Field Display
Apply colors and protection
to type code and description
filter fields based on action state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is setting screen field attributes after populating row data, and this is not the first entry to the program nor entry from the Admin program
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current action and filter state
acceptance_criteria.Then: If actions are requested (WS-ACTIONS-REQUESTED > 0): the type code filter field (TRTYPEO) shows the current input value, its attribute (TRTYPEA) is set to auto-skip (DFHBMASF), and its color (TRTYPEC) is set to blue (DFHBLUE); the description filter field (TRDESCO) shows the current input value, its attribute (TRDESCA) is set to auto-skip (DFHBMASF), and its color (TRDESCC) is set to blue (DFHBLUE). If the type code filter is valid or invalid (FLG-TYPEFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK): the type code filter field shows the current input and its attribute is set to editable (DFHBMFSE). If the type code filter is zero: the type code filter field is set to LOW-VALUES. If the description filter is valid or invalid (FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK): the description filter field shows the current input and its attribute is set to editable (DFHBMFSE). If the type code filter is invalid (FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK): the type code filter color is set to red (DFHRED) and cursor length (TRTYPEL) is set to -1. If the description filter is invalid (FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK): the description filter color is set to red (DFHRED) and cursor length (TRDESCL) is set to -1. If no errors exist and no actions are pending and neither PF7 nor PF8 was pressed: the cursor length for the type code filter (TRTYPEL) is set to -1 to position the cursor there

rules.rule_name: Display Delete Success Confirmation Message
rules.rule_description: After a transaction type record has been successfully deleted, a success confirmation message must be displayed to inform the user that the deletion was completed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Delete
Succeeded?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is determining which informational message to display on the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The delete success flag (FLG-DELETED-YES) is true, indicating the delete operation completed successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the delete success message (WS-INFORM-DELETE-SUCCESS is set to true), which will be displayed centered on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Update Success Confirmation Message
rules.rule_description: After a transaction type description has been successfully updated, a success confirmation message must be displayed to inform the user that the update was saved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Update
Succeeded?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is determining which informational message to display, and the delete success flag is not set
acceptance_criteria.When: The update completed flag (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED) is true, indicating the update operation completed successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the update success message (WS-INFORM-UPDATE-SUCCESS is set to true), which will be displayed centered on the screen

rules.rule_name: Suppress Informational Message When Filter Validation Error Exists
rules.rule_description: When a filter validation error exists (type code or description filter is invalid), no additional informational message is displayed because the error message for the filter issue already occupies the message area.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Filter
Validation Error?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is determining which informational message to display, and neither delete success nor update success flags are set
acceptance_criteria.When: Either the type code filter invalid flag (FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK) or the description filter invalid flag (FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK) is true
acceptance_criteria.Then: No informational message is set; the system continues without setting any informational message, as the filter error message already provides feedback to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Delete Confirmation Prompt When Delete Action Is Pending
rules.rule_description: When the user presses ENTER after selecting a delete action on exactly one row, a confirmation prompt must be displayed instructing the user to press PF10 to confirm the deletion.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Enter Pressed
with Delete
Requested?

acceptance_criteria.Given: No filter errors exist, no delete or update success has occurred, and the system is determining the informational message
acceptance_criteria.When: The ENTER key was pressed (CCARD-AID-ENTER is true) AND the number of delete actions requested (WS-DELETES-REQUESTED) is greater than 0 AND only one action is selected (WS-ONLY-1-ACTION is true) AND only one valid action exists (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION is true) AND no informational message has been set yet (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true) AND the type filter has not changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is true) AND the description filter has not changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the delete confirmation prompt (WS-INFORM-DELETE is set to true), instructing the user to press PF10 to confirm the deletion

rules.rule_name: Display Update Confirmation Prompt When Update Action Is Pending
rules.rule_description: When the user presses ENTER after selecting an update action on exactly one row, a confirmation prompt must be displayed instructing the user to press PF10 to save the update.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Enter Pressed
with Update
Requested?

acceptance_criteria.Given: No filter errors exist, no delete or update success has occurred, no delete confirmation is pending, and the system is determining the informational message
acceptance_criteria.When: The ENTER key was pressed (CCARD-AID-ENTER is true) AND the number of update actions requested (WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED) is greater than 0 AND only one action is selected (WS-ONLY-1-ACTION is true) AND only one valid action exists (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION is true) AND no informational message has been set yet (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true) AND the type filter has not changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is true) AND the description filter has not changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the update confirmation prompt (WS-INFORM-UPDATE is set to true), instructing the user to press PF10 to save the update

rules.rule_name: Display No Previous Pages Message When PF7 Pressed on First Page
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to scroll backward (PF7) while already on the first page of transaction type records, an informational message must be displayed indicating there are no previous pages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
PF7 on
First Page?

acceptance_criteria.Given: No filter errors, no action success, no action confirmation prompts are applicable, and the system is determining the informational message
acceptance_criteria.When: The PF7 key was pressed (CCARD-AID-PFK07 is true) AND the current page is the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error/return message (WS-RETURN-MSG) is set to 'No previous pages to display', which is displayed in the error message field (ERRMSGO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display No More Pages Message When PF8 Pressed After Last Page Already Shown
rules.rule_description: When the user attempts to scroll forward (PF8) but the last page has already been displayed and there are no more records, a message must be shown indicating there are no more pages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
PF8 on
Last Page Already Shown?

acceptance_criteria.Given: No filter errors, no action success, no action confirmation prompts, PF7 on first page is not applicable, and the system is determining the informational message
acceptance_criteria.When: The PF8 key was pressed (CCARD-AID-PFK08 is true) AND no next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is true) AND the last page has already been shown to the user (CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error/return message (WS-RETURN-MSG) is set to 'No more pages to display', which is displayed in the error message field (ERRMSGO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Record Actions Prompt When Last Page Is Reached for the First Time
rules.rule_description: When the user scrolls forward with PF8 and reaches the last page of records for the first time, an informational prompt is displayed instructing the user on available record actions, and the last page is marked as shown.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
PF8 Reached
Last Page Now?

acceptance_criteria.Given: PF8 was pressed, no next page exists, and the last page has NOT yet been shown (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines this is the first time the last page is being displayed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the record actions prompt (WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set to true) instructing the user they can type U to update or D to delete a record; the last page shown flag is updated: CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set to true to record that the last page has now been displayed

rules.rule_name: Display Default Record Actions Prompt When Records Exist and More Pages Available
rules.rule_description: When records are displayed and there are more pages available, or when no specific message condition applies, a default informational prompt is shown instructing the user on available record actions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Show Record Actions Prompt
Type U to update
D to delete a record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is determining the informational message and none of the specific message conditions (delete success, update success, filter error, action confirmation, PF7 first page, PF8 last page) apply
acceptance_criteria.When: Either no informational message has been set yet (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true) OR a next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the record actions prompt (WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set to true), instructing the user that they can type U to update or D to delete a record

rules.rule_name: Center Informational Message on Screen
rules.rule_description: Informational messages displayed on the Transaction Type List screen must be centered within the message field to provide a visually balanced presentation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Center Informational Message
Calculate message length
compute midpoint offset
display message centered on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: An informational message has been determined and is ready to be displayed on the screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system calculates the display position for the informational message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The trimmed length of the informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) is computed into WS-STRING-LEN; the midpoint offset is calculated as: WS-STRING-MID = (total length of WS-INFO-MSG minus WS-STRING-LEN) divided by 2, plus 1; the message text is placed into WS-STRING-OUT starting at position WS-STRING-MID for length WS-STRING-LEN; if the message is not the 'no info' message and not the 'no records found' message, the centered message (WS-STRING-OUT) is moved to the informational message display field (INFOMSGO) and its color attribute (INFOMSGC) is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR)

rules.rule_name: Display Error or Validation Message in Error Message Field
rules.rule_description: Any error or validation message generated during processing must be displayed in the designated error message field on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Error Message
Show validation or
action error to user

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed determining all messages to display on the Transaction Type List screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen message setup process finalizes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The content of WS-RETURN-MSG is moved to the error message display field (ERRMSGO) on the screen, making any validation errors, action errors, or navigation messages visible to the user

rules.rule_name: Send Completed Transaction Type List Screen to User
rules.rule_description: After all screen fields, attributes, and messages have been set, the completed Transaction Type List screen must be transmitted to the user's terminal.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Send Completed Screen
to User

acceptance_criteria.Given: All screen fields, row data, display attributes, and messages have been fully populated and set
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen send process (2600-SEND-SCREEN) executes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The screen map (LIT-THISMAP) from the mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET) is sent to the user's terminal using the populated output area (CTRTLIAO), the screen is erased before display (ERASE), the keyboard is unlocked (FREEKB), and the cursor is positioned at the field designated by the -1 cursor length settings

key_functionalities.title: Screen Attribute Setup for Actions
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Screen Attribute Setup\nfor Actions - Begin])
    LOOP[Process Each Row\non Screen - Up to 7 Rows]
    PROTECTTYPE[Always Set Transaction Type Code\nField as Protected/Read-Only]
    EMPTYROW{Row Has No Data\nOR Errors Require\nRow Protection?}
    PROTECTSEL[Protect Selection Field\nRow Cannot Be Selected]
    INVALIDERROR{Invalid Selection\nError Flagged\nfor This Row?}
    MARKINVALID[Mark Selection Field in RED\nMove Cursor to Invalid Row]
    DELETEROW{Delete Action\nRequested on This Row\nAND Only One Valid\nAction Selected?}
    HIGHLIGHTDELETE[Highlight Transaction Code\nand Description in Neutral Color\nMove Cursor to This Row]
    UPDATEROW{Update Action\nRequested on This Row\nAND Only One Valid\nAction Selected?}
    HIGHLIGHTUPDATE[Highlight Transaction Code\nField in Neutral Color]
    UPDATECOMPLETE{Update Already\nCompleted Successfully?}
    UPDATEDONECURSOR[Move Cursor to This Row\nHighlight Description\nin Neutral Color]
    ENABLEDESCEDIT[Enable Description Field\nfor Editing by User\nSet Cursor to Description Field]
    DESCVALID{Description\nValidation Failed?}
    MARKDESCRED[Mark Description\nField in RED]
    ENABLESEL[Enable Selection Field\nfor User Input]
    NEXTROW{More Rows\nto Process?}
    END([Screen Attribute\nSetup Complete])

    START --> LOOP
    LOOP --> PROTECTTYPE
    PROTECTTYPE --> EMPTYROW
    EMPTYROW -->|Yes - Empty Row\nor Errors Present| PROTECTSEL
    PROTECTSEL --> NEXTROW
    EMPTYROW -->|No - Row Has Data\nand No Protection Needed| INVALIDERROR
    INVALIDERROR -->|Yes - Invalid Code Entered| MARKINVALID
    MARKINVALID --> DELETEROW
    INVALIDERROR -->|No - Selection is Valid| DELETEROW
    DELETEROW -->|Yes - Delete Requested| HIGHLIGHTDELETE
    HIGHLIGHTDELETE --> ENABLESEL
    DELETEROW -->|No| UPDATEROW
    UPDATEROW -->|Yes - Update Requested| HIGHLIGHTUPDATE
    HIGHLIGHTUPDATE --> UPDATECOMPLETE
    UPDATECOMPLETE -->|Yes - Update Done| UPDATEDONECURSOR
    UPDATEDONECURSOR --> ENABLESEL
    UPDATECOMPLETE -->|No - Update Pending| ENABLEDESCEDIT
    ENABLEDESCEDIT --> DESCVALID
    DESCVALID -->|Yes - Description Invalid| MARKDESCRED
    MARKDESCRED --> ENABLESEL
    DESCVALID -->|No - Description OK| ENABLESEL
    UPDATEROW -->|No - No Action on Row| ENABLESEL
    ENABLESEL --> NEXTROW
    NEXTROW -->|Yes - More Rows| LOOP
    NEXTROW -->|No - All Rows Done| END

rules.rule_name: Transaction Type Code Field is Always Read-Only on Screen
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Type Code field on every row of the screen must always be set as protected and read-only, regardless of any action or state. Users can never directly edit the transaction type code through this screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Always Set Transaction Type Code Field as Protected/Read-Only

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is being performed for any row on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes each row during screen rendering, regardless of whether the row has data, is selected, or has any action pending
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field for that row must be set to protected/read-only (DFHBMPRF attribute), preventing any user input into that field

rules.rule_name: Selection Field is Protected When Row Has No Data or Errors Require Row Protection
rules.rule_description: A row's selection field must be locked and non-interactive when the row contains no transaction type data, or when a system condition (such as invalid filter input) requires all row selections to be protected. This prevents users from attempting to act on empty or unavailable rows.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Row Has No Data OR Errors Require Row Protection?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a specific row on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The row contains no transaction type data (row output area is empty/low-values) OR the system flag requiring protection of all selection rows is active (e.g., due to invalid filter input)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field for that row must be set to protected/read-only (DFHBMPRO attribute), preventing the user from entering any action code on that row

rules.rule_name: Invalid Selection Code Entry is Highlighted in Red with Cursor Positioned
rules.rule_description: When a user enters an invalid action code in a row's selection field (any value other than the valid Delete or Update codes), the selection field for that row must be visually highlighted in red and the cursor must be moved to that field to draw the user's attention to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark Selection Field in RED
Move Cursor to Invalid Row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that has data and does not require blanket row protection
acceptance_criteria.When: The row's selection error flag is set to '1', indicating the user entered an invalid action code in the selection field for that row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field color attribute for that row must be set to RED (DFHRED) and the cursor length attribute must be set to -1 to position the cursor on that invalid selection field

rules.rule_name: Row Selected for Delete is Highlighted in Neutral Color
rules.rule_description: When a user selects a row for deletion and it is the only valid action selected on the screen with no bad selections, the transaction type code and description fields for that row are highlighted in a neutral color to visually indicate the pending delete action, and the cursor is moved to the selection field of that row.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Highlight Transaction Code and Description in Neutral Color
Move Cursor to This Row

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that has data, does not require blanket row protection, and may or may not have an invalid selection error flagged
acceptance_criteria.When: A Delete action is requested on that specific row AND only one valid action is selected across the entire screen AND no bad/invalid action selections exist on any row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field color (TRTTYPC) and the Description field color (TRTYPDC) for that row must both be set to neutral color (DFHNEUTR), and the cursor length attribute (TRTSELL) must be set to -1 to position the cursor on the selection field of that row

rules.rule_name: Row Selected for Update Has Transaction Type Code Highlighted in Neutral Color
rules.rule_description: When a user selects a row for update and it is the only valid action selected on the screen with no bad selections, the transaction type code field for that row is highlighted in neutral color to visually indicate the pending update action. This applies regardless of whether the update has been completed or is still pending.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Highlight Transaction Code Field in Neutral Color

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that has data, does not require blanket row protection, and a Delete action is NOT requested on that row
acceptance_criteria.When: An Update action is requested on that specific row AND only one valid action is selected across the entire screen AND no bad/invalid action selections exist on any row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field color (TRTTYPC) for that row must be set to neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

rules.rule_name: Completed Update Row Has Cursor Positioned and Description Highlighted in Neutral Color
rules.rule_description: After a successful update has been completed for a selected row, the cursor is moved to the selection field of that row and the description field is highlighted in neutral color to confirm the update is done. The description field remains read-only (not editable) since the update is already complete.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Move Cursor to This Row
Highlight Description in Neutral Color

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row where an Update action is requested, only one valid action is selected, and no bad selections exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The update has already been completed successfully (update-completed flag is active)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor length attribute (TRTSELL) for that row must be set to -1 to position the cursor on the selection field, and the Description field color (TRTYPDC) must be set to neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

rules.rule_name: Pending Update Row Has Description Field Enabled for Editing with Cursor Positioned
rules.rule_description: When an update action is selected on a row but the update has not yet been confirmed or completed, the description field for that row must be made editable so the user can enter or modify the transaction type description. The cursor is positioned on the description field to guide the user to enter the new value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Enable Description Field for Editing by User
Set Cursor to Description Field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row where an Update action is requested, only one valid action is selected, and no bad selections exist
acceptance_criteria.When: The update has NOT yet been completed (update-completed flag is not active), meaning the update is still pending user confirmation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The description field length attribute (TRTYPDL) for that row must be set to -1 to position the cursor on the description field, and the description field attribute (TRTYPDA) must be set to unprotected/editable (DFHBMFSE) to allow user input

rules.rule_name: Description Field is Highlighted in Red When Description Validation Fails on Update
rules.rule_description: When a user has entered an invalid description for a row being updated (e.g., blank, non-alphanumeric characters, or exceeds maximum length), the description field for that row must be highlighted in red to alert the user to the validation error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Description Validation Failed?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row where an Update action is pending (not yet completed), the description field has been enabled for editing, and the cursor has been positioned on the description field
acceptance_criteria.When: The description validation flag for that row indicates the description is NOT valid (FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-ISVALID is not set), meaning the entered description failed validation checks (blank, non-alphanumeric, or other constraint)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Description field color attribute (TRTYPDC) for that row must be set to RED (DFHRED) to visually indicate the validation failure to the user

rules.rule_name: Selection Field is Enabled for User Input on Rows with Data and No Protection Required
rules.rule_description: For any row that contains transaction type data and does not require blanket protection, the selection field must be enabled and made available for user input, allowing the user to enter an action code (Delete or Update) for that row.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Enable Selection Field for User Input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that contains transaction type data and the system does not require all row selections to be protected
acceptance_criteria.When: The row processing reaches the point of setting the selection field attribute, regardless of whether a delete action, update action, or no action is currently associated with that row
acceptance_criteria.Then: The selection field attribute (TRTSELA) for that row must be set to unprotected/editable (DFHBMFSE), enabling the user to enter an action code in the selection field

key_functionalities.title: Search Filter Display
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([32: Search Filter Display Start])
    FIRSTENTRY{Is this the first\ntime entering the screen\nor coming from Admin Menu?}
    SKIP[Skip filter display setup\nUse screen defaults]

    ACTIONCHECK1{Are any row\nactions requested\nby user?}
    TYPECODE_ACTION[Display entered Type Code value\nSet filter field to Blue color\nProtect field from further input]

    TYPEVALID{Is Type Code filter\nvalid or invalid?}
    TYPECODE_SHOW[Display entered Type Code value\nSet field as modifiable]

    TYPECODE_ZERO{Is Type Code\nfilter zero/empty?}
    TYPECODE_CLEAR[Clear Type Code\ndisplay field]
    TYPECODE_DEFAULT[Clear Type Code display field\nSet field as modifiable]

    ACTIONCHECK2{Are any row\nactions requested\nby user?}
    DESC_ACTION[Display entered Description value\nSet filter field to Blue color\nProtect field from further input]

    DESCVALID{Is Description filter\nvalid or invalid?}
    DESC_SHOW[Display entered Description value\nSet field as modifiable]
    DESC_DEFAULT[Set Description field\nas modifiable]

    TYPENOTOK{Is Type Code\nfilter invalid?}
    TYPE_RED[Highlight Type Code field\nin Red color\nPosition cursor to Type Code field]

    DESCNOTOK{Is Description\nfilter invalid?}
    DESC_RED[Highlight Description field\nin Red color\nPosition cursor to Description field]

    INPUTOK{Are all inputs\nvalid with no errors?}
    ACTIONPENDING{Are row actions\npending and not\npaging forward/back?}
    CURSOR_TYPE[Position cursor\nto Type Code filter field]

    END([Search Filter Display Complete\nProceed to Message Setup])

    START --> FIRSTENTRY
    FIRSTENTRY -->|Yes - First Entry\nor from Admin Menu| SKIP

    SKIP --> END

    ACTIONCHECK1 -->|Yes - Actions Pending| TYPECODE_ACTION
    ACTIONCHECK1 -->|No| TYPEVALID

    TYPECODE_ACTION --> ACTIONCHECK2

    TYPEVALID -->|Valid or Invalid Filter Entered| TYPECODE_SHOW
    TYPEVALID -->|No Filter - Check if Zero| TYPECODE_ZERO

    TYPECODE_SHOW --> ACTIONCHECK2
    TYPECODE_ZERO -->|Yes - Zero/Empty| TYPECODE_CLEAR
    TYPECODE_ZERO -->|No| TYPECODE_DEFAULT
    TYPECODE_CLEAR --> ACTIONCHECK2
    TYPECODE_DEFAULT --> ACTIONCHECK2

    ACTIONCHECK2 -->|Yes - Actions Pending| DESC_ACTION
    ACTIONCHECK2 -->|No| DESCVALID

    DESC_ACTION --> TYPENOTOK

    DESCVALID -->|Valid or Invalid Filter Entered| DESC_SHOW
    DESCVALID -->|No Filter| DESC_DEFAULT

    DESC_SHOW --> TYPENOTOK
    DESC_DEFAULT --> TYPENOTOK

    TYPENOTOK -->|Yes - Type Code Invalid| TYPE_RED
    TYPENOTOK -->|No| DESCNOTOK

    TYPE_RED --> DESCNOTOK

    DESCNOTOK -->|Yes - Description Invalid| DESC_RED
    DESCNOTOK -->|No| INPUTOK

    DESC_RED --> INPUTOK

    INPUTOK -->|Yes - No Errors| ACTIONPENDING
    INPUTOK -->|No - Errors Exist| END

    ACTIONPENDING -->|No Actions or Paging| CURSOR_TYPE
    ACTIONPENDING -->|Actions Pending| END

    CURSOR_TYPE --> END

rules.rule_name: Skip Filter Display Setup on First Entry or Admin Menu Navigation
rules.rule_description: When a user enters the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time or navigates from the Admin Menu, the filter field display setup is skipped and screen defaults are used.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this the first time entering the screen or coming from Admin Menu?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is accessing the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being loaded for the first time (no prior session data exists) OR the user has navigated from the Admin Menu program
acceptance_criteria.Then: The filter field display setup is bypassed entirely and the screen renders with default display attributes for the Type Code and Description filter fields, without applying any color, protection, or cursor positioning logic

rules.rule_name: Lock and Highlight Filter Fields in Blue When Row Actions Are Pending
rules.rule_description: When a user has selected a row action (Delete or Update) on the screen, both the Type Code and Description filter fields are displayed in blue and made read-only to prevent filter changes while an action is in progress.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Are any row actions requested by user? → Display entered Type Code value, Set filter field to Blue color, Protect field from further input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and has previously entered a Type Code filter value and/or a Description filter value
acceptance_criteria.When: One or more row actions (Delete or Update) have been requested by the user on the current screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Type Code filter field displays the previously entered type code value, is highlighted in Blue color, and is protected from further input (read-only); AND the Description filter field displays the previously entered description value, is highlighted in Blue color, and is protected from further input (read-only)

rules.rule_name: Display Type Code Filter as Editable When Filter Value Is Present
rules.rule_description: When no row actions are pending and the user has entered a Type Code filter value (whether valid or invalid), the entered value is displayed and the field remains editable so the user can correct or change it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Type Code filter valid or invalid? → Display entered Type Code value, Set field as modifiable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending
acceptance_criteria.When: The Type Code filter field contains a value that has been identified as either valid (a 2-digit numeric code) or invalid (non-numeric entry)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The entered Type Code filter value is displayed in the Type Code filter field and the field is set as modifiable (editable) so the user can update it

rules.rule_name: Clear Type Code Filter Display When Filter Is Zero or Empty
rules.rule_description: When no row actions are pending and the Type Code filter contains zero or is empty, the Type Code filter display field is cleared to show no filter is active.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Type Code filter zero/empty? → Clear Type Code display field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending and the Type Code filter has been determined to have no active filter value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Type Code filter value is zero or empty (blank/low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Type Code filter display field is cleared (set to low-values/blank) to indicate no type code filter is currently active

rules.rule_name: Clear and Set Type Code Filter as Editable for Non-Zero Unrecognized State
rules.rule_description: When no row actions are pending and the Type Code filter is neither recognized as valid/invalid nor zero/empty, the display field is cleared and set as editable as a safe default.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Type Code filter zero/empty? No → Clear Type Code display field, Set field as modifiable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending
acceptance_criteria.When: The Type Code filter does not match any recognized state (not valid, not invalid, not zero, not empty)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Type Code filter display field is cleared (set to low-values/blank) and the field is set as modifiable (editable)

rules.rule_name: Display Description Filter as Editable When Filter Value Is Present
rules.rule_description: When no row actions are pending and the user has entered a Description filter value (whether valid or invalid), the entered value is displayed and the field remains editable.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Description filter valid or invalid? → Display entered Description value, Set field as modifiable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending
acceptance_criteria.When: The Description filter field contains a value that has been identified as either valid or invalid
acceptance_criteria.Then: The entered Description filter value is displayed in the Description filter field and the field is set as modifiable (editable) so the user can update it

rules.rule_name: Set Description Filter Field as Editable When No Filter Value Entered
rules.rule_description: When no row actions are pending and no description filter value has been entered, the Description filter field is set as editable to allow the user to enter a filter.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Description filter valid or invalid? No Filter → Set Description field as modifiable

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending
acceptance_criteria.When: The Description filter field is blank (no filter value has been entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Description filter field is set as modifiable (editable) to allow the user to enter a description filter value

rules.rule_name: Highlight Type Code Filter Field in Red and Position Cursor When Type Code Is Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Type Code filter value fails validation (non-numeric entry), the field is highlighted in red and the cursor is positioned there to draw the user's attention to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Type Code filter invalid? → Highlight Type Code field in Red color, Position cursor to Type Code field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and has entered a value in the Type Code filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The Type Code filter value is determined to be invalid (e.g., non-numeric characters entered in a field that requires a 2-digit numeric code)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Type Code filter field is highlighted in Red color AND the cursor is automatically positioned to the Type Code filter field so the user can correct the invalid entry

rules.rule_name: Highlight Description Filter Field in Red and Position Cursor When Description Filter Is Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Description filter value fails validation (no matching records found), the field is highlighted in red and the cursor is positioned there to draw the user's attention to the error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Description filter invalid? → Highlight Description field in Red color, Position cursor to Description field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and has entered a value in the Description filter field
acceptance_criteria.When: The Description filter value is determined to be invalid (no records found matching the entered description filter)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Description filter field is highlighted in Red color AND the cursor is automatically positioned to the Description filter field so the user can correct the invalid entry

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor to Type Code Filter Field When No Errors and No Actions Pending
rules.rule_description: When all inputs are valid, no row actions are pending, and the user is not navigating between pages, the cursor is defaulted to the Type Code filter field to guide the user to start a new search.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Are all inputs valid with no errors? → Are row actions pending and not paging forward/back? No Actions or Paging → Position cursor to Type Code filter field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: All input fields are valid (no validation errors exist) AND no row actions (Delete or Update) are currently pending AND the user is not navigating forward (PF8) or backward (PF7) through pages
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned to the Type Code filter field to prompt the user to enter or modify a search filter

rules.rule_name: Do Not Reposition Cursor When Row Actions Are Pending
rules.rule_description: When all inputs are valid but a row action (Delete or Update) is currently pending, the cursor is not repositioned to the Type Code filter field, allowing the user to focus on the pending action.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Are row actions pending and not paging forward/back? → Actions Pending → Search Filter Display Complete

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and all input fields are valid
acceptance_criteria.When: One or more row actions (Delete or Update) are currently pending AND the user is not navigating between pages
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is NOT repositioned to the Type Code filter field; the screen proceeds to the message setup phase without changing cursor position

rules.rule_name: Do Not Apply Filter Display Logic When Errors Exist
rules.rule_description: When input validation errors exist, the cursor positioning to the Type Code filter field is skipped and the screen proceeds directly to message setup, as cursor position has already been set by the error handling logic.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Are all inputs valid with no errors? No - Errors Exist → Search Filter Display Complete

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: One or more input validation errors exist (e.g., invalid type code, invalid description filter, invalid row selection)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The default cursor positioning to the Type Code filter field is skipped and the screen proceeds directly to the message setup phase; cursor position is governed by the specific error field highlighting rules already applied

sub_functionalities.title: Set Type Code Filter Field Display
sub_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Set Type Code Filter\nField Display])
    CHECKACTIONS{Are any row actions\npending?\nDelete or Update requested?}
    SHOWBLUE[Show entered type code value\nin the filter field\nDisplay in BLUE color\nField is PROTECTED - user cannot edit]
    CHECKFILTERSTATE{Is the type code filter\nvalid OR invalid\nbut a value was entered?}
    SHOWENTERED[Show entered type code value\nin the filter field\nField is MODIFIABLE\nUser can change the filter]
    CHECKZERO{Is the type code\nfilter value zero\nor empty?}
    CLEARFIELD[Clear the type code\nfilter field\nShow nothing to the user]
    CLEARMODIFIABLE[Clear the type code\nfilter field\nField is MODIFIABLE\nUser can enter a filter]
    END([Type Code Filter\nField Display Set])

    START --> CHECKACTIONS
    CHECKACTIONS -->|Yes - Actions Pending| SHOWBLUE
    CHECKACTIONS -->|No - No Actions Pending| CHECKFILTERSTATE
    CHECKFILTERSTATE -->|Yes - Filter Value Present\nValid or Invalid| SHOWENTERED
    CHECKFILTERSTATE -->|No - No Filter Value| CHECKZERO
    CHECKZERO -->|Yes - Zero or Empty| CLEARFIELD
    CHECKZERO -->|No - Other Condition| CLEARMODIFIABLE
    SHOWBLUE --> END

    CLEARFIELD --> END
