rules.rule_description: PF14 is treated as an alias for PF2, allowing users on terminals where upper-row function keys are the primary keys to navigate to the Add New Transaction Type screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
ALIAS14[PF14 → Same as PF2
Add New Record]

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type maintenance screen is displayed and the user's terminal uses upper-row function keys
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF14 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the active key action to PF2 (CCARD-AID-PFK02 = TRUE), identical to the result of pressing PF2, and the screen navigates to the Add New Transaction Type program

rules.rule_name: Alias PF15 to PF3 Exit to Menu Action
rules.rule_description: PF15 is treated as an alias for PF3, allowing users on terminals where upper-row function keys are the primary keys to exit to the calling menu or Admin menu.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
ALIAS15[PF15 → Same as PF3
Exit to Menu]

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type maintenance screen is displayed and the user's terminal uses upper-row function keys
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF15 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the active key action to PF3 (CCARD-AID-PFK03 = TRUE), identical to the result of pressing PF3, and the screen navigates back to the calling program or Admin menu

rules.rule_name: Alias PF19 to PF7 Page Backward Action
rules.rule_description: PF19 is treated as an alias for PF7, allowing users on terminals where upper-row function keys are the primary keys to scroll backward to the previous page of transaction type records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
ALIAS19[PF19 → Same as PF7
Page Backward]

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type maintenance screen is displaying a list of transaction types and the user's terminal uses upper-row function keys
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF19 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the active key action to PF7 (CCARD-AID-PFK07 = TRUE), identical to the result of pressing PF7, and the screen reads and displays the previous page of transaction type records

rules.rule_name: Alias PF20 to PF8 Page Forward Action
rules.rule_description: PF20 is treated as an alias for PF8, allowing users on terminals where upper-row function keys are the primary keys to scroll forward to the next page of transaction type records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
ALIAS20[PF20 → Same as PF8
Page Forward]

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type maintenance screen is displaying a list of transaction types and the user's terminal uses upper-row function keys
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF20 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the active key action to PF8 (CCARD-AID-PFK08 = TRUE), identical to the result of pressing PF8, and the screen reads and displays the next page of transaction type records

rules.rule_name: Alias PF22 to PF10 Confirm Delete or Update Action
rules.rule_description: PF22 is treated as an alias for PF10, allowing users on terminals where upper-row function keys are the primary keys to confirm a previously selected delete or update action on a transaction type record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
ALIAS22[PF22 → Same as PF10
Confirm Delete or Update]

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type maintenance screen is displayed, the user has previously selected a delete or update action and pressed ENTER to preview it, and the user's terminal uses upper-row function keys
acceptance_criteria.When: The user presses the PF22 key
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the active key action to PF10 (CCARD-AID-PFK10 = TRUE), identical to the result of pressing PF10, and the screen executes the confirmed delete or update operation subject to validation that filters and row selection have not changed

rules.rule_name: Unified Key Action Processing Regardless of Physical Key Pressed
rules.rule_description: Once a function key is mapped to its logical action (either directly or via alias), the system processes the action identically regardless of which physical key was pressed. PF1 and PF13 produce the same outcome; PF2 and PF14 produce the same outcome; PF3 and PF15 produce the same outcome; PF7 and PF19 produce the same outcome; PF8 and PF20 produce the same outcome; PF10 and PF22 produce the same outcome.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
UNIFIED([Unified Key Action
Processed Identically
Regardless of Which Key Was Pressed])

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Type maintenance screen is displayed and the user presses any function key
acceptance_criteria.When: The key pressed is any of the following pairs: PF1 or PF13, PF2 or PF14, PF3 or PF15, PF4 or PF16, PF5 or PF17, PF6 or PF18, PF7 or PF19, PF8 or PF20, PF9 or PF21, PF10 or PF22, PF11 or PF23, PF12 or PF24
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the same internal action flag for both keys in each pair (e.g., both PF2 and PF14 set CCARD-AID-PFK02 = TRUE), and all subsequent processing uses only the internal action flag, making the behavior completely identical regardless of which physical key in the pair was pressed

key_functionalities.title: Informational Message Centering
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Informational Message Centering])
    B[Take the informational message\nto be displayed]
    C[Calculate the length of the message\nafter removing trailing spaces\nTrimmed Message Length]
    D[Calculate the total available\ndisplay width of the message field]
    E[Compute the starting position\nfor the message:\nStart Position = Total Width minus Trimmed Length\ndivided by 2 plus 1]
    F[Place the trimmed message\ninto the output field\nstarting at the calculated center position]
    G{Is there an\ninformational message\nto display?}
    H[Display the centered message\non screen in neutral color]
    I([End: Message Centered on Screen])
    J([End: No Message Displayed])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G -->|Yes - Message exists\nand records were found| H
    H --> I
    G -->|No - No message\nor no records found| J

rules.rule_name: Calculate Trimmed Informational Message Length
rules.rule_description: Before centering an informational message on screen, the system calculates the actual content length of the message by trimming trailing spaces, so that only the meaningful text portion is used for positioning calculations.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Calculate the length of the message after removing trailing spaces - Trimmed Message Length

acceptance_criteria.Given: An informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) has been prepared for display on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to center the informational message on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system calculates the trimmed length of WS-INFO-MSG by applying the TRIM function to remove trailing spaces, and stores the result as the Trimmed Message Length (WS-STRING-LEN), which represents the number of meaningful characters in the message

rules.rule_name: Compute Center Starting Position for Informational Message
rules.rule_description: To visually center the informational message within the available display field, the system computes the starting position by subtracting the trimmed message length from the total field width, dividing the remainder by 2, and adding 1 to obtain the correct offset position.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Compute the starting position for the message: Start Position = Total Width minus Trimmed Length divided by 2 plus 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Trimmed Message Length (WS-STRING-LEN) has been calculated and the total available display width of the informational message field is known as the full length of WS-INFO-MSG
acceptance_criteria.When: The system computes the horizontal center position for the message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system calculates the center starting position (WS-STRING-MID) using the formula: WS-STRING-MID = (Total Field Width of WS-INFO-MSG minus WS-STRING-LEN) divided by 2, plus 1; this position represents the column offset at which the trimmed message text should begin to appear centered within the field

rules.rule_name: Place Trimmed Message Text at Calculated Center Position
rules.rule_description: After computing the center starting position, the system places the trimmed informational message text into the output display buffer at the calculated offset, so that the message appears visually centered when rendered on screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Place the trimmed message into the output field starting at the calculated center position

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Trimmed Message Length (WS-STRING-LEN) and the center starting position (WS-STRING-MID) have both been computed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system writes the informational message into the screen output buffer
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system copies the trimmed portion of WS-INFO-MSG (from position 1 for WS-STRING-LEN characters) into the output string buffer WS-STRING-OUT, starting at position WS-STRING-MID for a length of WS-STRING-LEN characters, effectively placing the message text at the centered position within the output field

rules.rule_name: Determine Whether Informational Message Should Be Displayed
rules.rule_description: Before rendering the centered informational message on screen, the system evaluates two conditions: whether an informational message actually exists, and whether the current state is not a 'no records found' situation. Both conditions must be satisfied for the message to be displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is there an informational message to display?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The centered informational message text has been placed into the output buffer (WS-STRING-OUT)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether to display the informational message on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the centered message ONLY IF both of the following conditions are true: (1) the informational message flag is NOT set to 'No Info Message' (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is FALSE), AND (2) the message is NOT a 'No Records Found' message (WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND is FALSE); if either condition fails, no informational message is displayed on screen

rules.rule_name: Display Centered Informational Message in Neutral Color
rules.rule_description: When the conditions for displaying an informational message are met, the system renders the centered message text on the screen using a neutral color attribute, ensuring the message is visually distinguishable without being highlighted as an error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display the centered message on screen in neutral color

acceptance_criteria.Given: The informational message exists (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is FALSE) AND the message is not a 'No Records Found' message (WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND is FALSE), and the centered message text has been placed in WS-STRING-OUT
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sends the Transaction Type maintenance screen to the user
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system moves WS-STRING-OUT to the informational message output field (INFOMSGO) of the screen map (CTRTLIAO), and sets the color attribute of the informational message field (INFOMSGC) to neutral color (DFHNEUTR), so the message appears centered and in neutral color on the screen

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Maintenance program is invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All working storage areas (CC-WORK-AREA, WS-MISC-STORAGE, WS-COMMAREA) are initialized to their default values, the return message flag is set to OFF, and the program is ready to process user input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Program Working Storage Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: On every program entry, all working storage areas, miscellaneous storage, and the communication area are reset to their default values before any processing begins.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has completed initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Session context is being established
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) is stored in WS-TRANID, the program name (LIT-THISPGM) is stored in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, the map name (LIT-THISMAP) is stored in CDEMO-LAST-MAP, and the mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET) is stored in CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET

all_rules.Rule_Name: Session Context Setup
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program records its own identity (transaction ID, program name, map name, mapset name) into the session context so that navigation and return routing are correctly established.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Maintenance program is invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No prior session communication area exists (first-time entry)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The CARDDEMO communication area and program-specific communication area are initialized, the calling transaction ID is set to the current transaction, the calling program is set to the current program, the user type is set to Admin, the program state is set to Enter, the last map and mapset are set to the current map and mapset, the display is positioned at the first page, and the last-page-not-shown flag is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: First-Time Entry Detection and Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time (no prior session exists), the program initializes all session data fresh, sets the user type to Admin, and positions the display at the first page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Maintenance program is invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A prior session communication area exists (returning user)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The CARDDEMO communication area is restored from DFHCOMMAREA for the length of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is restored from DFHCOMMAREA starting after the CARDDEMO-COMMAREA length

all_rules.Rule_Name: Existing Session Data Restoration
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user returns to the Transaction Type Maintenance screen after a prior interaction, the program restores all previously saved session state including filters, paging position, and selections from the communication area.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program detects entry from a different program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM not equal to LIT-THISPGM and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is true) OR PF3 is pressed while the calling transaction is the Add Transaction program (LIT-ADDTTRANID)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is initialized, the program state is set to Enter, the key is set to ENTER, the last map and mapset are set to the current map and mapset, the display is positioned at the first page, and the last-page-not-shown flag is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset List Screen on Return from Add Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user returns from the Add Transaction Type screen using PF3, or when entering from a different program, the list screen is reset to a fresh first-page state, clearing all prior filters and selections.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program receives the screen map (CTRTLIAI from LIT-THISMAP / LIT-THISMAPSET)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The type code filter value is captured from TRTYPEI into WS-IN-TYPE-CD, the description filter value is captured from TRDESCI into WS-IN-TYPE-DESC, and for each row (1 through WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES): the selection flag is captured from TRTSELI(I) into WS-EDIT-SELECT(I), the transaction type code is captured from TRTTYPI(I) into WS-ROW-TR-CODE-IN(I), and the description is captured from TRTYPDI(I) into WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I) — if TRTYPDI(I) is an asterisk or spaces the description is set to LOW-VALUES, otherwise the trimmed value is stored

all_rules.Rule_Name: Screen Input Reception for Transaction Type List
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program receives all user-entered data from the Transaction Type List screen, capturing the type code filter, description filter, and for each displayed row: the selection action code, the transaction type code, and the transaction description.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction Type List screen with row selections
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The type code filter and description filter have NOT changed (if either filter changed, all selections are cleared and validation is skipped)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program counts: total actions requested (WS-ACTIONS-REQUESTED = WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES minus blank/low-value selections), delete actions (WS-DELETES-REQUESTED = count of LIT-DELETE-FLAG values), and update actions (WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED = count of LIT-UPDATE-FLAG values); for each row, if the selection is a valid action code (D or U) it is accepted, if blank it is ignored, and if any other value is entered the row is flagged with a selection error and INPUT-ERROR is set with message 'Invalid action code'

all_rules.Rule_Name: Row Selection Action Code Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program validates the action code entered in each row's selection field, counting the number of delete and update requests, and flagging any invalid action codes entered by the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted the Transaction Type List screen with row selections
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The total number of valid actions selected (WS-VALID-ACTIONS-SELECTED = WS-DELETES-REQUESTED + WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED) is greater than 1 (WS-MORETHAN1ACTION is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: INPUT-ERROR is set to true, each row with a valid selection is flagged with a selection error indicator (WS-ROW-TRTSELECT-ERROR = '1'), FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-YES is set, and the error message WS-MESG-MORE-THAN-1-ACTION is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Multiple Row Actions Prevention
all_rules.Rule_Description: Only one action (delete or update) may be selected across all displayed rows at a time. If the user selects actions on more than one row simultaneously, an error is raised.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has selected the Update (U) action on a row and the row is the only valid action selected with no bad selections
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates the entered description for that row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the trimmed, upper-cased entered description (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I)) equals the trimmed, upper-cased stored description (WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(I)) AND their trimmed lengths are equal, then NO-CHANGES-FOUND is set and WS-MESG-NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is set and description validation is skipped; otherwise CHANGES-HAVE-OCCURRED is set and description validation proceeds

all_rules.Rule_Name: Row Description Change Detection for Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an update action is selected on a row, the program compares the newly entered description against the original stored description to determine whether any actual change has been made.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a new description for a transaction type row and changes have been detected
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The description field (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I), up to 50 characters) is validated with field name 'Transaction Desc'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the description is blank, empty, or all low-values, INPUT-ERROR is set and the message '[field name] must be supplied.' is generated; if the description contains non-alphanumeric characters (characters other than letters and numbers), INPUT-ERROR is set and the message '[field name] can have numbers or alphabets only.' is generated; if the description passes both checks, FLG-ALPHNANUM-ISVALID is set; the validation result flags are stored in WS-ARRAY-DESCRIPTION-FLGS and FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-NOT-OK is initially set before validation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Row Description Alphanumeric Validation for Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user requests an update on a transaction type row, the new description entered must be non-blank and contain only alphanumeric characters.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in the type code filter field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The type code filter (WS-IN-TYPE-CD) is validated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If WS-IN-TYPE-CD is LOW-VALUES, SPACES, or ZEROS, FLG-TYPEFILTER-BLANK is set and WS-TYPE-CD-FILTER is set to ZEROES (no filter applied); if WS-IN-TYPE-CD is not numeric, INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK is set, FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES is set, and the message 'TYPE CODE FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER' is set in WS-RETURN-MSG; if WS-IN-TYPE-CD is numeric, WS-TYPE-CD-FILTER is set to WS-IN-TYPE-CD and FLG-TYPEFILTER-ISVALID is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Type Code Filter Numeric Validation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The type code filter field, if supplied, must be a 2-digit numeric value. Blank or zero values are treated as no filter being applied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The type code filter has been validated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current type code filter value (WS-IN-TYPE-CD) is compared to the previously stored value (WS-CA-TYPE-CD)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If WS-IN-TYPE-CD equals WS-CA-TYPE-CD, OR if the filter is blank AND WS-CA-TYPE-CD is ZEROES/LOW-VALUES/SPACES, then FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is set (no reset needed); otherwise WS-CA-PAGING-VARIABLES are initialized, WS-IN-TYPE-CD is stored into WS-CA-TYPE-CD, and FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-YES is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Type Code Filter Change Detection and Page Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the type code filter value changes from the previously used value, the paging variables are reset so the display starts from the beginning of the filtered result set.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered a value in the description filter field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The description filter (WS-IN-TYPE-DESC) is processed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If WS-IN-TYPE-DESC is LOW-VALUES or SPACES, FLG-DESCFILTER-BLANK is set (no filter applied); if a value is provided, FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID is set and WS-TYPE-DESC-FILTER is constructed by concatenating '%' + TRIM(WS-IN-TYPE-DESC) + '%' so that the database search uses a LIKE pattern matching any description containing the entered text

all_rules.Rule_Name: Description Filter Wildcard Wrapping
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a description filter value is provided, the program automatically wraps it with wildcard characters to enable a contains-style partial match search against transaction type descriptions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The description filter has been processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current description filter value (WS-IN-TYPE-DESC) is compared to the previously stored value (WS-CA-TYPE-DESC)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If WS-IN-TYPE-DESC equals WS-CA-TYPE-DESC, OR if the filter is blank AND WS-CA-TYPE-DESC is LOW-VALUES/SPACES, then FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is set (no reset needed); otherwise WS-CA-PAGING-VARIABLES are initialized, WS-IN-TYPE-DESC is stored into WS-CA-TYPE-DESC, and FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-YES is set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Description Filter Change Detection and Page Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the description filter value changes from the previously used value, the paging variables are reset so the display starts from the beginning of the filtered result set.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: At least one filter is active (FLG-TYPEFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A COUNT query is executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE with the active filter conditions: type code filter applies exact match on TR_TYPE when WS-EDIT-TYPE-FLAG = '1', and description filter applies LIKE match on TR_DESCRIPTION using TRIM(WS-TYPE-DESC-FILTER) when WS-EDIT-DESC-FLAG = '1'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the count (WS-RECORDS-COUNT) is zero, INPUT-ERROR is set, FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK is set if the type filter was active, FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK is set if the description filter was active, FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES is set, and the message 'No Records found for these filter conditions' is set in WS-RETURN-MSG; if records are found, processing continues normally

all_rules.Rule_Name: Filter Cross-Validation Against Database
all_rules.Rule_Description: When at least one filter (type code or description) is active, the program verifies that at least one matching transaction type record exists in the database before allowing the user to proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed a function key on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The pressed key is evaluated against the list of valid keys
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the key is ENTER, PF2, PF3, PF7, PF8, or PF10 (where PF10 is only valid when a delete or update has been requested), PFK-VALID is set; if the key is PF10 without a pending delete or update, it is not considered valid; if the key is any other key, PFK-INVALID is set and the key is treated as ENTER (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Function Key Validation and Invalid Key Handling
all_rules.Rule_Description: Only specific function keys are valid in the Transaction Type Maintenance screen. Invalid key presses are silently converted to ENTER key behavior to prevent unintended actions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses a function key on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The EIBAID value is evaluated in YYYY-STORE-PFKEY
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: ENTER maps to CCARD-AID-ENTER, CLEAR maps to CCARD-AID-CLEAR, PA1 maps to CCARD-AID-PA1, PA2 maps to CCARD-AID-PA2, PF1/PF13 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK01, PF2/PF14 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK02, PF3/PF15 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK03, PF4/PF16 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK04, PF5/PF17 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK05, PF6/PF18 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK06, PF7/PF19 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK07, PF8/PF20 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK08, PF9/PF21 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK09, PF10/PF22 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK10, PF11/PF23 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK11, PF12/PF24 both map to CCARD-AID-PFK12

all_rules.Rule_Name: Function Key Aliasing PF13-PF24 to PF1-PF12
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program maps the upper function keys (PF13 through PF24) to their equivalent lower function keys (PF1 through PF12) so that users on keyboards with only upper function keys receive the same behavior.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: PF3 is pressed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is LOW-VALUES, SPACES, or the current transaction ID, the destination transaction is set to LIT-ADMINTRANID; otherwise CDEMO-FROM-TRANID is used as the destination transaction; if CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is LOW-VALUES, SPACES, or the current program name, the destination program is set to LIT-ADMINPGM; otherwise CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is used as the destination program; the current transaction and program are recorded as the source, user type is set to Admin, program state is set to Enter, a SYNCPOINT (commit) is issued, and control is transferred via XCTL to the destination program passing CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

all_rules.Rule_Name: Exit to Main Administration Menu
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3 to exit the Transaction Type Maintenance screen, control is transferred to the appropriate calling program or the administration menu if no specific caller is identified.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and PF2 is pressed while the current program is this program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: PF2 is pressed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current transaction ID is set as the source transaction (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID = LIT-THISTRANID), the current program is set as the source program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = LIT-THISPGM), user type is set to regular user (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER), program state is set to Enter, the current mapset and map are recorded, the destination program is set to LIT-ADDTPGM, the next mapset is set to LIT-ADDTMAPSET, the next map is set to LIT-ADDTMAP, WS-EXIT-MESSAGE is set to TRUE, and control is transferred via XCTL to LIT-ADDTPGM passing CARDDEMO-COMMAREA

all_rules.Rule_Name: Navigate to Add Transaction Type Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF2, control is transferred to the Add Transaction Type program to allow creation of a new transaction type record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 to scroll forward and a next page exists, OR the program needs to display a forward page of records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The forward cursor (C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD) is opened and records are fetched from CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE where TR_TYPE >= WS-START-KEY, applying type code filter (exact match on TR_TYPE when WS-EDIT-TYPE-FLAG = '1') and description filter (LIKE match on TR_DESCRIPTION when WS-EDIT-DESC-FLAG = '1'), ordered by TR_TYPE ascending
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All current row output data (WS-CA-ALL-ROWS-OUT) is cleared; records are fetched one by one up to WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES rows; each fetched record's TR_TYPE is stored in WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT(row) and TR_DESCRIPTION-TEXT in WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(row); the first record's TR_TYPE is stored as WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE and if page number is 0 it is incremented to 1; when the maximum rows are filled, one additional fetch is attempted: if successful CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is set and the additional record's TR_TYPE becomes WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE, if no more records CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is set; if PF8 was pressed and no more records WS-MESG-NO-MORE-RECORDS is set; the page number is incremented by 1 when navigating forward via PF8

all_rules.Rule_Name: Forward Paging - Read Next Page of Transaction Types
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user scrolls forward, the program reads the next page of transaction type records from the database starting from the last key of the current page, filling up to the maximum number of screen rows.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to scroll backward and the display is not on the first page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backward cursor (C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD) is opened and records are fetched from CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE where TR_TYPE < WS-START-KEY (WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE), applying the same type code and description filters, ordered by TR_TYPE DESCENDING
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All current row output data (WS-CA-ALL-ROWS-OUT) is cleared; WS-ROW-NUMBER is initialized to WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES; records are fetched one by one and placed from the bottom row upward (WS-ROW-NUMBER decrements by 1 after each fetch); each record's TR_TYPE is stored in WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT(WS-ROW-NUMBER) and TR_DESCRIPTION-TEXT in WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(WS-ROW-NUMBER); when WS-ROW-NUMBER reaches 0, the last fetched TR_TYPE is stored as WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE and the read loop exits; the page number is decremented by 1; all row selection flags are cleared after reading

all_rules.Rule_Name: Backward Paging - Read Previous Page of Transaction Types
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user scrolls backward, the program reads the previous page of transaction type records from the database in descending order, filling the screen rows from bottom to top to reconstruct the previous page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF7 to scroll backward
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current page is the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The display remains on the first page, WS-START-KEY is set to WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, the forward read (8000-READ-FORWARD) is performed to re-display the current first page, and the message 'No previous pages to display' is set in WS-RETURN-MSG

all_rules.Rule_Name: First Page Boundary Check on Backward Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to scroll backward while already on the first page, the program prevents navigation and informs the user that no previous pages are available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered 'D' in a row's selection field and pressed ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: ENTER is pressed, WS-DELETES-REQUESTED is greater than 0, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: WS-START-KEY is set to WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, a forward read is performed if both type and description filters are valid (not FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK and not FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK), CA-DELETE-REQUESTED state is maintained, the selected row is highlighted in neutral color with the type code and description displayed, and the screen is sent to the user prompting confirmation via PF10; the informational message WS-INFORM-DELETE is set if no other info message exists and filters are unchanged

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Confirmation Request Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user selects a delete action on a row and presses ENTER, the program displays a confirmation screen highlighting the selected row and prompting the user to press PF10 to confirm the deletion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has previously selected a delete action on a row and pressed PF10 to confirm, with no changes to filters or row selection since the delete was requested
Acceptance_Criteria.When: PF10 is pressed, WS-DELETES-REQUESTED is greater than 0, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The TR_TYPE value from the selected row (WS-ROW-TR-CODE-IN(I-SELECTED)) is moved to DCL-TR-TYPE, and a DELETE statement is executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = DCL-TR-TYPE

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Record Execution
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user confirms a delete action by pressing PF10, the program permanently removes the selected transaction type record from the database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A DELETE operation has been executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The delete completes successfully (SQLCODE = 0)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A CICS SYNCPOINT is issued to commit the deletion, CA-DELETE-SUCCEEDED is set to TRUE, WS-INFORM-DELETE-SUCCESS is set if no other info message exists, FLG-DELETED-YES is set, the screen is sent showing the success message, and then CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, and WS-MISC-STORAGE are initialized, CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is set to TRUE, CA-FIRST-PAGE is set to TRUE, and CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN is set to TRUE to return to the first page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Success Handling and Session Reset
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a transaction type record is successfully deleted, the change is committed, a success message is displayed, and the session is reset to show the first page of the updated list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A DELETE operation has been executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The delete fails because child records exist that reference this transaction type (referential integrity violation, SQLCODE = -532)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: CA-DELETE-REQUESTED is set to TRUE (delete not completed), the error message 'Please delete associated child records first:' is set as WS-DB2-CURRENT-ACTION, the DB2 error details are formatted and stored in WS-RETURN-MSG, and the screen is redisplayed showing the error message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Delete Failure Due to Child Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: A transaction type cannot be deleted if other records in the system reference it as a foreign key. The user must first remove all associated child records before the transaction type can be deleted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered 'U' in a row's selection field and pressed ENTER
Acceptance_Criteria.When: ENTER is pressed, WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED is greater than 0, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: WS-START-KEY is set to WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, a forward read is performed if both type and description filters are valid (not FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK and not FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK), CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED state is maintained, the selected row's description field is made editable (DFHBMFSE attribute), the type code field is displayed in neutral color (read-only), and the screen is sent to the user prompting confirmation via PF10; the informational message WS-INFORM-UPDATE is set if no other info message exists and filters are unchanged

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Confirmation Request Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user selects an update action on a row and presses ENTER, the program displays a confirmation screen with the description field editable and prompts the user to press PF10 to save the changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has previously selected an update action on a row, entered a new description, and pressed PF10 to confirm, with no changes to filters or row selection since the update was requested
Acceptance_Criteria.When: PF10 is pressed, WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED is greater than 0, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The TR_TYPE from the selected row (WS-ROW-TR-CODE-IN(I-SELECTED)) is moved to DCL-TR-TYPE, the trimmed new description (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I-SELECTED)) is moved to DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-TEXT, the description length is computed as the length of WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I-SELECTED) and stored in DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN, and an UPDATE statement is executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE SET TR_DESCRIPTION = DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION WHERE TR_TYPE = DCL-TR-TYPE

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Record Execution
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user confirms an update action by pressing PF10, the program updates the description of the selected transaction type record in the database. Only the description field can be changed; the type code is immutable.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An UPDATE operation has been executed against CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update completes successfully (SQLCODE = 0)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A CICS SYNCPOINT is issued to commit the update, CA-UPDATE-SUCCEEDED is set to TRUE, WS-INFORM-UPDATE-SUCCESS is set if no other info message exists, FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is set to TRUE, WS-START-KEY is set to WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, a forward read (8000-READ-FORWARD) is performed to refresh the list, and the screen is sent showing the updated data with the success message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Success Handling
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a transaction type description is successfully updated, the change is committed, a success message is displayed, and the list is refreshed to show the updated data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF10 to confirm an update on a selected row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The trimmed, upper-cased entered description equals the trimmed, upper-cased stored description AND their trimmed lengths are equal (NO-CHANGES-FOUND is true / WS-MESG-NO-CHANGES-DETECTED is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No database UPDATE is executed, WS-MESG-NO-CHANGES-DETECTED message is displayed to the user, and the screen is refreshed showing the current data without modification

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Changes Detected on Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user confirms an update but the entered description is identical to the existing description, the program informs the user that no changes were detected and does not perform a database update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF10 with a pending delete or update action
Acceptance_Criteria.When: PF10 is pressed AND any of the following conditions are true: the type code filter has changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-YES), OR the description filter has changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-YES), OR the row selection has changed (FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-YES)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: PF10 is treated as ENTER (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE) and the confirmation action is not executed; the screen is redisplayed in its current state

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF10 with Changed Criteria Treated as Enter
all_rules.Rule_Description: PF10 is only valid as a confirmation key when the filter criteria and row selection are unchanged since the action was requested. If any criteria have changed, PF10 is treated as ENTER to prevent confirming an action against unintended data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Transaction type records have been read from the database and the screen is ready to be built
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen initialization (2100-SCREEN-INIT) and array population (2300-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT) are performed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen output area (CTRTLIAO) is initialized to LOW-VALUES; the current date is formatted as MM/DD/YY and placed in CURDATEO; the current time is formatted as HH:MM:SS and placed in CURTIMEO; the current page number (WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM) is placed in PAGENOO; the program title lines (CCDA-TITLE01, CCDA-TITLE02) are placed in TITLE01O and TITLE02O; the transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) is placed in TRNNAMEO; the program name (LIT-THISPGM) is placed in PGMNAMEO; for each row with data (WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT not LOW-VALUES): the transaction type code (WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT(I)) is placed in TRTTYPO(I), the description (WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(I)) is placed in TRTYPDO(I), and the selection flag (WS-EDIT-SELECT(I)) is placed in TRTSELO(I)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Type List Screen Build
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program builds the Transaction Type List display screen, populating it with up to the maximum number of transaction type records, along with the current page number, date, time, program name, and transaction ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen attributes are set up (2200-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS) for each row (from WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES down to 1)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction type code column (TRTYPDA) is always set to protected (DFHBMPRF — read-only); if a row has no data (WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT = LOW-VALUES) OR FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES is set, the selection field (TRTSELA) is set to protected (DFHBMPRO); if a row has a selection error (WS-ROW-TRTSELECT-ERROR = '1'), the selection field color is set to RED (DFHRED) and cursor length is set to -1; if DELETE is selected on a row with only one valid action and no bad selections, the type code color (TRTTYPC) and description color (TRTYPDC) are set to neutral (DFHNEUTR) and cursor length is set to -1; if UPDATE is selected on a row with only one valid action and no bad selections: the type code color is set to neutral, if update is completed the description color is neutral and cursor length -1, if update not yet completed the description length is set to -1 and attribute to editable (DFHBMFSE) and if description validation failed the description color is set to RED; otherwise the selection field attribute is set to editable (DFHBMFSE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Screen Attribute Setup Based on Action State
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program sets the visual attributes (colors, field protection, cursor position) of each screen row based on the current action state, ensuring users can only interact with appropriate fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display and it is not the first entry or entry from the admin program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen attributes for filter fields are set up (2400-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For the type code filter: if actions are requested, WS-IN-TYPE-CD is displayed in TRTYPEO with skip attribute (DFHBMASF) and blue color (DFHBLUE); if type filter is valid or invalid, WS-IN-TYPE-CD is displayed with editable attribute (DFHBMFSE); if WS-IN-TYPE-CD is zero, LOW-VALUES is displayed; otherwise LOW-VALUES is displayed with editable attribute; if FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK, the type filter color is set to RED (DFHRED) and cursor length to -1; for the description filter: if actions are requested, WS-IN-TYPE-DESC is displayed in TRDESCO with skip attribute and blue color; if description filter is valid or invalid, WS-IN-TYPE-DESC is displayed with editable attribute; otherwise editable attribute is set; if FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK, the description filter color is set to RED and cursor length to -1; if INPUT-OK and no actions requested and not PF7/PF8, cursor length for type filter is set to -1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Filter Display with Color Coding
all_rules.Rule_Description: The type code and description filter fields are displayed with appropriate values and color coding to reflect their current state (active, invalid, or normal).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The informational message is determined (2500-SETUP-MESSAGE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message is selected based on the following priority: if FLG-DELETED-YES, WS-INFORM-DELETE-SUCCESS is set; else if FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED, WS-INFORM-UPDATE-SUCCESS is set; else if FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK or FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK, no info message change; else if ENTER pressed with exactly one delete requested and one valid action and filters unchanged, WS-INFORM-DELETE is set (prompting PF10 confirmation); else if ENTER pressed with exactly one update requested and one valid action and filters unchanged, WS-INFORM-UPDATE is set (prompting PF10 confirmation); else if PF7 on first page, message is 'No previous pages to display'; else if PF8 and no next page and last page already shown, message is 'No more pages to display'; else if PF8 and no next page (first time at last page), WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set and CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set; else if no info message or next page exists, WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set; the WS-RETURN-MSG is placed in ERRMSGO; the WS-INFO-MSG is centered and placed in INFOMSGO with neutral color (DFHNEUTR) if not WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE and not WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND

all_rules.Rule_Name: Context-Sensitive Informational Message Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program displays context-sensitive informational messages to guide the user through the current state of the screen, such as prompting for confirmation, indicating success, or advising on available actions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Input validation has been performed and errors were found (INPUT-ERROR is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display after validation errors
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: WS-RETURN-MSG is moved to CCARD-ERROR-MSG, the current program, mapset, and map are set as the source and next destination, WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE is set as WS-START-KEY, a forward read (8000-READ-FORWARD) is performed if both FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK is false and FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK is false, the screen is sent with the error message displayed in ERRMSGO, and control returns to wait for the next user interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validation Error Message Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: When input validation errors exist, the program displays the error message on the screen and re-displays the current page data so the user can correct their input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 to scroll forward
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The next page existence flag is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is true, WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE is set as WS-START-KEY, WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is incremented by 1, the forward read (8000-READ-FORWARD) is performed, all row selection flags (WS-EDIT-SELECT-FLAGS) are cleared, and the screen is displayed with the next page; if CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is true (last page already reached), the 'No more pages to display' message path is followed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Next Page Existence Check
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before scrolling forward, the program checks whether additional records exist beyond the current page to determine if forward navigation is possible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A forward read has been performed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The forward cursor returns no records (SQLCODE = +100) AND the current screen number is 1 AND WS-ROW-NUMBER is 0
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND is set to TRUE, CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is set, and the screen is displayed with the no-records message; the informational message area (INFOMSGO) is not updated with the info message when WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND is true

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Records Found on First Page Notification
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no transaction type records are found on the first page (either due to an empty table or filter conditions returning no results), the user is informed that no records exist for the current search conditions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has pressed PF8 and no next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The last page status is evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is already true (user previously reached the last page), the message 'No more pages to display' is set in WS-RETURN-MSG; if CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN is true (first time reaching the last page), WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set as the informational message and CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set to TRUE; any key press other than PF8 resets CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN to TRUE

all_rules.Rule_Name: Last Page Tracking and No More Pages Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program tracks whether the last page has been shown to the user and displays an appropriate message when the user attempts to scroll beyond the last page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has completed all processing and is ready to return to CICS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The COMMON-RETURN section is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: LIT-THISTRANID is moved to CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, LIT-THISPGM is moved to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, LIT-THISMAPSET is moved to CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET, LIT-THISMAP is moved to CDEMO-LAST-MAP, CARDDEMO-COMMAREA is moved to WS-COMMAREA, WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA is moved into WS-COMMAREA starting at position (LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + 1) for LENGTH OF WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, and CICS RETURN is issued with TRANSID = LIT-THISTRANID, COMMAREA = WS-COMMAREA, LENGTH = LENGTH OF WS-COMMAREA

all_rules.Rule_Name: Session State Persistence to Communication Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before returning control to CICS, the program saves all current session state (paging keys, screen data, selected row, flags, filter values) to the communication area so it can be restored on the next user interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) has been determined for display
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The message is being prepared for placement in the screen output field (INFOMSGO)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: WS-STRING-LEN is computed as the length of the trimmed WS-INFO-MSG; WS-STRING-MID is computed as (LENGTH(WS-INFO-MSG) - WS-STRING-LEN) / 2 + 1 to find the centering start position; the trimmed message text WS-INFO-MSG(1:WS-STRING-LEN) is placed into WS-STRING-OUT starting at position WS-STRING-MID for length WS-STRING-LEN; if the message is not WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE and not WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND, WS-STRING-OUT is moved to INFOMSGO and the color is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Informational Message Centering on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Informational messages displayed on the screen are centered within the message display area by calculating the trimmed message length and computing the appropriate starting position.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Maintenance program has been invoked by any user action
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen work area (CC-WORK-AREA), miscellaneous storage (WS-MISC-STORAGE), and the outbound communication area (WS-COMMAREA) are all initialized to their default empty values; the current transaction identifier is recorded in WS-TRANID; and the return message flag is set to OFF so no prior message is carried forward

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Working Storage and Communication Areas at Program Start
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the very start of every program invocation, all working storage areas, communication areas, and message flags are reset to their default empty state before any session logic is applied. This ensures no residual data from prior executions contaminates the current run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has completed its initial working storage reset
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program evaluates the length of the communication area passed from the previous interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the communication area length is zero, the session is treated as brand new and all session data is freshly initialized; if the communication area length is greater than zero, the session is treated as a continuation and prior session data is restored

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Whether the Session is Brand New or a Continuation
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program must determine whether the current invocation is the very first entry (no prior session data exists) or a continuation of an existing session. This decision drives whether session state is freshly initialized or restored from the previous interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has determined this is a brand new session with no prior session data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The new session initialization begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The common CardDemo communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is initialized to its default empty state, and the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is also initialized to its default empty state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Common and Program-Specific Communication Areas for a New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a brand new session is detected, both the shared common communication area (used across all CardDemo programs) and the program-specific communication area (used only by this Transaction Type Maintenance program) must be fully initialized to their default empty values before any defaults are applied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand new session has been initialized with empty communication areas
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The session source identity is being established
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current transaction identifier (LIT-THISTRANID) is stored in the communication area field CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, and the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is stored in the communication area field CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record Current Transaction and Program Identity as the Session Source
all_rules.Rule_Description: For a new session, the system must record the identity of the current transaction and program as the originating source within the communication area. This establishes the audit trail and enables correct return navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized for the Transaction Type Maintenance program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The default user type is being assigned
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The user type indicator in the communication area (CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN) is set to TRUE, designating the session as an Administrator-level session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Assign Administrator User Type for New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a brand new session is started, the user type must be defaulted to Administrator. This establishes the access level and determines which functions and data are available to the user during the session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program entry status is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program entry status flag in the communication area (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) is set to TRUE, indicating this is a first-time entry into the program

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Program Status as First-Time Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: For a new session, the program status must be flagged as a first-time entry. This flag controls downstream processing logic, ensuring the program behaves correctly for an initial entry rather than a re-entry from a user action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The active screen context is being recorded
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current screen name (LIT-THISMAP) is stored in the communication area field CDEMO-LAST-MAP, and the current screen set name (LIT-THISMAPSET) is stored in the communication area field CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET

all_rules.Rule_Name: Record the Current Screen and Screen Set as the Active Display Context
all_rules.Rule_Description: For a new session, the system must record the name of the current screen and its associated screen set (mapset) in the communication area. This information is used for navigation, return routing, and screen redisplay logic.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized for the Transaction Type Maintenance program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The initial paging position is being established
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The paging indicator (CA-FIRST-PAGE) is set to TRUE, directing the program to display records starting from the very first transaction type in the database

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Paging Position to Start from the First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: For a new session, the paging position must be initialized to the first page of transaction type records. This ensures the user always begins viewing data from the beginning of the list when first entering the program.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand new session is being initialized and paging has been set to start from the first page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The last-page display status is being initialized
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The last-page-shown indicator (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN) is set to TRUE, recording that the last page of transaction type records has not yet been presented to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark the Last Page of Results as Not Yet Displayed
all_rules.Rule_Description: For a new session, the system must record that the last page of transaction type records has not yet been shown to the user. This flag controls the display of end-of-list messages and prevents premature 'no more records' notifications.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has determined this is a continuation of an existing session with prior session data available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The common session data is being restored
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The common CardDemo communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is populated by extracting the first portion of the passed communication area (DFHCOMMAREA), sized exactly to the length of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, restoring all shared session context from the previous interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Restore Common Session Data from Previous Interaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the session is a continuation (not brand new), the shared common session data from the previous user interaction must be restored. This preserves cross-program context such as user identity, navigation history, and shared state.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has determined this is a continuation of an existing session and the common session data has already been restored
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program-specific session data is being restored
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is populated by extracting the second portion of the passed communication area (DFHCOMMAREA), starting immediately after the common communication area and sized exactly to the length of WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, restoring all Transaction Type Maintenance-specific session context including filters, paging position, and row selections from the previous interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Restore Program-Specific Session Data from Previous Interaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the session is a continuation, the program-specific session data (filters, paging state, row selections, and other Transaction Type Maintenance-specific context) from the previous user interaction must also be restored alongside the common session data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time with no existing session communication area (session length equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that this is a brand-new session with no prior interaction data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the originating transaction identifier in the session context to the current Transaction Type Maintenance transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID), so that subsequent interactions can identify where the session originated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Originating Transaction ID for New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the very first time (no prior session exists), the system must record the current transaction identifier as the originating transaction to establish session traceability.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time with no existing session communication area (session length equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that this is a brand-new session with no prior interaction data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the originating program name in the session context to the current Transaction Type Maintenance program name (LIT-THISPGM), enabling the system to identify which program initiated the session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Originating Program Name for New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the very first time, the system must record the current program name as the originating program to support navigation and return routing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time with no existing session communication area (session length equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that this is a brand-new session with no prior interaction data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the last used map name in the session context to the current Transaction Type Maintenance map name (LIT-THISMAP), so the system knows which screen was last displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Last Used Map Name for New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the very first time, the system must record the current screen map name as the last used map to support screen redisplay and navigation continuity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time with no existing session communication area (session length equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that this is a brand-new session with no prior interaction data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the last used mapset name in the session context to the current Transaction Type Maintenance mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET), so the system knows which screen group was last active

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Last Used Mapset Name for New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user accesses the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the very first time, the system must record the current screen mapset name as the last used mapset to support screen group identification and navigation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user returns to the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and a prior session communication area exists (session length is greater than zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that this is a returning user with existing session data in the communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system restores the general session communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) from the first portion of the passed communication area (DFHCOMMAREA), and restores the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) from the subsequent portion of the passed communication area, making all prior session state available for the current interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Restore Session Data from Prior Interaction for Returning User
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user returns to the Transaction Type Maintenance screen after a prior interaction, the system must restore all previously saved session data from the communication area passed between interactions, so that the user's context (filters, page position, selections) is preserved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A returning user's session data has been successfully loaded from the prior interaction communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The session context fields (originating transaction ID, originating program name, last map name, last mapset name) are extracted from the restored communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All four session context fields — originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID), originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM), last used map name (CDEMO-LAST-MAP), and last used mapset name (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) — are available in working storage for use during the current processing cycle

all_rules.Rule_Name: Carry Forward Transaction ID, Program Name, Map Name, and Mapset Name from Prior Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When session data is restored from a prior interaction, the transaction ID, program name, map name, and mapset name carried in the communication area are made available to the current processing cycle, ensuring continuity of session identification across interactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All business processing for the current interaction has completed and the system is preparing to return control
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the common return routine (COMMON-RETURN) to finalize the session and pass control back
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the current Transaction Type Maintenance transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) into the originating transaction ID field (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) of the session context, overwriting any prior value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Store Current Transaction ID to Session Context After Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all business processing is complete, the system must update the session context with the current transaction ID before returning control, so that the next interaction knows which transaction was last active.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All business processing for the current interaction has completed and the system is preparing to return control
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the common return routine (COMMON-RETURN) to finalize the session and pass control back
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the current Transaction Type Maintenance program name (LIT-THISPGM) into the originating program name field (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) of the session context, overwriting any prior value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Store Current Program Name to Session Context After Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all business processing is complete, the system must update the session context with the current program name before returning control, so that the next interaction knows which program was last active.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All business processing for the current interaction has completed and the system is preparing to return control
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the common return routine (COMMON-RETURN) to finalize the session and pass control back
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the current Transaction Type Maintenance map name (LIT-THISMAP) into the last used map name field (CDEMO-LAST-MAP) of the session context, overwriting any prior value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Store Current Map Name to Session Context After Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all business processing is complete, the system must update the session context with the current map name before returning control, so that the next interaction knows which screen map was last displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All business processing for the current interaction has completed and the system is preparing to return control
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the common return routine (COMMON-RETURN) to finalize the session and pass control back
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system stores the current Transaction Type Maintenance mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET) into the last used mapset name field (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) of the session context, overwriting any prior value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Store Current Mapset Name to Session Context After Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all business processing is complete, the system must update the session context with the current mapset name before returning control, so that the next interaction knows which screen group was last active.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All session context fields (transaction ID, program name, map name, mapset name) have been updated in the session context after processing
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to return control to the transaction manager for the next user interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system copies the general session communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) into the first portion of the outgoing communication area (WS-COMMAREA), copies the program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) into the immediately following portion of WS-COMMAREA, and issues a return to the same Transaction Type Maintenance transaction (LIT-THISTRANID) passing the fully packed WS-COMMAREA with its total length, so that all session state is available in the next interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pack Session Context into Communication Area for Next Screen Interaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all session context fields have been updated, the system must combine the general session communication area and the program-specific communication area into a single communication area and pass it to the next interaction, ensuring complete session state continuity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user initiates the Transaction Type maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether a communication area was passed from a previous execution (session length equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If no communication area is present, the system treats this as a brand-new session and proceeds to initialize all session data; if a communication area is present, the system treats this as a returning user session and loads the existing session data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect First-Time Program Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the current execution is a brand-new session (no prior communication area exists) or a returning user session, and routes initialization accordingly.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected with no prior communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initializes the session for the first time
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The general CardDemo communication area (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) is fully initialized to its default empty state, clearing all shared session fields including transaction ID, program name, user type, and program state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize General Communication Area for New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On first-time entry, the general communication area shared across all CardDemo programs is initialized to clear any residual data before the session begins.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected and the general communication area has been initialized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initializes the program-specific session data
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type program-specific communication area (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA) is fully initialized to its default empty state, clearing all paging variables, filter values, row selection data, and screen state flags

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Program-Specific Communication Area for New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On first-time entry, the program-specific communication area that holds Transaction Type screen state (filters, paging keys, row data) is initialized to clear any residual data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected and communication areas have been initialized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system establishes the session identity
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The originating transaction ID (CDEMO-FROM-TRANID) is set to the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) and the originating program name (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) is set to the current program name (LIT-THISPGM)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Originating Transaction and Program Identity on New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On first-time entry, the system records the current transaction ID and program name as the originating source in the communication area so that navigation history is established from the start.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets up the initial user context
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The user type indicator (CDEMO-USRTYP-ADMIN) is set to TRUE, designating the session as an Administrator-level session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Assign Administrator User Type on New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Transaction Type maintenance screen is accessed for the first time in a session, the user type is automatically set to Administrator, as this is an administrative maintenance function.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system establishes the initial program state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program entry state flag (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) is set to TRUE, indicating this is a fresh entry into the program rather than a re-entry from a user action

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Program State to First Entry on New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On first-time entry, the program state is set to indicate that the program is being entered for the first time, which controls how the screen is rendered and which actions are available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected and program state has been set to first entry
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system establishes the initial screen context
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The last active map name (CDEMO-LAST-MAP) is set to the Transaction Type list screen map name (LIT-THISMAP) and the last active mapset (CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET) is set to the Transaction Type list mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Current Screen to Transaction Type List Screen on New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On first-time entry, the system records the Transaction Type list screen and its mapset as the current active screen in the session context, establishing the navigation baseline.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initializes the paging state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The first-page indicator (CA-FIRST-PAGE) is set to TRUE, signaling that the current display position is at the beginning of the transaction type list

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Paging to First Page on New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On first-time entry, the paging state is initialized so that the display begins from the very first page of transaction type records, ensuring the user always starts at the beginning of the list.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A brand-new session is detected and paging has been set to the first page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initializes the last-page tracking state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The last-page-shown indicator (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN) is set to TRUE, indicating that the final page of transaction type records has not yet been displayed to the user in this session

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Last Page as Not Yet Shown on New Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: On first-time entry, the last-page-shown indicator is set to 'not yet shown' so that the system correctly tracks whether the user has reached the end of the transaction type list during this session.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A returning user session is detected with a communication area present from a prior execution
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system loads the existing session context
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The general CardDemo communication area is restored by copying the first portion of the passed communication area (DFHCOMMAREA) into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA for the length of that structure, AND the program-specific communication area is restored by copying the subsequent portion of DFHCOMMAREA into WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA starting at the offset immediately after the general communication area, for the length of the program-specific structure — thereby fully restoring all prior session state including filters, paging keys, row selections, and screen flags

all_rules.Rule_Name: Load Existing Session Data for Returning User
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a returning user re-enters the Transaction Type maintenance screen, the system restores all previously saved session state — including filters, paging position, and screen context — from the communication area passed by the previous execution.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type List screen is active and the user has navigated from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen (the originating transaction ID matches the Add Transaction Type transaction identifier)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF3 (Back/Exit key) while the originating transaction ID is equal to the Add Transaction Type transaction ID
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system identifies this as a return from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen and proceeds to reset the list screen to a fresh state; if PF3 is pressed from any other context or the originating transaction is not the Add Transaction Type transaction, the system continues with the current session state without resetting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect PF3 Return from Add/Update Transaction Type Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses PF3 (Back/Exit) from the Add or Update Transaction Type screen, the system must detect this specific navigation event by checking that PF3 was pressed and that the originating transaction is the Add Transaction Type transaction. If both conditions are true, the list screen is reset to a fresh state. If only PF3 is pressed from a different context, normal navigation continues.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has detected that the user pressed PF3 from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The reset process is triggered for the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All saved list screen session data is cleared, including: any active type code filter, any active description filter, all paging variables (current page number, first and last transaction codes on page), all row selections and pending action flags, and any previously selected row information

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Saved List Screen Session Data on Return from Add/Update Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a return from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen is detected, all previously saved session data for the Transaction Type List screen — including filter values, paging positions, row selections, and any pending actions — must be cleared so the user starts with a completely clean list screen state.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The saved list screen session data has been cleared following a PF3 return from the Add/Update Transaction Type screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The navigation state is being reset
