all_rules.Rule_Description: Once an update has been successfully completed, the action selection field (U) on the row that was updated is cleared so the row returns to a neutral, unselected state on the refreshed screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that had an Update action (U) selected, exactly one valid action was selected across all rows, no bad action selections exist, and the Update Completed Flag is TRUE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system assigns display color attributes to the fields of that row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type code field (TRTTYPC) for that row is set to neutral color (DFHNEUTR), the Transaction Type description field (TRTYPDC) for that row is set to neutral color (DFHNEUTR), and the selection field length indicator (TRTSELL) is set to -1 to position the cursor

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Updated Transaction Type Row in Neutral Color
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a successful update, the Transaction Type code field and the description field of the updated row are displayed in neutral color to visually indicate the row that was just updated, and the cursor length indicator is set to position focus.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen message setup step is executing and the Update Completed Flag (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED) is TRUE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates which message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the informational message indicator to 'Update Success' (WS-INFORM-UPDATE-SUCCESS = TRUE), which causes the predefined update success message text to be placed into the screen's informational message field (INFOMSGO)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Update Success Informational Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an update has been successfully completed, the system sets an informational success message to be displayed on the screen, confirming to the user that the Transaction Type description was updated.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The update success message text has been determined and is stored in WS-INFO-MSG, and the message is not a 'no information' message and not a 'no records found' message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the message for display in the screen's informational message area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system calculates the trimmed length of the message (WS-STRING-LEN = length of trimmed WS-INFO-MSG), calculates the starting position to center it (WS-STRING-MID = (total field length minus trimmed length) divided by 2, plus 1), places the trimmed message text into the output string at the calculated center position (WS-STRING-OUT), and moves the centered output string to the screen informational message field (INFOMSGO) displayed in neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Center the Update Success Message on the Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The update success message is centered within the informational message display area on the screen by calculating the midpoint position based on the trimmed message length and the total available message field width.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen output area (CTRTLIAO) has been fully populated with refreshed Transaction Type data, row attributes, and the centered update success message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sends the screen to the user's terminal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system transmits the complete screen map (LIT-THISMAP from LIT-THISMAPSET) to the terminal, erasing the previous screen content, positioning the cursor as specified, and freeing the keyboard so the user can interact with the refreshed Transaction Type list showing the update success confirmation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Refreshed Transaction Type List with Update Success Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: The fully built screen — containing the refreshed Transaction Type list and the centered update success message — is sent to the user's terminal, erasing the previous screen content and freeing the keyboard for the next interaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action (U) on a Transaction Type row on the maintenance screen, and the system has retrieved both the description entered by the user for that row (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN for the selected row index) and the existing description currently stored in session memory for that same row (WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT for the selected row index)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the two descriptions by: (1) trimming leading and trailing spaces from both values, (2) converting both to uppercase for case-insensitive comparison, and (3) comparing the trimmed lengths of both values — and finds that the trimmed, uppercased text of the entered description is EQUAL TO the trimmed, uppercased text of the stored description AND the trimmed length of the entered description is EQUAL TO the trimmed length of the stored description
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'No Changes Detected' and sets an informational message indicating no changes were detected, then exits the description validation without proceeding to further description field validation, effectively preventing an unnecessary update operation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect No Changes When Update Description Matches Existing Description
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user selects the Update action on a Transaction Type row and enters a new description, the system compares the entered description against the description currently stored in session memory. If both descriptions are identical in text (case-insensitive, ignoring leading and trailing spaces) and identical in trimmed length, the system informs the user that no changes were detected and does not proceed with the update validation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has selected the Update action (U) on a Transaction Type row, and the system has compared the entered description (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN for the selected row) against the existing stored description (WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT for the selected row) using case-insensitive, trimmed comparison of both text and length
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The trimmed, uppercased entered description is NOT EQUAL TO the trimmed, uppercased stored description, OR the trimmed length of the entered description is NOT EQUAL TO the trimmed length of the stored description — meaning at least one difference exists between the two values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the status to 'Changes Have Occurred' and proceeds to validate the new description by: (1) setting the field name context to 'Transaction Desc', (2) copying the entered description into the alphanumeric validation work area, (3) setting the maximum validation length to 50 characters, and (4) invoking the alphanumeric required field validation routine (1240-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD) to verify the new description is non-blank and contains only alphanumeric characters

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed with Update Validation When Description Has Changed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user selects the Update action on a Transaction Type row and the entered description differs from the existing stored description (either in text content or trimmed length), the system recognises that a change has occurred and proceeds to validate the new description value for correctness before allowing the update to continue.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is processing the array of row selections submitted by the user on the Transaction Type maintenance screen, and is iterating through each row to evaluate the action selected
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines that the Update action has been requested on a specific row (UPDATE-REQUESTED-ON for row index I is true), meaning the user has entered the Update action code in the selection field for that row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the description change detection routine (1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC) specifically for that row, passing the row index (I) as context so that the entered description for that row is compared against the stored description for that same row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Description Change Detection Only When Update Action Is Selected
all_rules.Rule_Description: The no-change detection comparison for a row's description is only triggered when the user has explicitly selected the Update action (U) for that specific row. Rows with no action selected or with a Delete action selected do not undergo description comparison.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has been triggered to perform description change detection for a row where the Update action has been selected
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The description change detection routine (1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC) begins execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the change detection status flag to 'No Changes Found' (NO-CHANGES-FOUND) as the initial default state before any comparison is performed, ensuring a clean baseline for the subsequent description comparison logic

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialise Change Detection Status Before Comparison
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before performing the description comparison for an update action, the system initialises the change detection status to 'No Changes Found' as a default state. This ensures that the comparison result is always explicitly set based on the actual comparison outcome rather than any residual state from a previous operation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and presses PF10
Acceptance_Criteria.When: There is NO pending delete action (CA-DELETE-REQUESTED is not set) AND there is NO pending update action (CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED is not set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: PF10 is treated as an invalid confirmation key; the screen is re-displayed with current transaction type data and filter results without executing any delete or update operation

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF10 Confirmation Requires Active Pending Action
all_rules.Rule_Description: PF10 is only recognized as a confirmation key when there is an active pending delete or update action. If no action is pending, the key press results in a screen re-display without executing any action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has a pending delete or update action selected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and presses PF10 to confirm
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Type Code filter value on the current screen submission is DIFFERENT from the Type Code filter value stored from the previous screen submission (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is NOT set, meaning the filter has changed)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: PF10 is NOT treated as a confirmation key; instead it is converted to a regular Enter key press (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE), and the delete or update action is NOT executed; the screen is re-displayed with current data

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF10 Confirmation Blocked When Type Code Filter Has Changed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When PF10 is pressed to confirm a pending delete or update, the system checks whether the Type Code filter value has been modified since the action was originally selected. If the filter has changed, the confirmation is blocked and PF10 is demoted to a regular Enter key press.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has a pending delete or update action selected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen, the Type Code filter is confirmed unchanged, and the user presses PF10 to confirm
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Description filter value on the current screen submission is DIFFERENT from the Description filter value stored from the previous screen submission (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is NOT set, meaning the description filter has changed)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: PF10 is NOT treated as a confirmation key; instead it is converted to a regular Enter key press (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE), and the delete or update action is NOT executed; the screen is re-displayed with current data

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF10 Confirmation Blocked When Description Filter Has Changed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When PF10 is pressed to confirm a pending delete or update, the system checks whether the Description filter value has been modified since the action was originally selected. If the description filter has changed, the confirmation is blocked and PF10 is demoted to a regular Enter key press.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has a pending delete or update action selected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen, both the Type Code filter and Description filter are confirmed unchanged, and the user presses PF10 to confirm
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row number currently selected (I-SELECTED) is DIFFERENT from the row number stored in the communication area from the previous screen submission (WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED), meaning FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-NO is NOT set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: PF10 is NOT treated as a confirmation key; instead it is converted to a regular Enter key press (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE), and the delete or update action is NOT executed; the screen is re-displayed with current data

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF10 Confirmation Blocked When Row Selection Has Changed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When PF10 is pressed to confirm a pending delete or update, the system checks whether the selected row has changed since the action was originally chosen. If a different row is now selected, the confirmation is blocked and PF10 is demoted to a regular Enter key press.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has a pending delete or update action selected on the Transaction Type maintenance screen and presses PF10 to confirm
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A delete or update action is pending (CA-DELETE-REQUESTED or CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED is set) AND the Type Code filter has NOT changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is set) AND the Description filter has NOT changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is set) AND the selected row has NOT changed (FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-NO is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: PF10 is accepted as a valid confirmation; processing continues as a PF10 confirmation action and the pending delete or update operation is executed against the Transaction Type record

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF10 Confirmation Proceeds When All Criteria Are Unchanged
all_rules.Rule_Description: PF10 is accepted as a valid confirmation key and the pending delete or update action is executed only when all three criteria — Type Code filter, Description filter, and row selection — are confirmed to be unchanged from the previous screen submission.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user presses PF10 on the Transaction Type maintenance screen with a pending delete or update action
Acceptance_Criteria.When: At least one of the following conditions is true: the Type Code filter has changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is NOT set), OR the Description filter has changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is NOT set), OR the selected row has changed (FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-NO is NOT set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The PF10 key action is overridden and replaced with an Enter key action (CCARD-AID-ENTER is set to TRUE); the delete or update operation is NOT executed; processing continues as if the user had pressed Enter

all_rules.Rule_Name: Changed Criteria Converts PF10 to Enter Key and Suppresses Action
all_rules.Rule_Description: When any of the confirmation criteria (Type Code filter, Description filter, or row selection) have changed since the action was selected, PF10 is silently converted to an Enter key press, preventing accidental execution of a delete or update against unintended data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: PF10 was pressed but either no delete or update action was pending, OR the confirmation criteria check failed due to changed filter or row selection
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The PF10 action has been converted to an Enter key press (CCARD-AID-ENTER is TRUE) and processing flows to the default screen refresh path
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system reads transaction type records forward from the current first transaction code (WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE used as WS-START-KEY), applies any active Type Code and Description filters, populates the screen with matching records up to the maximum screen lines, and re-displays the screen with current data — no delete or update is performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Screen Re-Display After PF10 Criteria Failure or No Pending Action
all_rules.Rule_Description: When PF10 confirmation is blocked due to changed criteria or no pending action, the screen is refreshed showing the current transaction type records matching the active filter conditions, without performing any data modification.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF10 AND there is a pending delete action (CA-DELETE-REQUESTED is set) OR there is a pending update action (CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: PF10 is classified as a valid key (PFK-VALID is set to TRUE) and processing proceeds to the PF10 criteria validation checks; if neither a delete nor update is pending, PF10 is not in the valid key set and is treated as an Enter key press

all_rules.Rule_Name: PF10 Key Validity Requires Pending Delete or Update Action
all_rules.Rule_Description: PF10 is only classified as a valid function key when there is an active pending delete or update action. Without a pending action, PF10 is not in the set of recognized valid keys and is treated as an invalid key press, which defaults to Enter behavior.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is preparing to display the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen build process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen output area is cleared to low values, the application title lines (CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02) are placed in the screen header, the current transaction ID (LIT-THISTRANID) is displayed in the transaction name field (TRNNAMEO), and the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is displayed in the program name field (PGMNAMEO)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Screen Header with Program Identity Information
all_rules.Rule_Description: When building the Transaction Type List screen, the system initializes the screen output area and populates the screen header with standard titles, the current transaction ID, and the current program name.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is building the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen header is being populated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current system date is retrieved, formatted by extracting the month (WS-CURDATE-MONTH into WS-CURDATE-MM), day (WS-CURDATE-DAY into WS-CURDATE-DD), and last two digits of the year (WS-CURDATE-YEAR positions 3-4 into WS-CURDATE-YY), and placed in the date field (CURDATEO) in MM/DD/YY format; the current system time is formatted by extracting hours (WS-CURTIME-HOURS into WS-CURTIME-HH), minutes (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE into WS-CURTIME-MM), and seconds (WS-CURTIME-SECOND into WS-CURTIME-SS), and placed in the time field (CURTIMEO) in HH:MM:SS format

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Date and Time on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen must display the current system date formatted as MM/DD/YY and the current system time formatted as HH:MM:SS in the designated screen fields.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is building the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen header fields are being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current screen/page number stored in WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is moved to the page number display field (PAGENOO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Page Number on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen must show the current page number so the user knows which page of transaction type records they are viewing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for each of up to 7 rows on the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A row's data area (WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT for that row index) is equal to LOW-VALUES, indicating no data exists for that row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection field attribute (TRTSELA) for that row is set to protected (DFHBMPRO), preventing the user from entering a selection code on that row; additionally, the transaction type code field attribute (TRTYPDA) is set to protected (DFHBMPRF) for all rows regardless

all_rules.Rule_Name: Protect Selection Field for Empty Rows
all_rules.Rule_Description: Rows that contain no transaction type data must have their selection field protected so the user cannot attempt to select an empty row for an action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for rows on the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row protection flag (FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES) is active, indicating that row selections must be locked
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection field attribute (TRTSELA) for every row is set to protected (DFHBMPRO), preventing the user from entering any selection code on any row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Protect All Row Selection Fields When Row Protection Is Required
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a condition exists that requires all row selections to be locked (such as a filter validation error), every row's selection field must be protected regardless of whether the row contains data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for a row that has data and row protection is not required
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row's selection error flag (WS-ROW-TRTSELECT-ERROR for that row index) is set to '1', indicating an invalid selection code was entered
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection field color attribute (TRTSELC) for that row is set to red (DFHRED) and the selection field cursor length (TRTSELL) is set to -1 to position the cursor on that field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Row Selection Field in Red for Invalid Selection Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: If a user enters an invalid action code in a row's selection field (anything other than D for Delete or U for Update), that selection field must be highlighted in red and the cursor positioned there to draw attention to the error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for a row that has data, row protection is not required, and no invalid selection error exists on the row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A delete action is requested on that row (DELETE-REQUESTED-ON for that row index is true) AND only one valid action is selected across all rows (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION is true) AND no bad action selections exist (FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction type code color attribute (TRTTYPC) for that row is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR), the description color attribute (TRTYPDC) for that row is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR), and the selection field cursor length (TRTSELL) is set to -1 to position the cursor on the selection field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Row in Neutral Color When Delete Action Is Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user has selected the Delete action on a row and it is the only valid action selected (no errors), the transaction type code and description fields for that row are highlighted in neutral color to visually indicate the pending delete action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is setting display attributes for a row that has data, row protection is not required, no invalid selection error exists, and no delete action is requested on the row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: An update action is requested on that row (UPDATE-REQUESTED-ON for that row index is true) AND only one valid action is selected (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION is true) AND no bad action selections exist (FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction type code color attribute (TRTTYPC) for that row is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR); if the update has already been completed (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is true), the selection field cursor length (TRTSELL) is set to -1 and the description color attribute (TRTYPDC) is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR); if the update is still in progress (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is false), the description cursor length (TRTYPDL) is set to -1 and the description field attribute (TRTYPDA) is set to editable/storable (DFHBMFSE) to allow the user to type a new description

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Row in Neutral Color When Update Action Is Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user has selected the Update action on a row and it is the only valid action selected, the transaction type code field is highlighted in neutral color. The description field behavior depends on whether the update has already been completed or is still pending confirmation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An update action is in progress on a row, the update is not yet completed, and the description field has been made editable
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The description validation flag (FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-ISVALID) is NOT set to valid, indicating the description entered by the user failed validation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The description field color attribute (TRTYPDC) for that row is set to red (DFHRED) to visually indicate the description is invalid

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Description Field in Red When Description Validation Fails During Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an update is in progress and the description entered by the user fails validation, the description field must be highlighted in red to indicate the invalid input.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An update action is requested on a row, it is the only valid action, no bad selections exist, and the update has not yet been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the display attributes for the update-pending row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The description field attribute (TRTYPDA) is set to editable and storable (DFHBMFSE), the description field cursor length (TRTYPDL) is set to -1 to position the cursor on the description field, allowing the user to enter a new description value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Enable Description Field for Editing When Update Is in Progress
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user has selected the Update action and the update has not yet been confirmed, the description field for that row must be made editable so the user can type a new description value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating row data fields for each of up to 7 rows on the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A row's stored output data (WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT for that row index) is equal to LOW-VALUES, indicating no transaction type record exists for that row position
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The row is skipped entirely and no data fields are populated for that row, leaving it blank on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Empty Rows When Populating Row Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: When populating the data fields for each row on the screen, rows that contain no transaction type data are skipped and left blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating row data fields and the row contains transaction type data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row data population process executes for a non-empty row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction type code stored in WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT for that row index is moved to the type code display field (TRTTYPO) for that row on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Transaction Type Code for Each Data Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: For every row that contains transaction type data, the 2-character transaction type code stored from the database must be displayed in the type code field. This field is always read-only and cannot be modified by the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An update action is requested on a row, it is the only valid action, no bad selections exist, and the update has not yet been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Changes have been detected in the description field (CHANGES-HAVE-OCCURRED is true), meaning the user's input differs from the original stored description
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the description entered by the user (WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN for that row) is not blank, the new description input is moved to the description display field (TRTYPDO) for that row; if the description is blank (FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-BLANK is true), an asterisk (LIT-ASTERISK) is placed in the description display field to indicate the field was left empty

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Updated Description When User Has Made Changes During Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an update action is in progress and the user has changed the description value, the screen must show the new description entered by the user rather than the original database value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An update action is in progress on a row, changes have been detected in the description field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The description blank flag (FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-BLANK) is true, indicating the user left the description field empty
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The literal asterisk value (LIT-ASTERISK) is moved to the description display field (TRTYPDO) for that row to signal to the user that the description is missing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Asterisk When Description Is Left Blank During Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user is performing an update and leaves the description field blank, an asterisk symbol is displayed in the description field to visually indicate that the field is empty and requires a value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating row data fields for a non-empty row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either no update action is requested on that row, OR an update is requested but no description changes have been detected (CHANGES-HAVE-OCCURRED is false)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The original description stored in WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT for that row index is moved to the description display field (TRTYPDO) for that row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Original Database Description When No Update Changes Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no update action is in progress, or when an update is in progress but no changes have been made to the description, the original description value from the database is displayed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is populating row data fields for a non-empty row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row data population process completes setting the type code and description fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection code stored in WS-EDIT-SELECT for that row index is moved to the selection display field (TRTSELO) for that row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display User's Action Selection Code on Row
all_rules.Rule_Description: The action code entered by the user (U for Update or D for Delete) must be reflected back in the selection field of the corresponding row so the user can see their pending selection.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A delete action was requested on a row, it was the only valid action, and no bad selections existed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The delete operation has been completed successfully (FLG-DELETED-YES is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection flag for that row (SELECT-BLANK for that row index) is set to blank/empty, clearing the selection field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Selection Field After Successful Delete
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a transaction type record has been successfully deleted, the selection field for that row must be cleared to reflect that the record no longer exists and no action is pending.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A delete action was requested on a row, it is the only valid action, and no bad selections exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The delete has not yet been completed (FLG-DELETED-YES is false)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The communication area flag CA-DELETE-REQUESTED is set to true, preserving the delete-pending state for the next screen interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Maintain Delete Requested State When Delete Not Yet Confirmed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a delete action has been selected but not yet confirmed with PF10, the system must maintain the delete-requested state so the confirmation prompt remains active.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An update action was requested on a row, it was the only valid action, and no bad selections existed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update operation has been completed successfully (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection flag for that row (SELECT-BLANK for that row index) is set to blank/empty, clearing the selection field on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Selection Field After Successful Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a transaction type description has been successfully updated, the selection field for that row must be cleared to indicate the action has been completed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An update action was requested on a row, it is the only valid action, and no bad selections exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update has not yet been completed (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED is false)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The communication area flag CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED is set to true, preserving the update-pending state for the next screen interaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Maintain Update Requested State When Update Not Yet Confirmed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an update action has been selected but not yet confirmed with PF10, the system must maintain the update-requested state so the confirmation prompt remains active.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is setting screen field attributes after populating row data, and this is not the first entry to the program nor entry from the Admin program
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current action and filter state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If actions are requested (WS-ACTIONS-REQUESTED > 0): the type code filter field (TRTYPEO) shows the current input value, its attribute (TRTYPEA) is set to auto-skip (DFHBMASF), and its color (TRTYPEC) is set to blue (DFHBLUE); the description filter field (TRDESCO) shows the current input value, its attribute (TRDESCA) is set to auto-skip (DFHBMASF), and its color (TRDESCC) is set to blue (DFHBLUE). If the type code filter is valid or invalid (FLG-TYPEFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK): the type code filter field shows the current input and its attribute is set to editable (DFHBMFSE). If the type code filter is zero: the type code filter field is set to LOW-VALUES. If the description filter is valid or invalid (FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID or FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK): the description filter field shows the current input and its attribute is set to editable (DFHBMFSE). If the type code filter is invalid (FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK): the type code filter color is set to red (DFHRED) and cursor length (TRTYPEL) is set to -1. If the description filter is invalid (FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK): the description filter color is set to red (DFHRED) and cursor length (TRDESCL) is set to -1. If no errors exist and no actions are pending and neither PF7 nor PF8 was pressed: the cursor length for the type code filter (TRTYPEL) is set to -1 to position the cursor there

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Filter Field Display Attributes Based on Action State
all_rules.Rule_Description: The type code and description filter fields on the screen must have their display attributes (color, editability, cursor position) set based on the current state of user actions and filter validity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is determining which informational message to display on the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The delete success flag (FLG-DELETED-YES) is true, indicating the delete operation completed successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the delete success message (WS-INFORM-DELETE-SUCCESS is set to true), which will be displayed centered on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Delete Success Confirmation Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a transaction type record has been successfully deleted, a success confirmation message must be displayed to inform the user that the deletion was completed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is determining which informational message to display, and the delete success flag is not set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update completed flag (FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED) is true, indicating the update operation completed successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the update success message (WS-INFORM-UPDATE-SUCCESS is set to true), which will be displayed centered on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Update Success Confirmation Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a transaction type description has been successfully updated, a success confirmation message must be displayed to inform the user that the update was saved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is determining which informational message to display, and neither delete success nor update success flags are set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either the type code filter invalid flag (FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK) or the description filter invalid flag (FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK) is true
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No informational message is set; the system continues without setting any informational message, as the filter error message already provides feedback to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Suppress Informational Message When Filter Validation Error Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a filter validation error exists (type code or description filter is invalid), no additional informational message is displayed because the error message for the filter issue already occupies the message area.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No filter errors exist, no delete or update success has occurred, and the system is determining the informational message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The ENTER key was pressed (CCARD-AID-ENTER is true) AND the number of delete actions requested (WS-DELETES-REQUESTED) is greater than 0 AND only one action is selected (WS-ONLY-1-ACTION is true) AND only one valid action exists (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION is true) AND no informational message has been set yet (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true) AND the type filter has not changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is true) AND the description filter has not changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the delete confirmation prompt (WS-INFORM-DELETE is set to true), instructing the user to press PF10 to confirm the deletion

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Delete Confirmation Prompt When Delete Action Is Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER after selecting a delete action on exactly one row, a confirmation prompt must be displayed instructing the user to press PF10 to confirm the deletion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No filter errors exist, no delete or update success has occurred, no delete confirmation is pending, and the system is determining the informational message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The ENTER key was pressed (CCARD-AID-ENTER is true) AND the number of update actions requested (WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED) is greater than 0 AND only one action is selected (WS-ONLY-1-ACTION is true) AND only one valid action exists (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION is true) AND no informational message has been set yet (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true) AND the type filter has not changed (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO is true) AND the description filter has not changed (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the update confirmation prompt (WS-INFORM-UPDATE is set to true), instructing the user to press PF10 to save the update

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Update Confirmation Prompt When Update Action Is Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER after selecting an update action on exactly one row, a confirmation prompt must be displayed instructing the user to press PF10 to save the update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No filter errors, no action success, no action confirmation prompts are applicable, and the system is determining the informational message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The PF7 key was pressed (CCARD-AID-PFK07 is true) AND the current page is the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error/return message (WS-RETURN-MSG) is set to 'No previous pages to display', which is displayed in the error message field (ERRMSGO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display No Previous Pages Message When PF7 Pressed on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to scroll backward (PF7) while already on the first page of transaction type records, an informational message must be displayed indicating there are no previous pages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: No filter errors, no action success, no action confirmation prompts, PF7 on first page is not applicable, and the system is determining the informational message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The PF8 key was pressed (CCARD-AID-PFK08 is true) AND no next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is true) AND the last page has already been shown to the user (CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The error/return message (WS-RETURN-MSG) is set to 'No more pages to display', which is displayed in the error message field (ERRMSGO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display No More Pages Message When PF8 Pressed After Last Page Already Shown
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to scroll forward (PF8) but the last page has already been displayed and there are no more records, a message must be shown indicating there are no more pages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: PF8 was pressed, no next page exists, and the last page has NOT yet been shown (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines this is the first time the last page is being displayed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the record actions prompt (WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set to true) instructing the user they can type U to update or D to delete a record; the last page shown flag is updated: CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set to true to record that the last page has now been displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Record Actions Prompt When Last Page Is Reached for the First Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user scrolls forward with PF8 and reaches the last page of records for the first time, an informational prompt is displayed instructing the user on available record actions, and the last page is marked as shown.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is determining the informational message and none of the specific message conditions (delete success, update success, filter error, action confirmation, PF7 first page, PF8 last page) apply
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Either no informational message has been set yet (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true) OR a next page exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message is set to the record actions prompt (WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set to true), instructing the user that they can type U to update or D to delete a record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Default Record Actions Prompt When Records Exist and More Pages Available
all_rules.Rule_Description: When records are displayed and there are more pages available, or when no specific message condition applies, a default informational prompt is shown instructing the user on available record actions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An informational message has been determined and is ready to be displayed on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system calculates the display position for the informational message
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The trimmed length of the informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) is computed into WS-STRING-LEN; the midpoint offset is calculated as: WS-STRING-MID = (total length of WS-INFO-MSG minus WS-STRING-LEN) divided by 2, plus 1; the message text is placed into WS-STRING-OUT starting at position WS-STRING-MID for length WS-STRING-LEN; if the message is not the 'no info' message and not the 'no records found' message, the centered message (WS-STRING-OUT) is moved to the informational message display field (INFOMSGO) and its color attribute (INFOMSGC) is set to neutral (DFHNEUTR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Center Informational Message on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Informational messages displayed on the Transaction Type List screen must be centered within the message field to provide a visually balanced presentation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed determining all messages to display on the Transaction Type List screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen message setup process finalizes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The content of WS-RETURN-MSG is moved to the error message display field (ERRMSGO) on the screen, making any validation errors, action errors, or navigation messages visible to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Error or Validation Message in Error Message Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: Any error or validation message generated during processing must be displayed in the designated error message field on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All screen fields, row data, display attributes, and messages have been fully populated and set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen send process (2600-SEND-SCREEN) executes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen map (LIT-THISMAP) from the mapset (LIT-THISMAPSET) is sent to the user's terminal using the populated output area (CTRTLIAO), the screen is erased before display (ERASE), the keyboard is unlocked (FREEKB), and the cursor is positioned at the field designated by the -1 cursor length settings

all_rules.Rule_Name: Send Completed Transaction Type List Screen to User
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all screen fields, attributes, and messages have been set, the completed Transaction Type List screen must be transmitted to the user's terminal.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is being performed for any row on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system processes each row during screen rendering, regardless of whether the row has data, is selected, or has any action pending
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field for that row must be set to protected/read-only (DFHBMPRF attribute), preventing any user input into that field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Type Code Field is Always Read-Only on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Type Code field on every row of the screen must always be set as protected and read-only, regardless of any action or state. Users can never directly edit the transaction type code through this screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a specific row on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row contains no transaction type data (row output area is empty/low-values) OR the system flag requiring protection of all selection rows is active (e.g., due to invalid filter input)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection field for that row must be set to protected/read-only (DFHBMPRO attribute), preventing the user from entering any action code on that row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Selection Field is Protected When Row Has No Data or Errors Require Row Protection
all_rules.Rule_Description: A row's selection field must be locked and non-interactive when the row contains no transaction type data, or when a system condition (such as invalid filter input) requires all row selections to be protected. This prevents users from attempting to act on empty or unavailable rows.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that has data and does not require blanket row protection
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row's selection error flag is set to '1', indicating the user entered an invalid action code in the selection field for that row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection field color attribute for that row must be set to RED (DFHRED) and the cursor length attribute must be set to -1 to position the cursor on that invalid selection field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Selection Code Entry is Highlighted in Red with Cursor Positioned
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters an invalid action code in a row's selection field (any value other than the valid Delete or Update codes), the selection field for that row must be visually highlighted in red and the cursor must be moved to that field to draw the user's attention to the error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that has data, does not require blanket row protection, and may or may not have an invalid selection error flagged
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A Delete action is requested on that specific row AND only one valid action is selected across the entire screen AND no bad/invalid action selections exist on any row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field color (TRTTYPC) and the Description field color (TRTYPDC) for that row must both be set to neutral color (DFHNEUTR), and the cursor length attribute (TRTSELL) must be set to -1 to position the cursor on the selection field of that row

all_rules.Rule_Name: Row Selected for Delete is Highlighted in Neutral Color
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user selects a row for deletion and it is the only valid action selected on the screen with no bad selections, the transaction type code and description fields for that row are highlighted in a neutral color to visually indicate the pending delete action, and the cursor is moved to the selection field of that row.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that has data, does not require blanket row protection, and a Delete action is NOT requested on that row
Acceptance_Criteria.When: An Update action is requested on that specific row AND only one valid action is selected across the entire screen AND no bad/invalid action selections exist on any row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code field color (TRTTYPC) for that row must be set to neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Row Selected for Update Has Transaction Type Code Highlighted in Neutral Color
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user selects a row for update and it is the only valid action selected on the screen with no bad selections, the transaction type code field for that row is highlighted in neutral color to visually indicate the pending update action. This applies regardless of whether the update has been completed or is still pending.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row where an Update action is requested, only one valid action is selected, and no bad selections exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update has already been completed successfully (update-completed flag is active)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor length attribute (TRTSELL) for that row must be set to -1 to position the cursor on the selection field, and the Description field color (TRTYPDC) must be set to neutral color (DFHNEUTR)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Completed Update Row Has Cursor Positioned and Description Highlighted in Neutral Color
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a successful update has been completed for a selected row, the cursor is moved to the selection field of that row and the description field is highlighted in neutral color to confirm the update is done. The description field remains read-only (not editable) since the update is already complete.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row where an Update action is requested, only one valid action is selected, and no bad selections exist
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The update has NOT yet been completed (update-completed flag is not active), meaning the update is still pending user confirmation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The description field length attribute (TRTYPDL) for that row must be set to -1 to position the cursor on the description field, and the description field attribute (TRTYPDA) must be set to unprotected/editable (DFHBMFSE) to allow user input

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pending Update Row Has Description Field Enabled for Editing with Cursor Positioned
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an update action is selected on a row but the update has not yet been confirmed or completed, the description field for that row must be made editable so the user can enter or modify the transaction type description. The cursor is positioned on the description field to guide the user to enter the new value.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row where an Update action is pending (not yet completed), the description field has been enabled for editing, and the cursor has been positioned on the description field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The description validation flag for that row indicates the description is NOT valid (FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-ISVALID is not set), meaning the entered description failed validation checks (blank, non-alphanumeric, or other constraint)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Description field color attribute (TRTYPDC) for that row must be set to RED (DFHRED) to visually indicate the validation failure to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Description Field is Highlighted in Red When Description Validation Fails on Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user has entered an invalid description for a row being updated (e.g., blank, non-alphanumeric characters, or exceeds maximum length), the description field for that row must be highlighted in red to alert the user to the validation error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen attribute setup is processing a row that contains transaction type data and the system does not require all row selections to be protected
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The row processing reaches the point of setting the selection field attribute, regardless of whether a delete action, update action, or no action is currently associated with that row
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The selection field attribute (TRTSELA) for that row must be set to unprotected/editable (DFHBMFSE), enabling the user to enter an action code in the selection field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Selection Field is Enabled for User Input on Rows with Data and No Protection Required
all_rules.Rule_Description: For any row that contains transaction type data and does not require blanket protection, the selection field must be enabled and made available for user input, allowing the user to enter an action code (Delete or Update) for that row.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is accessing the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being loaded for the first time (no prior session data exists) OR the user has navigated from the Admin Menu program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The filter field display setup is bypassed entirely and the screen renders with default display attributes for the Type Code and Description filter fields, without applying any color, protection, or cursor positioning logic

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Filter Display Setup on First Entry or Admin Menu Navigation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters the Transaction Type Maintenance screen for the first time or navigates from the Admin Menu, the filter field display setup is skipped and screen defaults are used.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and has previously entered a Type Code filter value and/or a Description filter value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: One or more row actions (Delete or Update) have been requested by the user on the current screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Type Code filter field displays the previously entered type code value, is highlighted in Blue color, and is protected from further input (read-only); AND the Description filter field displays the previously entered description value, is highlighted in Blue color, and is protected from further input (read-only)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Lock and Highlight Filter Fields in Blue When Row Actions Are Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user has selected a row action (Delete or Update) on the screen, both the Type Code and Description filter fields are displayed in blue and made read-only to prevent filter changes while an action is in progress.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Type Code filter field contains a value that has been identified as either valid (a 2-digit numeric code) or invalid (non-numeric entry)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entered Type Code filter value is displayed in the Type Code filter field and the field is set as modifiable (editable) so the user can update it

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Type Code Filter as Editable When Filter Value Is Present
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no row actions are pending and the user has entered a Type Code filter value (whether valid or invalid), the entered value is displayed and the field remains editable so the user can correct or change it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending and the Type Code filter has been determined to have no active filter value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Type Code filter value is zero or empty (blank/low-values)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Type Code filter display field is cleared (set to low-values/blank) to indicate no type code filter is currently active

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Type Code Filter Display When Filter Is Zero or Empty
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no row actions are pending and the Type Code filter contains zero or is empty, the Type Code filter display field is cleared to show no filter is active.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Type Code filter does not match any recognized state (not valid, not invalid, not zero, not empty)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Type Code filter display field is cleared (set to low-values/blank) and the field is set as modifiable (editable)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear and Set Type Code Filter as Editable for Non-Zero Unrecognized State
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no row actions are pending and the Type Code filter is neither recognized as valid/invalid nor zero/empty, the display field is cleared and set as editable as a safe default.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Description filter field contains a value that has been identified as either valid or invalid
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entered Description filter value is displayed in the Description filter field and the field is set as modifiable (editable) so the user can update it

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Description Filter as Editable When Filter Value Is Present
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no row actions are pending and the user has entered a Description filter value (whether valid or invalid), the entered value is displayed and the field remains editable.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen with no row actions pending
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Description filter field is blank (no filter value has been entered)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Description filter field is set as modifiable (editable) to allow the user to enter a description filter value

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Description Filter Field as Editable When No Filter Value Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no row actions are pending and no description filter value has been entered, the Description filter field is set as editable to allow the user to enter a filter.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and has entered a value in the Type Code filter field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Type Code filter value is determined to be invalid (e.g., non-numeric characters entered in a field that requires a 2-digit numeric code)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Type Code filter field is highlighted in Red color AND the cursor is automatically positioned to the Type Code filter field so the user can correct the invalid entry

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Type Code Filter Field in Red and Position Cursor When Type Code Is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Type Code filter value fails validation (non-numeric entry), the field is highlighted in red and the cursor is positioned there to draw the user's attention to the error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and has entered a value in the Description filter field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Description filter value is determined to be invalid (no records found matching the entered description filter)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Description filter field is highlighted in Red color AND the cursor is automatically positioned to the Description filter field so the user can correct the invalid entry

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Description Filter Field in Red and Position Cursor When Description Filter Is Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Description filter value fails validation (no matching records found), the field is highlighted in red and the cursor is positioned there to draw the user's attention to the error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All input fields are valid (no validation errors exist) AND no row actions (Delete or Update) are currently pending AND the user is not navigating forward (PF8) or backward (PF7) through pages
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is automatically positioned to the Type Code filter field to prompt the user to enter or modify a search filter

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor to Type Code Filter Field When No Errors and No Actions Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When all inputs are valid, no row actions are pending, and the user is not navigating between pages, the cursor is defaulted to the Type Code filter field to guide the user to start a new search.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen and all input fields are valid
Acceptance_Criteria.When: One or more row actions (Delete or Update) are currently pending AND the user is not navigating between pages
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is NOT repositioned to the Type Code filter field; the screen proceeds to the message setup phase without changing cursor position

all_rules.Rule_Name: Do Not Reposition Cursor When Row Actions Are Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When all inputs are valid but a row action (Delete or Update) is currently pending, the cursor is not repositioned to the Type Code filter field, allowing the user to focus on the pending action.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type Maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: One or more input validation errors exist (e.g., invalid type code, invalid description filter, invalid row selection)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The default cursor positioning to the Type Code filter field is skipped and the screen proceeds directly to the message setup phase; cursor position is governed by the specific error field highlighting rules already applied

all_rules.Rule_Name: Do Not Apply Filter Display Logic When Errors Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When input validation errors exist, the cursor positioning to the Type Code filter field is skipped and the screen proceeds directly to message setup, as cursor position has already been set by the error handling logic.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has confirmed a delete action by pressing PF10, and the transaction type record has been successfully deleted from the TRANSACTION_TYPE table and committed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates which informational message to display on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the informational message to the Delete Success message (WS-INFORM-DELETE-SUCCESS), which is then centered and displayed on the screen in neutral color to confirm the deletion was completed successfully

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Delete Success Informational Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a transaction type record has just been successfully deleted, the system must display a delete success informational message to confirm the completed action to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has confirmed an update action by pressing PF10, and the transaction type description has been successfully updated in the TRANSACTION_TYPE table and committed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates which informational message to display on the screen, and the delete success condition is not met
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the informational message to the Update Success message (WS-INFORM-UPDATE-SUCCESS), which is then centered and displayed on the screen in neutral color to confirm the update was completed successfully

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Update Success Informational Message
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a transaction type description has just been successfully updated, the system must display an update success informational message to confirm the completed action to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered filter criteria on the screen, and either the type code filter is marked as invalid (FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK) or the description filter is marked as invalid (FLG-DESCFILTER-NOT-OK)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates which informational message to display, and neither the delete success nor update success conditions are met
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system skips setting any informational message (CONTINUE with no action), because the filter error message is already displayed separately to the user, and no informational guidance message is shown

all_rules.Rule_Name: Suppress Informational Message When Filter Validation Errors Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When filter validation errors are present (invalid type code filter or invalid description filter), no additional informational message is displayed because the error message already communicates the issue to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen with one or more rows displayed, and the user has entered the Delete action code (D) in exactly one row's selection field, and no other action codes are selected on any other row, and no filter criteria (type code or description) have been changed since the last screen submission
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER to submit the screen, and the system evaluates the informational message to display, and no delete success, update success, or filter error conditions are active, and the total actions requested equals exactly one (WS-ONLY-1-ACTION) and the total valid actions equals exactly one (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION) and the number of delete actions requested is greater than zero (WS-DELETES-REQUESTED > 0)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the informational message to the Delete Confirmation prompt (WS-INFORM-DELETE), instructing the user to press PF10 to confirm the delete action; this message is then centered and displayed on the screen in neutral color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Delete Confirmation Prompt When Single Delete Action Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER with exactly one delete action selected and no filter changes have occurred, the system displays a confirmation prompt instructing the user to press PF10 to confirm the delete.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered the Delete action code (D) in exactly one row's selection field with exactly one valid action selected, and the user has also changed either the type code filter (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-YES) or the description filter (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-YES) since the last screen submission
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the system evaluates the informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does NOT display the delete confirmation prompt; instead, processing continues to evaluate subsequent message conditions (update pending, PF7/PF8 conditions, or default instructions)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Suppress Delete Confirmation Prompt When Filter Criteria Changed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER with a delete action selected but has also changed the filter criteria, the delete confirmation prompt is suppressed because the filter change resets the context.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is on the Transaction Type maintenance screen with one or more rows displayed, and the user has entered the Update action code (U) in exactly one row's selection field, and no other action codes are selected on any other row, and no filter criteria (type code or description) have been changed since the last screen submission
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER to submit the screen, and the system evaluates the informational message to display, and no delete success, update success, filter error, or delete pending conditions are active, and the total actions requested equals exactly one (WS-ONLY-1-ACTION) and the total valid actions equals exactly one (WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION) and the number of update actions requested is greater than zero (WS-UPDATES-REQUESTED > 0)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the informational message to the Update Confirmation prompt (WS-INFORM-UPDATE), instructing the user to press PF10 to confirm the update action; this message is then centered and displayed on the screen in neutral color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Update Confirmation Prompt When Single Update Action Pending
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER with exactly one update action selected and no filter changes have occurred, the system displays a confirmation prompt instructing the user to press PF10 to confirm the update.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has entered the Update action code (U) in exactly one row's selection field with exactly one valid action selected, and the user has also changed either the type code filter (FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-YES) or the description filter (FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-YES) since the last screen submission
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses ENTER and the system evaluates the informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does NOT display the update confirmation prompt; instead, processing continues to evaluate subsequent message conditions (PF7/PF8 conditions or default instructions)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Suppress Update Confirmation Prompt When Filter Criteria Changed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user presses ENTER with an update action selected but has also changed the filter criteria, the update confirmation prompt is suppressed because the filter change resets the context.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction Type maintenance screen and the current page is the first page (CA-FIRST-PAGE is true), meaning there are no records before the currently displayed set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF7 (scroll backward) and the system evaluates the informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the return message to 'No previous pages to display', which is then centered and displayed on the screen to inform the user they are already on the first page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display No Previous Pages Message When PF7 Pressed on First Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to scroll backward (PF7) while already viewing the first page of transaction types, the system informs the user that no previous pages are available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction Type maintenance screen, and there is no next page of records (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is true), and the last page has already been shown to the user in a prior interaction (CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (scroll forward) and the system evaluates the informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the return message to 'No more pages to display', which is then centered and displayed on the screen to inform the user they have reached the end of the available records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display No More Pages Message When PF8 Pressed and Last Page Already Shown
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user attempts to scroll forward (PF8) but there are no more pages and the last page has already been shown in a previous PF8 press, the system informs the user that no more pages are available.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction Type maintenance screen, and there is no next page of records (CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS is true), and the last page has NOT yet been shown to the user (CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The user presses PF8 (scroll forward) and the system evaluates the informational message to display, and no higher-priority message conditions (delete success, update success, filter errors, action pending) are active
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the informational message to the Record Actions instructions (WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS), instructing the user to type U or D to select actions on the displayed records; AND the system marks the last page as having been shown (CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN is set to TRUE) so that subsequent PF8 presses show the 'No more pages' message instead; the message is centered and displayed in neutral color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Action Instructions and Mark Last Page Shown When PF8 Reaches Last Page for First Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user scrolls forward (PF8) and reaches the last page of records for the first time, the system displays instructions for available record actions and marks the last page as having been shown.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user is viewing the Transaction Type maintenance screen with records displayed, and none of the specific message conditions are met: no delete just succeeded, no update just completed, no filter validation errors, no single pending delete or update action, not pressing PF7 on first page, not pressing PF8 on last page; AND either no informational message has been set yet (WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is true) OR a next page of records exists (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the informational message to the Record Actions instructions (WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS), instructing the user to type U or D in the selection field of a row to perform an update or delete action; the message is then centered and displayed on the screen in neutral color

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Default Action Instructions When No Specific Message Condition Met
all_rules.Rule_Description: When no specific message condition applies (no delete/update success, no filter errors, no pending actions, no PF7/PF8 boundary conditions), the system displays default instructions guiding the user to type U or D to select actions on displayed records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An informational message (WS-INFO-MSG) has been determined and is ready to be displayed on the Transaction Type maintenance screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the message for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system calculates the trimmed length of the message (WS-STRING-LEN = length of trimmed WS-INFO-MSG), then computes the starting position to center it (WS-STRING-MID = (total field length of WS-INFO-MSG minus WS-STRING-LEN) divided by 2, plus 1), then places the trimmed message text into the output string buffer (WS-STRING-OUT) at the calculated midpoint position, resulting in a centered message ready for screen display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Center Informational Message on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before displaying any informational message, the system calculates the message length and midpoint offset to center the message within the available screen display area.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The informational message has been determined, centered, and placed into the output string buffer (WS-STRING-OUT), and the system is preparing to send the screen to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system applies the final message to the screen output area
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If an informational message is active (NOT WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE) AND the 'no records found' condition is not set (NOT WS-MESG-NO-RECORDS-FOUND), the system moves the centered message text (WS-STRING-OUT) to the screen informational message output field (INFOMSGO of CTRTLIAO) and sets the display color to neutral (DFHNEUTR) for the informational message color attribute (INFOMSGC of CTRTLIAO); if either condition is not met, no informational message is displayed on screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Final Centered Informational Message in Neutral Color
all_rules.Rule_Description: The final centered informational message is displayed on the screen in neutral color, but only when a meaningful informational message exists and the 'no records found' condition is not active.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Transaction Type list screen is displayed with one or more rows of transaction type data, and the user has entered a value in a row's selection field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The entered value in the row selection field is not blank, not a valid Delete action code ('D'), and not a valid Update action code ('U')
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the overall input status to ERROR, (2) mark that specific row's selection field error indicator to '1' (highlighted in RED), (3) set the error flag 'FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-YES' to indicate bad actions were selected, and (4) set the message flag 'WS-MESG-INVALID-ACTION-CODE' to TRUE to indicate an invalid action code was entered

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Row Selection Action Code
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user enters a value in a row's selection field that is not a valid action code (not Delete 'D' or Update 'U'), the system must reject the input, highlight the row selection field in RED, and set an error flag indicating an invalid action code was entered.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A Transaction Type list screen is displayed and the user has entered action codes in the row selection fields of multiple rows
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The count of rows with valid action codes (Delete or Update) plus any invalid selections results in more than one row having an action selected (WS-ACTIONS-REQUESTED > 1), and a second valid selection is detected while iterating through rows
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must: (1) mark the additional selected row's selection field error indicator to '1' (highlighted in RED), (2) set the error flag 'FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-YES', (3) set the overall input status to ERROR, and (4) set the message flag 'WS-MESG-MORE-THAN-1-ACTION' to TRUE indicating only one action is allowed at a time

all_rules.Rule_Name: Restrict to Single Row Action Selection
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system enforces that only one row can have an action (Delete or Update) selected at a time. If the user selects actions on more than one row simultaneously, the system must reject the input and display an appropriate error message.
